Fixed the Chicago secret car showing the school bus model: the car drawing kept the bus buffer when the special car slot got the secret car. Checked by a log test, not by a picture of the car, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Added a tyre line to the car file, so a car can come with its own tyre compound (Race or Drift) unless you chose another in the garage. Race tyres now leave narrower, darker skid marks. Checked with the test bot on a Gran Turismo car (Race grips more, laps faster, Drift holds a slide) and the simulation hashes did not move. NOT tried by hand: no car carries the line yet, and the Race marks were looked at only in test pictures.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the names of the Driver 2 cars in Choose A Ride and the pause menu car list. Model 0 is the police car in every city and the names sat one place off, so the Mercury Monarch showed the Oldsmobile and the other way round. The names follow the pictures now and the tanks stay with their car. NOT tried by hand: the unit tests and the name audit passed, I did not look at the menus yet. The two pickups of Vegas and Rio are called Pickup because I do not know their make, and the order of the three Chicago cars still needs your eyes. Cars from an older install get the right names at once, the car files themselves only after the setup repair.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the chase camera ending up inside a building when the car falls out of the map (jump spots in Havana and Rio). The old camera was left where it was while the clear spot had already moved. NOT tried by hand, only the new logchecks cam_fall_city1 and cam_fall_city3 and the old cam_ramp and cam_crest checks ran.  [2026-11-16]

Saved the tyre compound (Normal, Race or Drift) of every player in the replay file, in a new trailer at the end of the file. A replay of a Race tyre drive now plays with Race tyres again, so the drive comes out the same. Old replays have no trailer and play with Normal tyres as before, and an older build skips the new bytes. Tested with a recorded Race drive and its replay on the second PC (the first 400 ticks equal) and unit tests for a cut off and a bad trailer. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Added a U-turn routine to the Smart Cop option: a cop swings round or backs out when you are behind it. It stays off by default, because the cop test round showed no gain beyond its noise. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

I made the police car follow model 0 in the traffic rules. The Driver 2 police car is model 0 in every city (the cop voices and sirens already said so, and the car names were fixed to it last week), but the rules that tell the police car from the street cars still used model 3. Now the car kinds (Core city files, cars.kinds), the borrow weight, the foreign cop pick of Mixed police, the car sound / sheet / handling tables and their tests say model 0 = police and model 3 = a street car (Sebring, Delta 88, Cougar ...). So the traffic of every city now borrows the model 3 cars of the other cities, and the police car of another city still never drives as a civilian. The traffic and the cop choice change, so 147 tick hash scenarios moved. NOT tried by hand, tick hash and unit tests only.  [2026-11-16]

Changed the Drift tyres so that only the throttle that reaches the rear wheels causes power oversteer: a front wheel drive car no longer slides its tail from the throttle, an all wheel drive car only with the rear share, rear wheel drive and cars without a sheet are unchanged. Measured on the tyre bed with a Golf V5 (front wheel drive): Race grips 13.8 percent more than Normal, the bot finds no throttle slide on Drift. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

I gave the six Driver 1 police cars that all read Dodge St Regis Police (1979) a place in their name (San Francisco, Intro, Los Angeles, Los Angeles 2, New York, PC), and renamed the small Driver 1 coupe from Maserati Kyalami to Triumph Stag, because its model is a long nose fastback. The name tests pass; I did not look at the car list in the game.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed: cars of the Ashland, Italian Job London and Driv3r Miami packs showed up in Chicago and every other city, low poly and half finished. Since 1302 the car scan took the built-in packs for the base set, so their city list and the pack switch were lost. They are traffic in their own city only now, and the scan counts them as packs again. Checked by a hidden Chicago run: 46 of these cars were picked before, 0 now in 424 picks. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed three Rio cars that were filed under the wrong country in the traffic rules: the Mercedes 450 SL is German, the Thunderbird American and the Corcel Brazilian. The traffic shares of those cars in the American cities and in Rio change. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Hid the low poly Ashland taxi and van (wspc_taxi, wspc_bluevan) from the car lists as unfinished cars. They show again with Options > Gameplay > Show Unfinished Cars. The list is a small data file of the Core pack, so no car files have to be made again. The game log counts 3 unfinished cars now. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the invisible wall on State St in Chicago (public issue 14). The round light poles of the Goose Island lot are 262144 units away from State St, and the check that decides which editor boxes are near the car squared that distance in 32 bit, so the number wrapped and the poles passed as near. The car then hit them as walls that are not drawn. The distance is 64 bit now. A new test drives every lane of State St with the touch log on and fails on a hard stop or an editor box contact. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Dropped the traffic wish lines for Havana and Rio cars that no game file has a model for (Fairlane, Buick, Olds 88, Belvedere, Series 62, Falcon, Peugeot 404, Renault 4, the Soviet cars, Fusca, Brasilia, Opala, Chevette, Passat, Maverick, Polara) and removed the Known problem. The traffic in both cities does not change, those lines matched no car. Unit tests pass.  [2026-11-17]

Made the Ashland cars an experimental group of their own in every car picker, like the GT1 and GT2 cars: an Ash tab in Choose A Ride, an Ashland source in the car browser and the customizer, an Ashland tab in the multiplayer picker, and "(experimental)" after each name (21 languages, machine translated). The taxi and the van are not hidden any more, all 17 stay selectable. NOT tried by hand, only the unit tests and a hidden picture of the pickers.  [2026-11-17]

Added automatic lamp placement for cars (job CAR-LAMPS-FIT). The game reads the red tail lamp and amber indicator patches off the car model and its texture sheet and moves the brake, indicator and reverse points onto the real lenses; a point it finds no evidence for stays where the car had it, and a point that floats off the body comes from the shape of the body. Cars of the disc, mod and pack sets get it, the original Driver 2 cars keep their points. The tweak autolamps picks it: 0 is the old placement, 1 (default) all cars but Driver 2, 2 every car. A lamp point set in a car file still wins. Head lamps are NOT fixed where a car has no lamp glass row. Unit test and pictures only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

A wrecked car in Take a Ride is not the end any more, alone or online: the police stop chasing you, you step out and a new car of the same model waits where the wreck was (fine 100 dollars). Before it was game over or a restart. Option wreckrecovery in tweaks.ini (default on, 0 = the old game over). Races, events and game modes keep their own rules and get a hook, Events_PlayerWrecked. Tried by tests and two games on one PC with equal hashes, NOT by hand, NOT on two PCs.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the invisible wall on State St in Chicago. A pole of the Goose Island Auto Exchange is exactly 4 x 65536 units away from State St, and the distance test wrapped around in 32 bit numbers, so the far pole stopped cars as a box with nothing drawn. The distances are squared in 64 bit now. Driven by hand on State St in the dev copy, the wall is gone. NOT tried in the other cities or with a Driver 1 car.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the rear wheels of the Dodge D250 pickup (Driver 1 PC) sitting far inside the body, and the front wheels of the Chevrolet Monte Carlo Landau. The setup now keeps the wheel track when the body skin it measures is just the inside of the wheel arch. Only these two cars changed in the full Disc Install, all other cars and all level files are byte equal. Tried by hand on the Dodge Ram in a freshly generated folder: the wheels look good. NOT tried by hand: the Monte Carlo front wheels.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the name order of the car lists: numbers in a name now sort by value, so Sports Coupe comes before Sports Coupe 2 and Car 9 before Car 10, in Choose A Ride and in the car browser. Tried by the unit tests only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Gave the Driv3r Miami cars their real in-game names (Packer Transport, Dart Retaliator, Flamingo Taxi, Police Prowler and so on), matched to each model by its picture. Car ids stay the same, so saves keep working. Tried by the unit test only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Added the pipe style Modeled to the car effects: a pipe that is part of the car model draws nothing and the exhaust smoke starts at its tip. The Driv3r cars use it, so they get no generated exhaust pipe. Shows in the customizer Exhaust tab as Modeled pipe. Tried by the unit tests only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Made more of the Driv3r Miami vehicles: the roadster (Velocity Turbo), the dump truck (Packer Transport), the box truck (Sobe Packer Truck), the bus, the work van and the tractor unit (Packer Big Daddy). The exhaust smoke of every Driv3r car starts at the tail pipes of its model. Tried by the unit tests and the converter on the disc only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Changed the car you follow in the story chases to plow through traffic again without slowing down, like in the original, and throw the cars it hits into your way. It no longer passes through them like a ghost. It still passes buildings, takes no damage and is put back on its wheels after 2 s on its roof. NOT tried by hand, measured with the chase test bed on missions 2, 4, 6, 10, 11, 13, 18, 19, 26, 38 and 78: no wreck, no crash, the same path as the original.  [2026-11-18]

Added the option Solid Cars (People and Traffic): no car passes through another one in a crash or a traffic jam. The jam breaker no longer lets a stuck car drive through the cars around it, and cars that meet in a junction no longer pass each other. Players Only keeps the traffic helpers for the traffic and never ghosts a player; Off gives the original back. NOT tried by hand, measured with the traffic flow bench in 4 cities and 8 seeds: jams about the same, a few percent fewer cars through the junctions, more traffic cars touch each other.  [2026-11-18]

Pulled the tyres of the Driv3r Miami cars in so the flat tyre face no longer stands outside the body: the rear wheels of the coupe, fastback, luxury coupe, muscle coupe, sports coupes, racer, supercar and targa stuck out beside the rear quarters. The setup now fits each axle to the side of the body beside the wheel (at most 10 cm, cars that already looked right stay as they are), and the 13 changed car pictures are remade. Tried by the unit test, a disc install into a scratch folder and in-game pictures from behind, the side and above, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the washed out look of the Driv3r cars: they were squeezed into 16 colours per picture, now the setup keeps the original full colour textures (a 1024 picture next to every Driv3r, Ashland and London car file). Not tried by hand, only checked on screenshots.  [2026-11-18]

Gave the Driv3r cars their paint. The bodies came out white and grey because the real game tints them from a table of 16 paints per car that sits in the vehicle property files of the disc. The Disc Install now reads it and paints every car of Miami, Nice and Istanbul in one of its real colours, picked to match the in-game pictures of the wiki; taxis, police cars and buses keep the colours of their own pictures. The car pictures of all 55 cars were made again. The other 15 colours per car are decoded but not written yet. Tried by unit tests, a disc run in a scratch folder and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Pulled the wheels of the Driv3r coupes, Freddo, Dolch Schub and the Polis car further into the body, up to 14 cm instead of 10 cm, so the rear tyres no longer stand out of the fenders. All 55 cars were checked from behind, from the side and from above. Tried by unit tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand in a drive.  [2026-11-18]

Gave the Driv3r cars their wheel arches back. The Disc Install had cut away every triangle inside a box round each wheel, which took the arch lining and the fender lip with the baked tyres (30 to 190 triangles a car, up to 45 percent of what was cut). Now only the baked tyre goes, the arches stay, and the body is as wide at the fenders as on the disc. The wheel inset stays as it was on all 55 cars. Tried by unit tests, the disc stage and pictures, NOT tried by hand in a drive.  [2026-11-18]

Kept the hard edges of the Driv3r car bodies. The disc models carry a normal at every corner, but the converter dropped them and the car file smoothed over every shared vertex (6 to 12 degrees off on average, 3 to 5 percent of the corners over 45). The normals now go into the car and corners of a hard edge stay separate vertices. All 55 cars keep the full detail model (the work van is over the 4096 polygon limit and uses the lower one). Tried by unit tests, the disc stage and pictures, NOT tried by hand in a drive, in the dark or with damage.  [2026-11-18]

Switched the car sheet physics on for every player: the package carries config/carsheet.ini (enabled, preset real), so the Car Realism row of the Game options page works (Real, Scaled, Capped) and Gran Turismo cars use their sheet. Before, only the dev folder had the file and a normal install showed 'Needs sheet physics (experimental)'. This changes the physics of the game for everybody, so every install needs the update to join online games together. NOT tried by hand on a fresh install.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the release writing a file when F7 is pressed. F7 saved the player position as a gas station into config/gasstations_marked.txt and showed 'Gas station position saved' in every build; that is a developer tool now and only exists in the dev exe, so F7 is only the free camera key for players. Also corrected a comment in the shipped config.ini that named a file wrongly. Built the dev exe and ran the health check; the release exe NOT built or tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

I added the cars of Destruction Derby (PlayStation). The Disc Install makes the game's one car body in six paints (Rookie, Amateur and Pro in the paints of player 1 and player 2) from your own disc, with the real door pictures, Driver 2 wheels and a car picture each. They show up as mods\Destruction Derby. Needs the disc. The roof, bonnet and window colours are plain colours, the 19 opponent paints are not found yet. Checked with the real disc and the car pictures on the second PC, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Added the 19 stock cars of Destruction Derby 2 (PlayStation). It is one NASCAR body with the paint and the door number of each driver, from The Master to Rivit, with their real names. They sit in the EXT tab. Disc Install makes them from your own disc (command line option --dd2 for now, no row in the window yet). The player cars Rookie, Amateur and Pro are not in yet. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the damage of a car zone overflowing: a very hard hit (a heavy chase runner, or two cars really colliding now that cars no longer ghost) added to a 16 bit number that wrapped negative, and the mirrored zone had no upper limit, so the dent picture of the car could read the wrong part of its texture page and show garbled noise. The damage is summed in a bigger number and kept between 0 and 4095. This is a likely cause of the garbled rear of a police car after a hit, but I could not reproduce that picture, so it is NOT confirmed. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Added the three player cars of Destruction Derby 2 (PlayStation): Rookie (white, red stripe), Amateur (white, purple stripe) and Pro (yellow, black stripe), on the same NASCAR body, with the 01 on the doors and a car picture each. They sit in the EXT tab next to the 19 drivers and come from the same Disc Install of your own disc. The colours match the wiki. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the Driv3r cars being the mirror image of the real cars: text, plates and decals (POLICE, SoBe, MIAMI, POLIS, number plates) read backwards and left and right were swapped. Checked in the game against the wiki pictures. Tried by the automatic tests only, NOT tried by hand. The car files and the data lumps have to be made again.  [2026-11-18]

Made the window glass of the Driv3r cars see through like the real game, so the seats, dash and steering wheel show inside. The glass picture kept its own alpha, before it was a dark solid slab. Tried by the automatic tests and pictures of 16 cars, NOT tried by hand. The car files and the data lumps have to be made again.  [2026-11-18]

Added all 16 body paints to the Driv3r cars (the customizer shows them as colour swatches, Paint 1 to 16). The game paints one white picture with a mask at load, so the cars stay at the same size on disk instead of 650 MB more. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic tests and pictures from the customizer.  [2026-11-18]

Made the picture of the Driv3r cars sharper: every polygon now keeps its exact picture points in a new file next to the car picture (cars/tex/<id>.uv16), so lettering, rivets and lamps are no longer smeared into steps of 4 texels. Cars without the file look as before. Checked with pictures from a build on the second PC of a coupe, a bus and a taxi, NOT tried by hand, tick hash not run (draw only). The car files and the data lumps have to be made again (about 1.5 MB more).  [2026-11-18]
Not Hand Tested: Made the jobs and the CB radio stop picking their random numbers from the clock, so recorded runs play the same every time.  [2026-10-20]
Not Hand Tested: Changed pedestrians to be run over by traffic and police cars too, not only your own car. Only your own car gives you the hit and run felony.  [2026-11-02]
Not Hand Tested: Made pedestrians dodge cars less, and the dodge now counts for traffic and police cars too. Slow cars and your horn still make everybody get out of the way.  [2026-11-02]

Not Hand Tested: Slowed down how fast a hit pedestrian is thrown: a hit at 60 mph used to throw him about 12 metres, now about 2.7, and at 120 mph about 8. It counts for you, traffic and police cars alike.  [2026-11-02]
Not Hand Tested: Added Pedestrian Models (Automatic, Driver 2, Driv3r, Both) and Pedestrian Height to the Advanced People and Traffic page, saved with the other tweaks.  [2026-11-03]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the names of the Chicago and Havana cars, for example the Buick GSX, the fire truck, the armored truck and the school bus.  [2026-11-05]

Not Hand Tested: Added a cockpit camera view: you sit on the left side of the car and see the bonnet with a dash that shows speed, rev counter and gear. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Made the tail lamps of the converted Gran Turismo cars change from dim red to bright red with a glow when you brake, and the third brake lamp lights too. The cars must be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-06]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed Driver 1 tyres that hung low and small under their wheel arch (the Civilian 4 van, 4 more cars): they are bigger and fill the arch now, the ride height stays.  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the cockpit view: the steering wheel is one smooth ring now (no gaps), the dials are all analog (needles, no digits, a fuel dial and gear lamps) and sit higher so the wheel does not hide them, and each kind of vehicle gets its own simple inside: coupe, convertible (no roof), truck (bench seat), mini bus, bus (seat rows and an aisle) and the cop car with the cage between front and back. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Lowered the dash in the cockpit view to a flat slab and made the dials smaller, so they sit low behind the top of the steering wheel and the windscreen with the bonnet fills most of the picture. The A pillars are thinner. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Fitted the back of the cockpit cabin to the real car body: the roof ends where the body roof ends, the parcel shelf sits under the trunk lid, a short cabin or a long rear window slope gets a coupe cabin without a back bench, and the seats are smaller. Looking back now shows the real trunk and spoiler. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Made the points on the car in the Lights and Exhaust tabs easy to read and to hit: a shape, a colour and a letter for every kind of light and for the pipe, an outline that shows on any paint, the name when the mouse is over a point, an orange halo with axes on the chosen one, a drag over the body of the car, the wheel over the chosen point resizes it, and a new light follows the mouse over the car until you click.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Added keyboard control to the Lights and Exhaust tabs: arrows and Page Up and Down nudge a point (Shift fine, Ctrl coarse), Tab chooses the next entry, M switches both sides, Del deletes, Ctrl+D copies, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo every change, and a number can be typed into every number row. The pipes got turn, tilt and style rows and a layout row. No pad controls were added.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the exhaust pipes of every Gran Turismo 2 and Gran Turismo 1 car to sit where the car's own rear shows its pipes (single, dual, quad or none), from a by-eye table of all 1,417 cars. The old texture search matched the real pipes on only about one car in five. The cars must be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Added a Smart Cop Difficulty option (Easy, Normal, Hard). Normal and Hard police aim ahead of you, ram instead of tailing, drive beside you and cut across open ground when they can see you; Hard also pits and blocks. Easy is the old Smart Cop.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Smart Cop on Normal and Hard so the police reach you much sooner: one or two more cars, replaced faster, and backups come out of side streets ahead of you instead of from far behind. They push you at your speed instead of hitting at full speed, and back out of a stuck spot sooner.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added a repair pad to CatFlip's International Auto Exchange on Goose Island. Park on it, and you can pay to repair your car, pay for new plates that clear your felony, or sell the car (it only buys the cars it asks for, see the Pick List). Every player in a split screen has his own prices and his own wallet.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added a shady CB call that asks for a car model: bring one to the Exchange for a better offer. Accepting costs nothing, there is no timer, and a player who does not answer loses nothing.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed cars in traffic that could turn up with garbled, noisy textures after a long session (a bus with white and grey noise in Chicago): the pool that shares colour palettes between the Driver 1, Gran Turismo and pack cars stopped counting at 255 users and gave a palette back while cars still used it.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Auto Exchange to open as a menu when you press the action button on the pad. Up and down, Enter and Esc, the pad and the mouse all work, and the car no longer drives off when you press the arrows.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Auto Exchange to buy only the cars it asks for: the five cars of its new Pick List and the model the CB radio asks for. Any other car shows Not Needed, and a car over half damaged shows Too Damaged until you repair it. The damage lowers the price.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added HOT: with a stolen car or a Pick List job the police are harder on you. They see you from 1.4 times as far, you cool off slower, backups come sooner and one more car chases you, and Smart Cops push harder. The heat panel reads HOT CAR.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added speed traps to Take a Ride, eight radar spots on the main roads of each of the four cities. Pass one over 65 mph (105 km/h) and you get a SPEED TRAP message with your speed, a small fine from your wallet and a bump to your wanted level. The same trap waits a minute before it catches you again, and a stolen car gets a stricter limit.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Made jobs pay more at night (25 percent), in rain or on a wet road (15 percent) and 40 percent when both. Package runs, race wins, hits, shake-offs, protection rounds and tails say so in the job message. Taxi fares keep their own rates.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Reworked the Smart Cop chase. One cop on Normal and two on Hard now drive the road ahead of you to cut you off, the far cops follow the road route to you, and the cops hit less scenery and traffic (slower through traffic, cutting across only where the car fits, a cop ahead does not ram you head on). In a test with a computer driver the cops wreck less and stay near you more, and one chase in eight still ends in a getaway. It is not as hard as it should be yet.  [2026-11-12]
Not Hand Tested: Added a known problem to the README, some Havana and Rio cars have no model yet and cars newer than 1963 do not spawn in Havana  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Added a radar post at every speed trap in Take a Ride: a pole with a camera box, a blinking lamp and a ring on the road, in the four Driver 2 cities and the four Driver 1 cities. When a trap catches you the screen flashes white, only in the view of the player who was caught. Fines and wanted level stay as they were. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed the wheel positions of the Driver 1 van and pickup. The hubs now sit in the middle of their wheel openings and the tyres are sized to the arches. NOT tried by hand: checked on the side, front and rear pictures only.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Added tyre compounds to the customizer: the Wheels tab has a Tyre compound row, Normal (Driver 2), Race and Drift. Race grips, brakes and corners better but lets go faster past the limit. Drift lets the tail slide and holds the slide for you, the throttle sets the angle, lifting straightens, a throttle stab in a corner or the handbrake kicks the tail out with no clutch button. Drift Assist in the options (Off, Light, Full) sets how much the car steers into the slide. The tyre is saved with each car. Traffic, police and mission cars keep the normal tyres. Compounds are listed in cars/tyres.txt, modders can add their own. NOT tried by hand, only the test bot: Race laps 3.6 percent faster, Drift holds 40 degrees for 8 seconds.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Reworked the Drift tyre. It no longer holds one angle for you: the slide now comes from weight transfer. Braking and lifting rotate the car, throttle gives power oversteer, a quick flick of the wheel swings the weight so you can throw the car from one slide into the other, and the car keeps its yaw momentum. Drift Assist (Off, Light, Full) is now only a gentle self-aligning help that gives way when you steer, plus a soft guard against spinning. NOT tried by hand, only the test bots: flick, S-bend and lift-off.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Made the Drift tyre easier and less snappy. The tail now lets go over a third of a second instead of at once, never drops below a safe grip, and tightens before a slide turns into a spin. A normal turn-in with the throttle starts a slide at 40 to 70 km/h, the clutch kick is softer and longer, and the steering help is stronger when the car is far sideways or turning fast but still gives way when you steer. NOT tried by hand, only the test bots: a seeded sloppy driver holds a slide of 20 degrees or more for 3 seconds without a spin in 20 of 20 runs.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Rebuilt the Drift tyre as a real combined slip model: each axle has its own slip angle, the rear wheels have a slip ratio, and throttle takes lateral grip off the rear through a friction ellipse, so the slide comes from one tyre model. The wheel counts more at a big slip angle so the front can be thrown across fast, and a small drift-hold throttle trim (Drift Assist) helps keep a slide. NOT tried by hand, only the test bots: chains of six slides with no spin in 20 of 20 runs, 10 of 20 sloppy drivers hold a circle drift for 16 seconds or more.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the handbrake on Drift tyres into a tool: the rear wheels no longer lock, a tap kicks the tail out like a clutch kick and keeps your speed, and holding it takes only a part of the rear grip. Smoothed the weight transfer, with lifting and re-applying the throttle shifting load front and back. Added a throttle blip kick: a quick stab from low to high throttle in a slide or turn-in dips the rear grip, spikes the revs and gives a short push, so you can tighten or re-throw a drift without a clutch pedal. NOT tried by hand, only the test bots.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed more Driver 2 car names with the IGCD list as the reference: Havana pickup is the Chevrolet Advance-Design 3100, Rio pickup is the Task Force 3100 (was Dodge C-Series), Vegas pickup is the Chevrolet K-10, Rio pickup is the Dodge Ram. NOT tried by hand. Some Chicago cars and the Rio police car are still open, the IGCD list does not settle them.  [2026-11-16]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Driver 2 car names to your picks: Chicago cars are the Oldsmobile 442 and the Oldsmobile Delta 88, the Havana police car is the De Soto Adventurer Police, the Rio police car is the GAZ 24 Volga Police. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

sections.title: Cities and World
lines: Added maps with road and place names for Havana, Las Vegas and Rio.  [2026-10-14]
Changed the city map pictures to be made on your own PC, so they no longer ship in the package. The Driver 1 cities build their own too, and Rio's street names no longer show on them.  [2026-10-14]
Changed the map, place name and street name files, the city settings and the gas station list to be found by city id as well.  [2026-10-14]

Not Hand Tested: Locked the show car in the Auto Exchange showroom: you cannot get in, it takes no damage and it goes back to its place when something pushes it. The cars on the lot are still for sale and for stealing. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed the Miami models losing the last triangle of every strip: the wedge shaped holes in the quay walls, the broken canal walls and the missing bridge deck pieces came from one wrong count in the model reader. One triangle models are kept now too. Made by the setup from your Driv3r disc, NOT tried by hand, only pictures of the container port, the canal and the beach.  [2026-11-15]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Miami beach: the sand models of the disc that floated over the sea as pale fingers are no longer drawn, the ground draws the sand, and the sand gets darker towards the water. NOT tried by hand, only pictures at the owner's spot.  [2026-11-15]

sections.title: Driver 1 and Gran Turismo
lines: Fixed Gran Turismo car decals under a bigger panel (like taillights set back in the boot lid), they are drawn in front of it now.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the Yellow Cab to ship only the repainted pixels as an overlay over the picture from your own disc.  [2026-10-15]
Fixed oversized wheels on the Driver 1 cars in traffic, and mods no longer replace the Driver 1 cars of a converted city.  [2026-10-15]
Fixed a crash when getting out of the car in a Driver 1 city.  [2026-10-15]
Changed Tanner to show up in the Driver 1 cities, the setup now adds his 16 models and his texture page to every city.  [2026-10-15]
Put the Driver 2 cars of Rio back in the Driver 1 traffic, with their own bodies and textures.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the setup to fit the Driver 1 PlayStation cars to Driver 2 sizes: cruisers per axis, long cars shortened, collision box from the real width.  [2026-10-19]
Gave the 30 Driver 1 PC cars the same size fit as the PlayStation cars.  [2026-10-19]

Added a tool that turns every car of a Gran Turismo 1 disc into a performance sheet (power, gears, tyres, drive type). The sheets are off by default and the physics that uses them is still being tuned.  [2026-10-22]

Added all 621 Gran Turismo 2 cars as performance sheets, with the tyre block taken from the size and compound tables and a 30 car comparison. Tyre grip, load sensitivity and peak slip now come from the record curves for GT1 and GT2 the same way, and drive types 3 and 4 count as rear drive.  [2026-10-23]
Left the two street Eunos Cosmo models out of the Gran Turismo cars, because their pop-up lamps float above the hood and the car does not look right.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed flat coloured shapes (lane stripes, kerb marks) in the Driver 1 cities, they are no longer drawn as textured quads with a random page.  [2026-10-26]
Fixed the lane directions of the Driver 1 cities, one way streets and 3 lane streets were mirrored, and 8 pieces in Los Angeles cut the north south streets.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the world scale to be a setting of the city file, with a check that a Driver 1 lane fits the engine lane.  [2026-10-26]
Gave the Driver 1 cities their own daytime sky colour and light, San Francisco paler, Los Angeles warm, Miami pastel, New York grey and cool.  [2026-10-29]
Gave the Driver 1 cities the English police sirens and phrases and took away the Rio sound zones and tunnels.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed 88 Gran Turismo cars that could not get past 51 km/h, their gear ratios were missing and are estimated now.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed the Driver 1 cars that rode too high on their wheels, and the wrong colours on the credits_5 car.  [2026-10-30]

Added the Driver 1 movies and a first version of the in-game cutscenes to the Driver 1 missions. The setup does not convert the Driver 1 movies yet, and the pickup scene is only like the original.  [2026-10-31]

Fixed the Driver 1 import finding no movies before the missions on the v1.0 disc dump. The movie tables and the start table of the executable are now found by their shape, not by a fixed address, so both disc dumps give the same 44 missions with 36 movies.  [2026-10-31]

Fixed the imported Driver 1 missions: the police missions (Survival, Getaway and others) now bring the cops, and a start inside a building moves to the nearest road. The target cars of the chase missions still only drive a short way and stop. Tested In-Game: Functioning  [2026-11-01]

Fixed the police of the imported Driver 1 missions again: while you are wanted the cops know where you are, so the patrol car goes after you instead of vanishing, and backup cars come from out of sight (up to 5). Tested In-Game: Functioning  [2026-11-01]

Changed the Driver 1 Survival missions (all eight): the police now send 8 cars, one every 2 seconds from the start, and fill up to 8 again when cars are lost. Tested In-Game: Functioning  [2026-11-01]

Gave the imported Trail Blazer missions a longer clock because the 16 places are taken in order and 2:00 was too hard. Gave the imported Getaway and Pursuit missions more police cars. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Changed the police of the imported Getaway, Pursuit and Survival missions: the first car comes at once and one more every 2 seconds, and the wait before the first felony is gone. Shortened the Trail Blazer clocks. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Changed the police cars of the imported Getaway, Pursuit and Survival missions to come up on a street behind you with a clear line to you, so they no longer get stuck behind a house. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Added a wheel position editor to the Wheels tab of the car customizer: move the axles, the track width or single wheels, for Driver 2, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars. It is saved with the car.  [2026-11-05]

Fixed the Gran Turismo 2 cars the setup makes from your disc: wheels, tyre sizes and body height now follow the disc, and trophy and licence entries are no longer listed as cars. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the Gran Turismo 2 car names, engine sounds and wheel designs, which came from the wrong files of the disc. The cars have to be made again with the setup. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Changed the Gran Turismo car names to Maker Model Grade in plain letters, and cars with the same name show their year. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Made the Gran Turismo 2 cars switch to their night look with the time of day, with lit lamps and windows at night. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the wheels of Gran Turismo 1 and 2 cars: front and rear wheels had swapped places, so many cars had the wheels out of their arches.  [2026-11-05]

Fixed the tail lights, brake lights and head lights of the Gran Turismo cars sitting above the roof, so no glow showed and the wet road strips had nothing to follow. The setup now puts the lamps on the body. The cars need the setup run again. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fitted the wheels of the Driver 1 cars to their wheel arches.  [2026-11-05]
Made the tail lamps of the Driver 1 PC cars red instead of blue.  [2026-11-05]
Linked the Gran Turismo 1 engine sounds to the real cars, so each car plays the engine of its own disc entry. The setup has to be run again. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Added the car facts of the Gran Turismo 1 disc to every Gran Turismo 1 car file: price, engine size, power, torque, redline, length, drive, engine type, turbo, the real paint names and the engine and exhaust sound. The Gran Turismo step of the setup has to run again. Nothing in the game shows it yet. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Changed the pop-up headlights of the Gran Turismo 1 cars so the lids move the way the disc moves them, on 67 cars. They need the cars made again by the setup.  [2026-11-06]
Fixed the tail lights of the Gran Turismo 2 cars at night: the red glow no longer lies over the boot lid like a band, one soft halo sits on each lamp.  [2026-11-06]
Fixed dark tail lamp lenses on the Corvette and many more Gran Turismo 2 cars, and made brake lights clearly brighter than parked lights.  [2026-11-06]

Gave every Gran Turismo car without a sheet of its own on the disc the sheet of its base car: 433 of 456 Gran Turismo 2 cars and 159 of 166 Gran Turismo 1 cars. The sheets are marked ESTIMATE, so a race version is really faster. Cars have to be made again with the setup. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Made the car you chase in the Driver 1 chase missions keep driving as traffic when you come close, so it no longer stops after a few metres.  [2026-11-06]
Gave nearly every Gran Turismo car a top speed and gear sheet. Race versions borrow the sheet of their base car, marked ESTIMATE. The setup has to be run again. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Fixed the tail lamps of the Suzuki Kei S and the lit lens of the Mercedes C43 in Gran Turismo 2. The setup has to be run again.  [2026-11-06]

Fixed the brake lamps of the Rover Mini Cooper: its parking colours are dimmed in the converter so braking shows. The same rule covers any Gran Turismo car whose brake and parking colours are close. NOT tried by hand: the cars must be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the Driver 1 PC cars to take the light positions of the civilian and police cars from the PC game files (headlights, indicators, brake and reverse lights, smoke, fire). Found how the PC game picks the light record from the car slot. The player cars keep the scaled PlayStation positions because the PC game builds their table inside its protected exe. NOT tried by hand: the converter ran on the French PC disc into a scratch folder and the numbers were read back, I did not look at the lamps in the game.  [2026-11-07]

Made the setup find the exhaust pipe that the texture of a Gran Turismo car draws (a small dark patch low on the rear end), put our pipe on that spot and pick the type of the car (single, dual, corner left or right). Where the texture shows none, the stock stub under the bumper stays. Cars must be made again by the setup. Checked on rear view pictures of 24 cars, NOT tried by hand; the pipe finds 409 of 1073 GT2 cars, some of them on the wrong spot.  [2026-11-07]
Moved the start spot of Newcastle onto a road that carries traffic. The old spot was on a dead end road. Needs the Driver 1 cities made again by the setup. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]
Fixed the street race job not starting in Newcastle. The race legs were longer than the city has road. The job now tries shorter legs when the long ones do not fit. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Made the chase cars of the Driver 1 missions (Bust Out Jean Paul, Take Out Di'angio's Car, the quick chases and the other chase missions) race away with the racer AI. The car drives off when you come close, ignores lights, picks a road far from you and a new one when you get near, and holds back when it is far ahead so you can still catch it. It always uses the racer policy, whatever the Smart Racer AI option says. Without the policy file it drives as traffic like before. Scripted checks on 1083, 1088 and 1157 pass (60 m and 100 m away in 600 ticks, hold back, no stop). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the night in the Driver 1 cities: San Francisco, Miami, New York and Newcastle only have day textures on the disc, so they are always day now (Take A Ride lists only the day, no more 5:49 AM dawn that was called night). Los Angeles stays night only. Los Angeles also gets street light pools along its roads at night. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Changed the Driver 1 day cities (San Francisco, Miami, New York, Newcastle) to offer day, dawn and dusk again, with no night, because the disc only has day textures for them. A night request starts the dusk, which lasts about 2 minutes before the clock goes back to the dawn. Los Angeles stays night only. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Added approximate street names for the Driver 1 cities San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami and New York: about 25 main roads and a few area names, shown in the street popup and on the full screen map. The disc has no street names, so the game's roads were matched to the real cities by shape and position (Great Highway, Geary Blvd, Wilshire Blvd, Collins Ave, the avenues of New York ...). It is a guess, not exact, and roads without a good match have no name. Newcastle has none. Checked by automatic tests at three road points per city, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed the target car of Driver 1 mission 1087 standing still. It was parked beside the road, so it could not pull out. I now put a parked chase car that is off every road piece into a lane of the nearest road. Cars on a road stay where they are. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic flee check.  [2026-11-09]

Made the Driver 1 converters, the Driver 1 PC level reader and the mission and movie readers refuse damaged files that could wrap a size check. The output for good files is the same. The tracker music player was also tried with 16000 damaged copies of the real Driver 2 music file, no crash. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Made the traffic of the five Driver 1 cities use the police cruisers of the city being played. San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami, New York and Newcastle used to mix in cruisers of the other Driver 1 cities. Now the cruisers are those of the city, as in the original. The first version of this also locked the civilian cars, the cab and the Driver 2 cars out; that part was taken back the same day, see the next entry. Checked by automatic tests in all five cities (no off-city cruiser), NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed the cars falling into the sea when they leave the road on a hill in San Francisco and Los Angeles. The cells beside the roads there counted as deep sea and had no ground, so a car that left the road fell and died. They are ground now when they join the slope of the road (a cliff stays sea). Miami and New York are unchanged, the New York deck gap is NOT fixed. Checked by automatic tests (a car put on a hillside in both cities stays on the ground), NOT tried by hand. The levels have to be made again from the discs to get it.  [2026-11-09]

Put the cars of both games back into the traffic of every city. The five Driver 1 cities show Driver 1 cars, Driver 2 cars (the specials from model 8 to 12 too) and the cab again, as the Driver 2 cities always did. Only the police cruisers are the city's own. Newcastle, the smallest city, showed 22 Driver 1 and 15 Driver 2 models in a long test run, New York 52 and 25. The Driver 2 cities did not change. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Built the Driver 1 training courses. The eight courses (Time trial and Practice 1 to 4) on the Training level now show only their own cone and pole set, count in with 3, 2, 1, GO while the car is locked and the clock stands still, number the laps (Lap 2 of 6), and the time trials end with your time and the best time of the course, which stays in your save. The start of the Training level is no longer moved onto a road (it put course 1 against a wall). The Driver 1 Missions mod has to be made again (setup) to get it. The three films and the two interviews are still plain drives. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand. The cones falling over was not run in the game (their model data says smashable).  [2026-11-09]

Added speed traps to the Driver 1 cities (6 each in Frisco, Los Angeles, Miami and New York). The contract board and the night and rain pay already worked there, now tested. City Music rows for Driver 1 cities are not added, the game has no Driver 1 city music. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]
Corrected two Driver 1 car names after the review: a Chevrolet C10 and a Ford.  [2026-11-12]
Fixed the wheel positions of two more Driver 1 cars (the Newcastle coupe and the Newcastle muscle car). NOT tried by hand, only looked at in pictures.  [2026-11-12]

Fixed the purple glass panes of the storefronts in Driver 1 Miami. The glass key colour of the Driver 1 palettes now becomes a dark blue glass tint when the city loads. The other Driver 1 cities use the same key and get the same tint. Looked at in two Miami pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Checked the 17 Driver 1 missions where you chase or wreck a car with scripts: the car drives off when you come close and the mission ends complete once it is wrecked, in all of them. Checked that no car goes under the ground in the four Driver 1 cities. NOT played by hand, and the chase car still only flees, it does not drive the route of the original. The known problems in the README say this now.  [2026-11-14]

Puts a street floor under the elevated roads of Driver 1 New York. The deck and the ramp near the road end floated over the sea. The setup now adds the floor when it makes the city, the driving surface is not changed (a car on the deck behaves the same, checked old against new). A new New York level has to be made to see it. Checked by log check and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Makes the Driver 1 training films 1 to 3 real. A lead car now drives the run the original recorded, the position log of your own disc, with the recorded speed, and you follow it; the film ends when it stops at the last place. Interview 1 gets the same lead car (the interview rules are not in yet). It is a normal car that one new call in the existing car control hook drives with the pad. Made by the setup from your disc, so the mission files have to be made again. Checked by unit tests and a log check, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Adds the Driver 1 credits ride (mission 127). The credits of the original roll up over the Credits level at the original pace while the car drives itself along the road, and the ride ends when the roll is over. The text is read from your own disc by a new setup step (rdcontent d1mission credits) into your own mod folder only, it is not part of the game files. Without that file the mission stays a free drive. The car drives itself on the road lanes, the original played a recorded run that this engine cannot play. The face pictures are not drawn. Checked by unit tests, a log check and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Adds the rules of the Driver 1 interview (missions 173 and 174). The test keeps a score from 5000, adds points for the weave through the two lanes of cones that the original scored, takes a penalty for a hit (one every second at most, four wreck the test), and judges you when the time is up and the car has stopped: wrecked, out of time, or you get the job. Six parked cars stand on the course. The texts and the scoring data are read from your own disc into your own mod folder, not part of the game files. The lead car of interview 1 drives the recorded run. Not in yet: the dial, the pad display, the voices. The interview level itself still shows water instead of the car park, so it cannot be driven properly yet. Checked by unit tests and a log check, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Fixes the Driver 1 interview level. The car started on the water far from the car park, because the start was moved to the nearest road, 14805 units away over the sea. Now the start stays where the mission puts it, in the car park with the pillars, the low ceiling and the six parked police cars. The new test d1iview_ground checks that the start is kept and that the cars stay on the ground. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Makes the setup write the Driver 1 credits roll and the interview rules from your own disc, in the Driver 1 missions step: the credits ride (mission 127) and the two interview tests (173 and 174) work after a normal install, no extra command. The new line Driver 1 credits and interview is in the setup report, and its texts are in all 21 languages. The interview time limit is now read from the disc too: 30 seconds on the clock, 1800 ticks, instead of a guess. Tested with a game folder made by the setup itself (the logchecks for films, credits and interview pass there). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Changes how the Driver 1 interview is passed, to the rule of the original: you get the job when you have shown all nine driving moves (wheelspin, handbrake, the first and second half of the course, a handbrake turn, hard cornering, a fast reverse turn, a hard stop, braking from speed). Running out of time is a fail, as in the original, and the score does not decide. The speeds and turn rates are the original numbers scaled to the Driver 2 car, they are checked by unit tests only. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Removed five models that are not cars from the Gran Turismo 1 car list: the cup trophy, the GT logo and three licence plates. They showed up as flat slabs on wheels. The setup no longer converts them, an older install loses their files on the next Disc Install, and their pictures are out of the car photos. Setup builds and the GT unit tests pass, NOT tried by hand with a new Disc Install.  [2026-11-17]
Not Hand Tested: Found the Driver 1 story movies on the European, French, German and Italian discs, so the movie list shows 44 missions with movies on all six discs.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Added the night look of the Gran Turismo 2 cars to their car files: lit lamps and windows, and the night model for the cars whose night model differs. The game does not switch to it yet.  [2026-11-05]

Not Hand Tested: Added pop-up headlights for 22 Gran Turismo 1 cars (RX-7 FC and FD, Eunos Roadster, 180SX, the two Supra A70): the lamp lids tilt up when the lights come on, and the glow and beam show only when the lid is up.  [2026-11-05]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the setup so every Gran Turismo car with a car sheet on the disc carries it in its car file, so the Gran Turismo Car Top Speed option and the 5th and 6th gear work in the install (617 of 1073 Gran Turismo 2 cars, 178 of 344 Gran Turismo 1 cars). The cars need to be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Moved the head light of the Gran Turismo 2 cars onto the real headlamp glass: it shows dark glass when off and a lit glass with a glow when on (1059 of 1073 cars). The cars must be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-06]
Not Hand Tested: Changed the pop-up headlights so the lid is one solid piece that turns up about a hinge, with a dark pocket under it. The setup has to be run again.  [2026-11-06]
Not Hand Tested: Made the exhaust search of the setup prefer a pipe patch low on the bumper over plate screws and lamp rims.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Centred the wheels of the Driver 1 cars in their wheel openings. The old rule found no opening on most cars, so many wheels stood in a corner of the opening, sat too far forward or showed through the fender. 42 of the 63 cars change and the tyre size follows the opening. NOT tried by hand, side pictures only; the Driver 1 cities are not rebuilt yet.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Named all 63 Driver 1 cars after the real cars they look like (make, model, years), for example Ford Thunderbird (1957) instead of Thunderbird look-alike. The Ferrari 250 SWB keeps its name and every car keeps its id, so saves and mods work as before. The names are best guesses from the pictures and NOT tried by hand in the Choose A Ride list.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Driver 1 car names to the real cars listed in the Internet Game Cars Database; matched by looking at the models, NOT tried by hand. Every name is Make Model (year) with the year as that list shows it, police cars and taxis say so, and the Ferrari 250 SWB and the Thunderbird (1955) keep their names. Many are still best guesses.  [2026-11-12]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed turning on one Gran Turismo car switching off the Gran Turismo traffic; the 1983 cars stay on and picked cars are added  [2026-11-13]
Not Hand Tested: Corrected the readme: all 123 Driver 1 missions import. The training courses are real, the films, the interviews and the credits ride are only approximations.  [2026-11-15]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Driver 1 car pictures (the lists and the Choose A Ride photos) so the wheels sit in the middle of the openings. NOT tried by hand in the game, the pictures were looked at only.  [2026-11-16]

sections.title: Graphics and Lighting
lines: Changed the water to reflect the sky, so the clouds and the sun show in it.  [2026-10-14]
Fixed a black box that showed around a wheel when its hubcap flew off.  [2026-10-14]
Added a flat water reflection to the Driver 1 cities, made from the water tiles of the level.  [2026-10-14]
Added three car options: Exhaust Pipes, Tail Lamp Glow and Handbrake Brake Light (all off by default). View Distance can now go down to 1. All translated.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the flat car shadow to stay still again, it no longer slides with the sun. The Sun Shadows setting is the moving shadow.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the 3D grass patches to follow the slope of the ground.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the grass patches to be a little less regular.  [2026-10-21]

Added a texture manager for car and level textures, so a picture is no longer stuck to a 256 x 256 page or 16 colours. All textures are drawn through it now, and colour cycling and the day and night swap follow the textures.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the GPU cars to use their pages as indexed materials with the texture manager (home city cars, borrowed cars, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars).  [2026-10-22]
Changed indexed car pages to follow the bilinear filtering setting.  [2026-10-22]
Changed customizer paint changes and the day to night swap to reach the car materials.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed roads at long view distances losing their lane stripes, kerb edges and crossing marks, the far map now bakes the high detail road and ground tiles.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed far buildings and props losing parts at long view distances. The far map now uses the full detail model of every object.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the normal view to never switch buildings and ground tiles to the lower detail model with distance.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the picture to be smooth in split screen with 2 to 8 players and while the game is paused, every view now moves with the same timing.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the game to keep the city's draw data in a few big memory blocks and draw each pass with far fewer calls.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the background traffic to draw in groups per car model, Draw Calls reduced from 1160 to 406 in rush hour test scenario.  [2026-10-23]
Changed split screen views to draw less far away, with a closer fog and smaller shadow and reflection maps in a small view, so split screen runs faster.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the cars in the shadow maps to draw in groups, and left out cars that cannot shadow anything in that map.  [2026-10-23]
Made the effect streams (background layer, shadow casters, car groups) go to the card through a mapped buffer so the driver stops waiting.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the objects around you (street lamps, barriers, trees, signs, animated objects like traffic lights) to the graphics card, and the city walk now only covers the near ring.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the game to tell the graphics card to start working at the end of every pass, which lifts the rush hour test from about 650 to 750 fps. It can be turned off in display.ini.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the sky to draw after the solid world, so only the open pixels run the sky, and the road reflection redraws every second frame above 250 fps, both for a single view only.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the background cars and the crowd to the graphics card.  [2026-10-23]

Changed the graphics card batch to be the only renderer at every view cells setting, the old 10 cell view is gone. The draw radius is now a fog and cull distance, the original reach is back to 20 cells and the fog starts half way to the draw distance.  [2026-10-23]
Moved smoke, sparks, debris, leaves, birds, tyre tracks, light glows and rain to a new graphics card effect pass and deleted the old processor effect code.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the lens flare, the wet road reflections, the ground light and the round shadows to the graphics card as effect quads.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the lines between the two stacked views in two player split screen showing old picture bits, they are cleared to black each frame.  [2026-10-23]
Made the game skip graphics calls that set something already set (program, buffers, textures, framebuffer).  [2026-10-23]
Removed the upscaled high quality sky from the game, the vanilla sky stays.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the drawing of pedestrian heads, Tanner, traffic cones, the hubcap, event models and smashed objects to the graphics card. This is faster and the old drawing code is gone.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the flat shadow under a car to the graphics card.  [2026-10-23]
Moved explosions to the graphics card.  [2026-10-23]
Changed pedestrians to use the graphics card limb drawing in split screen too.  [2026-10-23]
Moved the mission target arrows, the stop zone and the helicopter rotor blades to the graphics card.  [2026-10-23]

Added a Render Scale row to the display settings. It draws the 3D world smaller or bigger than the window and scales it to fit while the HUD and minimap stay sharp. 50 to 100 percent runs faster, 125, 150 and 200 percent draw sharper. In all languages.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the sun shadows to work with the original painted sky.  [2026-10-23]
Added six graphics presets (Classic, Classic: Extended, Extended Low, Medium, High, Max) that set the graphics options in one step, also as the console command preset, in all languages.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the Classic frame limit staying locked after switching to PAL, and a broken fpsfree value now means unlimited.  [2026-10-23]
Removed the wholeMap setting. The whole map is always drawn now, and an old config.ini with the key still loads.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed road markings, crosswalks and kerbs flickering on the road, overlapping ground pieces are now drawn in layers in the same order as the PlayStation game.  [2026-10-25]
Fixed signs flickering, a sign made of a front and a back piece now draws one side.  [2026-10-25]
Fixed the ferris wheel disappearing at a distance, big objects now draw out to the end of the fog.  [2026-10-25]
Lifted the headlight and brake light pools of a car a little off the road, so their far part no longer disappears into the road.  [2026-10-25]
Changed Tanner's shadow on foot to show (the old one was never visible), and the pedestrian sprite fallback moved to the effect pass.  [2026-10-25]
Added a setting for modders, texMgrCompat. The default 0 gives smooth textures in the distance, 1 draws them like the old way.  [2026-10-26]
Moved the painted original sky to the graphics card, so it shows the clouds and skyline again where the old path showed one flat colour.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the sun, the lens flare and the moon of the original sky to effect sprites, and the glare of the sun now depends on how much of the sun disc is really visible.  [2026-10-26]
Made the light trails of lamps and car lights and the full screen flash of lightning, explosions and the sun effect quads on the graphics card, same picture as before.  [2026-10-26]

Fixed the ghost cars at night: headlight beams and red lights showed on the road for cars that are not drawn. The flat back light patch is off with dynamic lights and far cars get lamps only when they have a body.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the night roads of Las Vegas and Rio to be readable, each city has a night ground brightness key (light.nightground).  [2026-10-26]
Changed the brightness of the Driver 1 cities, Los Angeles no longer clips lit shop windows to flat white.  [2026-10-27]
Gave the Driver 1 cities the PlayStation dusk light, flat shading, a dusk sky and nearest texture sampling.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed the fence mosaic at dusk in Vegas, the transparent parts of the day and night textures are mixed now.  [2026-10-27]
Changed dynamic lights to run much faster, every screen tile only uses the lights that reach it, the cost fell by about half at 4K.  [2026-10-27]
Raised the limit of dynamic lights from 256 to 1024 and the car and lamp light caps to 160 and 512.  [2026-10-27]
Changed every near street lamp to be a dynamic light (160 by default), brighter and higher, with a smaller glow sprite.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed the flat headlight patch under cars while dynamic lights are on, and beams fade in at the range edge instead of popping.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed blocky lighting in busy streets and visible tile edges when the camera turns, and added a debug mode that paints tile errors.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed the crosswalks flickering on the road, road pieces that only touch at a seam no longer pile up on top of each other.  [2026-10-29]
Added an optional OpenGL 4.3 drawing route, it is off by default and set with gl43 in config.ini.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed Las Vegas at night, the lamp posts no longer stay pale grey.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed loose pedestrian heads floating around in the free camera. They are not drawn any more.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed a car texture page that no swap wrote: it holds the day set now (Havana started at night).  [2026-10-29]
Changed the texture manager to be the only way the game draws textures. If the graphics card cannot start it, the game says so and stops.  [2026-10-30]
Removed the PGXP Texture Correction and PGXP Z-Buffer options from Developer Options. Both always ran on and still do, so only a player who had turned one off loses that choice.  [2026-10-30]

Rebuilt the photo mode camera panel: Focal Length, Zoom and FOV move together (24 mm is the normal view), with a tracking aim at a target, and a panel with tabs you can use with the keyboard, the pad or the mouse.  [2026-10-31]

Added photo mode image sliders: Exposure, Brightness, Contrast, Colour (black and white at the left end), Sepia and White Temperature, plus a softer vignette with Size, Softness, Shape and Colour rows. The panel itself is never toned.  [2026-10-31]

Added photo mode scene and car settings: Time Of Day, Weather (rain), headlights, high beams and Steering that turns the front wheels. All of it goes back to how the game was when you leave, and the simulation is not changed.  [2026-10-31]
Added photo mode presets: three slots that Save Preset, Load Preset and Reset All keep between games.  [2026-10-31]
Strengthened the photo mode depth of field: the blur discs are five times as large, so aperture, focus and bokeh show clearly even at the default 24 mm lens.  [2026-11-01]
Added a first version of 3D tree shadows: a tree throws a round crown shadow and not a pole. The trees themselves look the same. Off by default.  [2026-11-01]

Added a pedestrian model set that draws civilians as Driv3r character models, made by the setup from your own Driv3r disc. The models are scaled to Tanner and the Driver 2 sprites. Draw only, the simulation is not touched.  [2026-11-01]

Added shadows for the Driv3r pedestrians: a slim volume goes into the sun and moon shadow map the cars and trees use, and the 24 pedestrians nearest to the camera cast the shadow of their real posed shape. Off when the shadow map is off.  [2026-11-01]

Fixed the turbo walk of scared Driv3r pedestrians: a pedestrian that jumps away from a car or runs now plays the run clip, and goes back to the walk clip when it slows down, so it does not flicker.  [2026-11-01]
Made the shader cache build safer: a shader that does not compile is skipped instead of stopping the game, and the build gives up after 120 seconds if a driver hangs.  [2026-11-02]

Changed the ragdoll of a hit pedestrian: a body at rest settles into the Driv3r die pose that lies the same way, the arms no longer pass through the torso, a body thrown at a wall stops at it, and a lying body sinks into the road instead of popping out. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]

Added street lamp shadows at night (Lamp shadows setting). The two lamps nearest the camera cast shadows of trees, poles, cars and pedestrians on the road and the wall behind. On in Extended Medium, High and Max. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]

Fixed the light streaks of headlights and street lamps switching themselves off for half of every nine minutes of play. NOT tried by hand, NOT proven past that point (no test scene can start there).  [2026-11-03]

Made the Driv3r pedestrians the default pedestrian set. With no pedModelSet in config.ini and no console choice, the game uses the Driv3r models when they are converted and falls back to the Driver 2 sprites with one log line when they are not. New value auto (config.ini, console ped set auto) asks for the default again.  [2026-11-03]

Smoothed level textures in the distance. Far walls, windows and road lines are averaged over the pixels they cover, so they shimmer and sparkle less while you drive. Near textures look the same. New setting indexedMips in config.ini under [render], 1 is the default, 0 gives the old look. NOT tried by hand, a hand check far-textures-mips is ready.  [2026-11-04]
Made the lit lamps of the Gran Turismo 2 cars light up at night: headlamp glass, tail lamps and lit windows. The cars have to be made again by the setup.  [2026-11-05]

Added a real rear view mirror to the cockpit view that shows what is behind you, with a Mirror Quality option (Off, Low, High) under Camera Views. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-06]

Changed the pop-up headlight lids to open together with the lamp ramp at dusk, not after it. Checked by automatic tests (lids down by day, up at night), NOT tried by hand at dusk. Not done: lit sprites of Havana and Vegas (need a decision first for a third colour table entry) and the cycling neon.  [2026-11-07]

Made the game know what is water: water models are marked now, and the water look uses that mark instead of guessing water from a blue colour. Water reflection and Water Brightness behave as before (8 water, rain and night scenes compared: same picture, only moving boats and lamps differ). Driver 1 cities still find their water by the height of the water plane. Edited water pieces in a Driver 2 city no longer count as water unless they are in a water model. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added light colours per car in the customizer: headlights, indicators, tail lights, brake lights and reverse lights can be white, warm yellow, cool white, amber, red or any colour you set. The colour changes the glow, the headlight beams and the brake light on the road. NOT tried by hand: the colours were checked only by log and picture.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the missing 3D tree shadows: the setting stood at off (the old small dark squares) when a config did not name it, so only the presets Medium, High and Max showed them. A new or old tweaks.ini now gets the finest tree shadows, a round crown shadow that follows the sun from morning to dusk. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Made the water look (reflection, sky, water drawing) apply only to the texture named water and to the original water of the Driver 2 cities. Driver 1 cities found their water by height, so random surfaces near the sea got the water look; that rule is gone. Water pieces made with the water texture (water.tga, water_blue.tga) now look like water in every city, also in Chicago and Havana where the edit pieces had lost it. Added a default water texture to the Core pack. Checked by test pictures only, NOT tried by hand, no Driver 1 city compared.  [2026-11-08]

Added colour sliders to photo mode: new Tone and Colour tabs with highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, a three point tone curve, clarity, sharpen, vibrance, tint, hue, saturation and luminance for each of eight colours, split toning and film grain. They work in the live view and in the saved photo and never in normal play. Every row has a small dot when it changed: click it, or press Backspace, Delete or Square, to put that row back; Reset all clears everything. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Added 30 built in looks to photo mode (Presets tab), several in the style of the late 70s and early 80s: Seventies Print, Drive-In Night, Super 8, Cop Show, Instant Print, Neon Night and more. A look only sets the picture rows, never the lens, depth of field, shutter or size, and you can move any slider after it. NOT tried by hand, only the picture tests.  [2026-11-09]

Made the batch cache file refuse counts that promise more data than the file has, so a damaged cache file is baked again instead of aborting the game. Checked by build only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Drew the street nearest to the camera first, so the graphics card throws hidden wall and road pixels away early. At 1080p it saves about 0.06 ms a frame (day 1.15 to 1.08 ms, night and wet night the same), more on a wide screen. The pictures are the same. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Cut the grass into blocks of 2048 units instead of 8192, so fewer grass patches go to the graphics card just to be thrown away. Saves up to 0.02 ms at 1080p and 0.04 to 0.06 ms at 3440x1440. The pictures are the same. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Took two wasted bits out of the light calculation: a loop over the cars that was multiplied by zero, and the car shadow check on surfaces that face away from the light. About 0.03 ms a frame at 1080p. The pictures are the same. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]
Made far away textures a little softer for a small speed gain. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Made the picture cheaper to draw by reusing what did not change: the street lamp shadows and the sun and moon shadows are kept while nothing they show moved, the car reflection picture is redrawn at most every 6 ms, the wet road reflection is reused for up to 8 ms while the camera stands still, and the sky of a still view is drawn once and copied for up to 33 ms. At 1920x1080 the frame takes about 0.1 ms less (day street 1.13 to 1.01 ms), and the shadows are exactly the same as a redraw. NOT tried by hand: how the shorter reflection and sky refresh looks in motion, split screen, other cities.  [2026-11-10]

Moved the grass culling to the graphics card, so grass costs less. The picture is the same. It needs OpenGL 4.3 and falls back to the old drawing when the card lacks it. The frame takes 0.07 to 0.10 ms less (1080p day 1.08 to 1.00 ms). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Made far away level textures (distant walls, roads, hedges, trees) use one averaged sample instead of four mixed ones. They look a little softer, and the game runs faster: 0.06 to 0.17 ms less on every frame at 1080p, 5 to 12 percent. Colours, edges and water are the same, no flicker between frames in a driving test. The old look comes back with indexedMips=2 in config.ini. Pictures were compared at 1920x1080. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed the streetlight glow on the road at dusk being far too bright: lamps now fade in as the sun goes down and are at full strength at night, as before. Checked with pictures at five times of the evening and the dusk and dawn scenes, and tried by hand at 19:54 in Chicago.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed the street lamp glow vanishing in the early night: lamps now follow the square of the night amount (7 percent at sunset, 25 percent at -2 degrees of sun, full at night), and cut the traffic light pools on the road to about a third (smaller and weaker, colour kept). Looked at pictures at 19:00, 20:00, 20:45 and 21:00 in a street and at a junction. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]

Fixed the highway sign boards so the text shows, crisp, with the right arrow, day and night. The plain back of a board was drawn over the text on its front. A sign board model is now drawn as a front and a back, and the text side faces the road. Checked in pictures at four distances by day and night. NOT tried by hand at your ramp. The Goose Island hall keeps its old rule.  [2026-11-11]

Made the two big halls of the Auto Exchange lighter: red-brown brick with the windows showing instead of near black, every dark wall, end wall and roof face, also when you drive past. At night they look like the original night picture with the lit arches. The lighter pictures are made by the game from your own game data when the level loads, nothing of the disc is shipped, and the halls stay as they were if that fails. Checked with pictures only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Changed the Miami textured ground at night: the ground pictures use the night picture of the disc and the night class of the other models, so road and ground match at dusk and night. NOT tried by hand: pictures at 12:00, 20:30 and 22:30 on the dev PC.  [2026-11-14]

Added Anisotropic Filtering (Off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x) and Mipmaps (on, off) to Options > Graphics. They change at once, no restart. The cars and the level textures that go through the texture manager use them; 8x is the look from before. Checked with pictures and the option tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Added a Window Size row to Options > Graphics (1280x720, 1920x1080, 2560x1440, 3840x2160, Borderless) that changes the window at once, and a Car Shine row on the main Graphics page (the same value as Car Reflections: it scales the sky reflection and the sun glint of the car paint, 0 is matte). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Added Anti-Aliasing (MSAA) to Options > Graphics: Off, 2x, 4x, 8x (never more than the graphics card can do). The 3D picture is drawn into a multisampled buffer and resolved before FXAA, photo mode and the screen, so edges of buildings, cars and road lines get smooth. It changes at once, no restart, and is Off by default, so the picture and the game are the same as before. Checked with pictures (day, night, split screen), the tick hash and the picture tests with it Off, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Added a soft warm glow round the light poles on Goose Island and round the lamps in the two halls at night, like the street lamps have. It is gone by day. NOT tried by hand: only test scene pictures at 23:00 (apron, both halls, seen from outside).  [2026-11-14]

Added a Round Light Glow setting. Street lamps, signals and car lights glow in a round soft shape with a bright core, not a square picture. The glow is wider in rain and fog, and a far light stays a small bright dot. On in Extended Low and up, off in Classic. Only the picture changes. Checked by pictures and the tick hash, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Added a Lamp Light On Trees setting. At night the street lamps and signals now light trees, signs and the grass blades from every side. Before, a tree or the grass next to a lit road stayed black. On in Extended Low and up. Only the picture changes. Checked by pictures and the tick hash, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Lightened the big dark halls west of CatFlip's International Auto Exchange on Goose Island, the same way as the Exchange halls: red-brown brick with visible windows instead of near black, from the road and from far away. It is its own built-in pack (Goose Island Halls West), so the Exchange pack and your edits are not touched. 860 wall and roof faces, same +60 percent brightness set, the picture is made from your own game on the first load. NOT tried by hand, only looked at in pictures (street view, far view over the river); night not looked at. The dark halls further north (past z 227000) are still dark.  [2026-11-14]

Added an instant style switch: one key (F2, or both sticks on a pad) flips the running game between the Classic look and the Extended look with no loading screen, and back. It changes shadows, light glow, reflections, grass, anti-aliasing, the frame rate lock, how far the world is drawn and the far traffic layer. The simulation stays the same, so online only the picture changes. The HUD, the sky and the dynamic lights do not switch yet. New rows in Options > Graphics: Instant Style Switch and Style Switch Key. Checked by the tick hash tests and by pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Added the HUD, the painted sky, the Dynamic Lights option and the rain streak density to the instant style switch. Classic style shows the original HUD and the original painted sky (dark by the clock at night, it has no sunset colours or stars), your own HUD choice comes back on the next flip. The cause of the phase 1 hash difference was the option writer (it also reset the traffic numbers), not the HUD or the lights. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Calmed the round light glow: one strength setting (glowstrength, default 40 percent), much weaker by day so a traffic light is a small halo hugging the lamp and not a white blob, a modest glow at night and far lights fade out. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before. Only pictures and automatic tests ran, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Made far lights small points: the glow now shrinks and fades with distance, full inside 18 m, a faint dot at 140 m and nothing past about 250 m, and the smallest glow is 1 pixel and not 3. Two new tweaks glowdistnear and glowdistfar set the distances. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Split the light glow by light type: stoplights keep the calm new glow, street lamps and other lights are the original glow again, and car headlights glow a little more. New tweaks glowtraffic, glowlamps and glowheadlights (percent) tune each. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]
