Made the head plate of the Goose Island light poles follow the night: it is a dull lens by day and lights up at night with the street lamps (one new colour table entry, no rebuild of the pole data). Game builds, tick hash quick set 184 ok. Looked at pictures day and night, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]
Fixed the road grain that showed on the roof and bonnet of a car when Car Reflections was 0. NOT tried by hand, a picture test showed the grain gone.  [2026-11-15]

Added a Sky Picture option (Procedural or Painted original) under the Weather sky options: the original Driver 2 sky pictures can be chosen in the Extended style too, and the day clock keeps running. In 21 languages. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Tuned the day look of the Goose Island pole head plate to a dull brown (the first value matched what the world already shows by day). Pole pictures day and night are in the hub preview folder goose_pole_heads. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Made the exhaust pipes, the tail lamp glow and the Car's Own engine sounds part of the instant Classic / Extended switch: Classic turns them off, Extended brings your own setting back. The simulation does not change. NOT tried by hand, only automatic tests.  [2026-11-16]

Lightened the dark halls further north on the west bank of Goose Island, the same way as the Exchange halls and the west halls: red-brown brick with visible windows and roofs instead of near black. It is its own built-in pack (Goose Island Halls North), so the other two packs and your edits are not touched, and removing the folder brings the dark halls back. 3315 wall and roof faces, same +60 percent brightness set, the picture is made from your own game on the first load. Only the picture changes, the tick hash is equal with and without the pack. NOT tried by hand, only looked at in pictures: by day the change is clear from the street, from the east and from above, at night it is small, and from far over the river it is tiny.  [2026-11-16]

I fixed the black world when anti-aliasing (MSAA) is on together with a render scale under 100 percent (50 and 75 with 4x, 75 with 8x). The small world picture is blown up into the window sized scene with a scaling blit, and a scaling blit into the multisampled copy is refused by GL (error 0x502 every frame), so only the HUD showed. Now the blit goes into the plain scene texture and that is copied into the multisampled copy; scale 150 no longer logs the error either, and the cockpit mirror blit goes the same way. With MSAA off and at scale 100 nothing changed: the picture smoke set and the tick hash scenes come out the same as before my change. Checked by the pictures and the log on the second PC, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

I fixed the photo mode picture with MSAA 4x or 8x: the screenshot showed the plain world without the warm tone, the panel, the frame, the grid and the vignette. The screenshot read the scene texture before the multisampled copy was resolved into it. Screenshots and pixel probes resolve first now; the window picture itself was never wrong. Pictures with MSAA off, 4x and 8x now show the same overlay. Checked by pictures on the second PC, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Added a new option Far Glass Darken (Weather page, Sky). On it darkens the pale blue glass of far towers by day so they stop looking like a see-through box at the horizon. Off is the default and the picture stays the same as before. NOT tried by hand, only pictures and the automatic tests (tick hash and the picture set show no change with it off).  [2026-11-17]

Fixed cars that were drawn plain white or with wrong colours after a long session: the palette texture of the cars held 4095 rows and ran full, now it holds 16384. A car of another city whose page has no palette row is no longer built with the pedestrian palette. NOT tried by hand: no long online session, only a scripted run that fills the texture and parks the buses of Havana and Vegas (pictures before and after).  [2026-11-17]

Fixed online games drawing the world like a 6 player split screen. The draw distance, fog, ambient range and shadow size looked at the seats of the room, not at the one full view you see. Now the view is full detail like single player. NOT looked at by eye.  [2026-11-17]

Made the glow and flare of car head, tail and brake lights weaker and smaller by day and far away, so far cars no longer show big red blobs. Night looks the same as before. Checked by automatic tests only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Cops on foot are drawn as police officers now. The traffic stop officer and the roadblock cops used a civilian model of the Driv3r pedestrians, now they get one of 5 Driv3r police officers (run the setup again with the Driv3r disc to make them), or the Driver 2 officer when there are none. The Driver 2 officer also lost his uniform in a dense crowd, that is fixed too. Tried by pictures and tests, NOT by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Redrew the glow of traffic lights, head lamps, tail, brake, reverse and turn signal lamps: the lit lamp fills its whole lens, gets smaller and fainter with the distance, and has only a small soft halo that is much weaker by day. No more tiny pins for traffic lights by day, no star flares, no white hot cores. New option Lamp Lens Glow (Options > Graphics > Lighting, on by default): off gives the old round glow. Checked with before and after pictures (cars at 5, 15 and 40 m, signals at 5, 20 and 60 m, day, night and rain) and a unit test; Tried by hand in Chicago by day and at night: the lamps look good.  [2026-11-18]

Changed the exhaust smoke of cars to a soft grey puff that blends with the light: weaker at night and far away, no white hot spot with a star at the pipe. A new Soft Exhaust Smoke option (Options > Graphics > Lighting) brings the old puff back, and Classic keeps it. NOT tried by hand, only automatic pictures and tests.  [2026-11-18]
Not Hand Tested: Added depth of field to Photo Mode: set the aperture from f/1.4 to f/22 and what is out of focus blurs like a real lens.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Added focus to Photo Mode: keep your car sharp, focus on the middle of the view, or set the distance from 0.5 m to infinity, with a focus bracket on screen.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Added bokeh shapes to Photo Mode (circle, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, star) and a blur quality setting, the lens settings are saved in the presets.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Added a shutter speed to photo mode, 1/4000 s to 1 s. A slow shutter blurs what moves.  [2026-10-31]

Not Hand Tested: Added Photo Size 1x to 4x and a Sampling Quality that smooths edges in the saved photo. Big photos are drawn in tiles and written piece by piece, so they do not fill the memory.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Changed the bokeh shapes (hexagon, pentagon, star) to be clearly visible on bright lamps, and moved the focus bracket onto your car in car focus mode.  [2026-10-31]

Not Hand Tested: Added translations of the new photo mode texts (Shutter, Exposure Link, Sampling Quality, Photo Size and their tips) in all languages. They are machine translations, shortened so they fit the panel.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Changed the photo mode text in the README: it now describes the six panel tabs, aperture and focus, bokeh shapes, shutter speed, photo size up to 4x and the presets.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the Centre focus mode of photo mode for photos bigger than 1x: the sharp plane is now taken from the middle of the whole picture, not from each tile.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed dark shapes on the road in photos taken at 3x and 4x size.  [2026-10-31]
Not Hand Tested: Changed the bokeh so lamps keep their shape, even small far lamps and traffic lights.  [2026-10-31]

Not Hand Tested: Shortened four photo preset tab names so they fit the tab (French, Greek, Hungarian, Portuguese) and wrote the photo mode section of the README, with every tab and row and the saved picture size.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Gave roads and sidewalks a fine surface grain from real asphalt and concrete pictures, with a new option Road Surface Grain (0 to 100, off in Classic and Low). Rain drops make a small crown on hard ground and rings on puddles.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Made the 3D grass reach the kerb of the sidewalk, so no blade shows on the sidewalk or the road. Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and the Driver 1 cities.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Brightened the street lamp pools at night, made traffic lights cast red, amber and green light on the road, weakened the moon shadows and darkened tree sprites at night.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Added sidewalk roughness to low concrete and stone walls, like the lake side wall of Michigan Ave.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Added blood for pedestrians that are run over: a few droplets, a pool on the road that grows and fades, and a smear where the body slides. New option Blood (Off, Low, Full, default Low). No gore.  [2026-11-02]
Not Hand Tested: Added FXAA, an edge smoothing of the 3D picture that runs before the HUD, so the map, gauges and text stay sharp. Off in Classic and Low, on from Medium.  [2026-11-02]

Not Hand Tested: Put the particle limits of smoke, sparks, debris, leaves and blood behind the graphics preset: Low 40 percent of the original limits, Medium 70, High and Classic 100, Max 150.  [2026-11-02]
Not Hand Tested: Added a Brightness setting (Graphics, 50 to 150 percent) that makes the whole picture lighter or darker with one post pass, off at 100 percent.  [2026-11-03]

Not Hand Tested: Added a faint glow on the street lamps and the stop lights from the moment the evening sky turns orange (sun about 7 degrees above the horizon), growing smoothly to the full night glow. The evening no longer looks flat at 8 PM.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the gas station zones, and added the same for the repair pad: a flat pad on the ground that follows the road, with a pulsing ring, chevrons, a light pillar and a turning marker. Every player sees it in his own view.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed the sun shadow of cars on ramps below the street, on bridges and on high ground: it lay far to the side or was missing, and now sits under the car. The shadow body used the wrong height and turn.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the car photos: the game takes them in the real Chicago street now, in daylight with a low camera, and the car fills most of the picture, 1024 by 640, with the washed out sepia look on top. All 1522 cars, 53 MB.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: I added a cross-fade to the style switch: when you flip between Classic and Extended (F2, both sticks on a pad, or the console), the old picture stays on the screen and fades out over the new look in a quarter of a second. It is a copy of the last picture of the old style that is blended over the new one at the end of the frame, so nothing changes in the game itself (tick hash: city0, night0, rain0 and the six flipping style0 scenarios equal their baselines; the style100 scenarios show the same hash as before my change) and nothing is drawn or allocated while no flip is running. It works with MSAA 4x and with the render scale at 75 and 150 (no GL error). New row Options > Graphics > Effects > Style Switch Fade (on by default, off flips at once), in all 21 languages. NOT tried by hand: I looked at pictures of 0, 60, 120 and 250 ms and ran the log checks; the real feel and the first flip (the shader compiles then) still need a person.  [2026-11-16]

sections.title: Weather and Sky
lines: Changed the fog to fade into the colour of the painted horizon, and the water reflections to show the painted sky.  [2026-10-14]

Changed the day clock to whole milliseconds, it drifted by up to 207 game seconds in 3 days before. The day clock settings (sunrise, sunset, start hour, day length, city dawn and dusk) are whole numbers too and the start hour is exact now.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed rain missing in the Classic, Classic: Extended and Extended Low presets, their rain row is now 15, 15 and 20.  [2026-10-23]
Changed day to turn into night smoothly. There is no Smooth Night setting any more, it is always on.  [2026-10-26]

Changed street lamps, lit signs and lamps of Havana and Vegas, the lighting of the world, pedestrians, car lights, the lamps of other traffic, the traffic light glow and the police lights to come on little by little with the dark.  [2026-10-26]
Gave each city its own night level (light.nightlevel), so the Driver 1 cities keep their bright look and the old light schedule with the smooth night.  [2026-10-26]
Changed rain to fall at about the speed of real rain, new rainSpeed setting, 170 is the default and 100 is the old slower speed.  [2026-10-26]
Added big puffy clouds to the sky, cumulus heaps lit by the sun, orange at dusk and dim at night, and made them a little less bright.  [2026-10-28]
Added dynamic weather, an option Dynamic Weather, storm clouds roll in, it rains, the storm passes and the sky clears, with console commands weather skip and status.  [2026-10-28]
Added banks of fog every third spell, the fog pulls in grey and the sky turns milky.  [2026-10-28]
Added lightning with jagged bolts, the flash lights the clouds, the screen and the street, thunder comes after the delay of the distance, console command weather strike.  [2026-10-28]
Added puddles along both kerbs from kerb data in the level files, with some in the middle of the road and on the sidewalk, and a splash when a wheel drives through.  [2026-10-28]
Added storm fronts and cloud decks, rain that comes in waves, puddles that stay and dry slowly and a dark horizon fog.  [2026-10-28]
Changed the light, the sun and the wet road to follow the clouds gradually.  [2026-10-28]
Added a scripted weather show for testing (console: weather show).  [2026-10-28]
Fixed the clouds and the weather moving on while the game is paused, they stand still and carry on when you resume, and a pause or customizer picture always starts under the same sky.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed lightning and thunder that kept going while the game was paused: a storm no longer strikes or rumbles on the frames drawn in the pause menu.  [2026-10-30]
Replaced the storm sounds: 7 near and 19 far thunder recordings, street rain and made wind loops instead of the old pack. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Changed rain, wind and thunder to play from mp3 and WAV files in stereo on their own voices, so they no longer crush the rain sound or take the engine voices. The wind follows the storm with gusts and is quieter. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Reworked the fog: the sky, clouds, far buildings and far road run into one solid fog colour, the sun fades out in thick fog, and slow fog banks cover wide areas of the city. Lamps and lights get a halo in fog. The level is set with the console command weather fog. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Changed the storm sounds to play the recordings as they are, with near thunder at full volume and no distance fade. Removed the window rain layer, it sounded like a drain. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Reworked the fog banks and the fog scale: the fog level sets a base fog over the whole city and the banks are wide denser areas on top, so there are no more single pockets. The scale 0 to 100 is gradual at the low end: 1 is 8 km of view, 30 is 600 m, 100 is 30 m, and 0 is off.  [2026-11-01]
Made the fog banks cheaper to draw: at 4K the fog 60 cost over a clear sky fell from 0.5 ms to 0.1 ms. The fog pictures stay the same.  [2026-11-01]
Fixed the rain sound being squashed and clipped at heavy rain. The rain stays under full scale and only one rain loop is loud at a time. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]
Fixed the weather after a restart or a replay. It kept the rain, the wet road, the weather clock and a forced preset of the old game. It now starts like a fresh level.  [2026-11-02]
Made the weather plan the same on every PC, so the rain starts and stops at the same time and the grip matches. The look is the same.  [2026-11-02]
Fixed a memory leak in the weather sound: the rain and thunder voices are freed when a level ends.  [2026-11-02]

Added Weather Changes (Off, Rare, Normal, Often: how many days have storms) and Storm Strength (Light, Normal, Heavy) to the weather plan. Normal and Normal are the plan as it was, any other pair is part of the replay fingerprint. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand: the other levels were not played.  [2026-11-03]

Added a Rain Visibility slider to the Weather page of the pause menu, from nearly invisible up to the brighter rain of before. The normal setting is the dimmer look you have now. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Rebuilt the light reflections on the wet road like the original game: every tail light, brake light, headlight, street lamp and traffic light gets a thin strip of its own colour running towards you.  [2026-11-05]
Took the narrow streaks of the street lamps off the wet road and gave every street lamp one large soft flood of light instead.  [2026-11-06]

Added rain drops on the windscreen in the hood view and the cockpit view (experimental, off by default, on hold). The drops appear, grow, merge and run down in streaks, the airflow of a fast car pushes the small ones up and out, the wipers sweep by themselves in hard rain, and the glass dries in about ten seconds after the rain. At night the drops catch the headlights and passing lamps. New option Weather > Windscreen Rain (Off, Low, Normal, High, default Off), in all languages. It is only a picture effect, the game itself does not change. The third person and bumper views draw nothing, and there is no snow in the game. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Put the windscreen rain on hold: it is off by default now. In my hand check the drops looked like cartoons and ran into the cabin, and the cockpit view it needs is on hold too. The option stays in Options as an experimental setting.  [2026-11-08]

Made the weather sound follow where you are: the rain is quieter and duller in a closed car (cockpit view) with a soft tap on the roof. The wind now also grows with your speed (more in the open and the chase view, less behind glass). Thunder gets quieter and duller with distance. The dips under a bridge or overpass and in a tunnel are EXPERIMENTAL: no verified tunnel or overpass spot was found in Chicago, so they are not proven. Checked by automatic tests. NOT heard by ear yet, and the city ambience beds (harbour, park, downtown) are NOT made yet.  [2026-11-08]

Added one wind for the whole picture: it slants the rain, bends trees, bushes and grass in gusts and turns the clouds. Gave every weather its own light (overcast, storm, haze, golden hour, dust, snow, blizzard, smog, freezing fog, tropical) and made weathers blend into each other over game minutes, through light rain where a jump would look wrong. Console: wind, weather look, weather transition. Clear weather and the old presets look the same as before. NOT tried by hand, only pictures and automatic tests. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Added slippery roads: water, snow, packed snow and ice build up and melt with the weather, and the tyres of every car (yours, traffic, cops) grip less on them. Full brake from 50 km/h takes 1.2 times the dry distance on snow, 1.5 on packed snow and 2 on ice (Mild); 1.5, 2 and 3.2 times (Realistic). Traffic drives slower, brakes earlier and follows farther, fewer people walk outside in storms and frost. It stays off while the new weather variety is off, so the old rain stays as it was. Checked by unit test, brake and traffic tests, 5 tick hash scenarios equal to before. NOT tried by hand; ice may jam the traffic. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Added the look of snow: one amount whitens roofs, hoods, boots, ground and grass by the way they face, walls stay clear, car windows stay clear, trees, bushes and grass blades are loaded with snow from the top, flakes fall round the view (light, heavy, blizzard), the light turns a little cool, the night snow glows a little, and your car leaves wheel tracks in it. It costs nothing when no snow lies. Nothing starts it yet (a console command and a test switch only), the weather will drive it later. NOT tried by hand; the snow caps as boxes on cars and roofs are not done. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Reworked the look of snow so it has form: the sun lights it (warm on the sunny side, blue in the shade, orange at a low sun), drifts and ridges catch the light, it glints a little, thick snow shades blue and it is never pure white. Dusting, settled and deep snow now look clearly different. Flakes are soft and round, a few big ones drift close to the lens. Trees and grass are loaded in clumps. Every moving car, traffic and cops too, now ploughs a path through the snow, a groove with a ridge of loose snow on both sides. NOT tried by hand; snow caps on cars and roofs, ruts on busy roads and slush spray are not done. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Made snow flakes drift down wind with the weather wind, the same wind that bends the rain, trees and grass. Nothing changes while the wind is calm. NOT tried by hand, only pictures of the snow scenes. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-14]

Fixed rain in split screen when the players are far apart: every view keeps its own picture of asphalt and concrete (the wet road grain flickered between the views before) and every view decides by itself if a puddle mirrors the world. Tick hash unchanged. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Changed the Classic style sky to the original Driver 2 sky pictures. With the day clock running it now shows the real orange sunset at dusk, the original night sky and the original rain sky, not one darkened day picture. The day and rain looks are unchanged. The picture switches at once when the clock crosses to the next one, no fade. NOT tried by hand, only checked by the automatic tests and pictures. Dawn not looked at.  [2026-11-15]

I moved the light of every weather (flat grey overcast, dark blue storm, warm haze, golden hour, dusty orange dust, grey yellow smog, snow, blizzard, freezing fog, tropical) out of the code into a plain text file, maps/weatherlooks.txt in the Core pack. Modders can edit it, or ship a file of the same name in a mod and list only the looks they change. A missing file or a bad row falls back to the built-in numbers and is logged once. With the shipped file nothing looks different. Tested by machine with a unit test and the tick hash of the weather scenarios, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Not Hand Tested: Made roads and sidewalks wet from the rain history: the water fills while it rains and dries slowly, so a downpour stays wet longer than a shower. Wet surfaces turn darker and richer, show a fine grain, and the nearest lamps and car lights draw streaks on them.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Tuned the drying of wet roads: a short shower dries in about 2.5 minutes, a heavy storm in about 9. The road grain can be turned off, and it is off in the Classic and Low presets.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Made rain splashes on foot the same as in a car, and made the wet road look grow with the water from about 20 percent up.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Gave wet roads and sidewalks a glossy sheen that grows with the wetness: the sky shows in the film of water, more at a low view angle, with sun glare and wider light streaks. Grass and dirt stay dry.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Reworked the light streaks on wet roads at night: the white headlight haze and the long red smears across junctions are gone and the streaks are narrower.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Built weather presets: eight presets (clear, foggy morning, light, medium and heavy rain, light and heavy storm, rolling fog) strung into storms that last hours. Every day starts and ends clear and the weather never jumps from clear to a heavy storm.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Dimmed the rain streaks so the rain is a faint texture in the air and not white lines. The weather sounds are replaced with sounds the project owns.  [2026-11-04]
Not Hand Tested: Added a soft, blurry reflection of the sky and the buildings on wet roads and sidewalks. New option Wet Road Blur, next to Wet Road Reflections.  [2026-11-06]
Not Hand Tested: Took the focused light streaks under the street lamps off the wet road. The lamps keep their big aura and the car lights keep their soft strips.  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Added 19 new weathers: partly cloudy, overcast, hazy heat, golden hour, light mist, dense fog, city smog, drizzle, rain showers, after rain, night thunderstorm, tropical downpour, dust storm, light snow, snow, heavy snow, sleet, freezing fog and after snow. Every city got a climate with an air temperature through the day: Chicago and New York snow, Las Vegas gets dust, Havana, Rio and Miami get tropical downpours, Frisco gets fog. The new option Weather Variety plays them (on by default, off keeps the old eight weathers as before). NOT tried by hand, only unit tests, log checks and pictures. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Connected the new weathers to the road grip: with Weather Variety on, rain, snow, air temperature and fog of the weather feed the road surface model, so snow, ice and slush change how the cars grip. NOT tried by hand, only log checks and tick hash runs that are the same twice. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Connected the new weathers to the light, the wind and the snow: with Weather Variety on every weather gets its light grade (overcast, storm, haze, golden, dust, snow, blizzard, smog, freezing fog, tropical), its wind speed and direction, and the snow on the ground and in the air follows the snow of the weather. Snow melts through a slush weather. With Weather Variety off nothing changes. NOT tried by hand, only log checks, same-twice tick hash runs and 16 new pictures. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

sections.title: Sound and Music
lines: Changed Driver 1 cars to keep the Driver 2 sound for a light hit, the Driver 1 sample was the steel barrier clang.  [2026-10-14]
Changed the Driver 1 crash sounds to play about 10 dB louder, they were too quiet next to Driver 2.  [2026-10-15]
Fixed far away sounds wrapping around to loud and near, they are quiet or silent now.  [2026-10-19]
Added music to the main menu, it plays in a loop until a game starts.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the menu music to fade out by itself while a game loads.  [2026-10-21]
Raised the sound to 32 voices and gave the effects 24 channels instead of 16, so more sounds can play at once. The music moved to the upper voices.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed players 5 to 8 driving without engine sound and engines in games with more than 4 players.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed the tyre skid sound of players 3 and 4 missing.  [2026-10-22]

Changed the sound code to decode each sample once instead of at every key-on, which removes the 5 to 6 ms hitches when a long engine loop starts (checked by ear: the sounds are unchanged).  [2026-10-23]

Fixed damaged tracker music files making the player read past its 24 channel states, past the data of a pattern, or behind an instrument cut short by the end of a song, so a damaged song can no longer read outside its tables.  [2026-10-24]
Changed a song whose order list names a missing pattern to stop instead of crashing.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed far away sounds going silent from a long way off, they now fade out slowly with the distance.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed short looping sounds clicking at high pitch.  [2026-10-27]
Added rain, wind and thunder recordings mixed by the weather intensity, near and far thunder. They are placeholders, they will be swapped for sounds with a cleared licence.  [2026-10-28]

Added Options > Sound > Output Device. The sound follows the Windows default device when it changes (headphones, Bluetooth) and moves to another device without a restart. Each run gets its own entry in the Windows Volume Mixer. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]
Made the weather sound lighter: the rain and gale loops load when first needed, the next thunder loads only while it storms, and after 45 seconds of calm they are released.  [2026-11-01]

Changed the rain to play the sound clips as they are again. The tamed rain copy dipped the whole sound 13 times a second by 3 dB and more, and the low cut took the body out of it. Low cut and drop softening now default to off, and a loud mix lowers the gain by one flat factor.  [2026-11-01]
Fixed car engine and crash sounds not loading when no mod has its own sound list. The game now also reads the one in its base content, below all mods. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-03]
Changed the Sound tab of the customizer to show the car behind each engine sound, and the find box finds a sound by its cars. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Put the engine sounds of the customizer into folders (Gran Turismo 1, Gran Turismo 2, Driver 1, Driver 2, one per mod), closed until you open them.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the tracker music player reading past its instrument tables when a note comes before any instrument. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Made the slow weather sound timers (gusts, release of unused sounds, preview storm) run in real seconds at the 25 Hz PAL option too. At 30 Hz nothing changes. NOT tried by hand, NOT listened to at 25 Hz.  [2026-11-07]

Gave the planes and the helicopter their own engine sounds, made by the program itself (no recordings). The plane has a propeller engine that rises in pitch and volume with the throttle, a wind rush that grows with speed and a stall beep. The helicopter has a rotor thump that speeds up with the rotor and a turbine whine. They fade out when you bail out, leave or crash, and a plane that flies on without you is heard from far away, quieter the further it goes. NOT heard by ear yet, only the loops and the logic are checked.  [2026-11-08]
Fixed the car sound names list: a file whose size cannot be read no longer leads to a huge read. Checked by building the game only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the wait when a mission or level ends: the game stopped the 24 sound channels one at a time and waited a screen refresh after each, about 0.37 seconds every time. Now it stops them all and waits once, 0.01 ms. A voice that does not stop at once is asked again once per refresh and not in a tight loop. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]
The package and the setup now carry the pre-made radio station reD2ex Radio (20 mp3 files, about 121 MB), and the radio readme says so. The package itself is not built yet.  [2026-11-10]

Set the Your Engine volume to start at 120 percent (it was 180). A saved setting is kept. The slider goes to 250 and the sound can not go above full level. Checked by a console test of the default and the limits. NOT tried by ear.  [2026-11-10]

Lowered the near thunder claps by 4.4 dB (gain 1.0 to 0.6) so the rain mix no longer clips at 100 percent master volume. Two near claps on top of the rain and engine reached full scale (peak 32767) before; the sound check now peaks at about 29000 at 100 percent. Far claps, rain, wind and the skid loop are unchanged. Checked by the automatic sound level test only, NOT tried by ear: the thunder may now feel a bit softer.  [2026-11-13]

Added Options > Sound > Engine Sounds: City Default (as before) or Car's Own. With Car's Own a car from another city (a Havana car in Chicago traffic) plays the engine of its own make, read from the game's sound file when it first shows up. Mod cars, Driver 1 cars and Gran Turismo cars keep their own sounds. Checked in the log, NOT tried by ear.  [2026-11-14]

Made the helicopter turbine whine softer: the thin high tones are weaker, the pitch tops out lower and the loop is about 4 dB quieter at full rotor speed. NOT tried by ear, only the made loop and its tests were measured.  [2026-11-14]

Added the song title under the station name on a station with DJs and ads, shown for a few seconds when each new song starts. NOT tried by hand, the radio plays plain mp3s in this release.  [2026-11-14]

Removed the driver1music option from config.ini and the game. The Driver 1 cities already play their own songs, and there is no Driver 1 music file on the disc that Disc Install could convert. Built, the release config check passes, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Added music for the Driver 1 cities (Frisco, LA, Miami, New York): they play the CD audio tracks that Disc Install made from the Driver 1 PC disc, one after the other, instead of Driver 2 songs. No new option: City Music = Default plays the tracks, a song picked in City Music still plays that song, and the Driver 2 cities are unchanged. Which city starts on which track is a first guess in music/d1music.txt. Checked by a hidden run that moved on from track to track; NOT listened to by ear.  [2026-11-17]

Not Hand Tested: Added a Weather Mixer page to the pause menu (Options, Sound) with sliders for rain, wind, thunder, how far rain quiets engines and traffic, the mission music and a master weather volume, plus Reset To Defaults. The main menu does not have it yet.  [2026-11-01]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the rain, wind and radio sounds going on in the main menu after you quit a game.  [2026-11-03]
Not Hand Tested: Lowered the click sounds of the main menu so they are no louder than the menu music.  [2026-11-03]

Not Hand Tested: Added a Master Volume (Sound) that scales the sound effects, the music, the radio and the weather sounds together, 100 percent keeps the old mix. The Weather Mixer lost its double Music row.  [2026-11-03]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the main menu music to my new track (main_menu_music_4). The game plays it from the menu folder and falls back to the old track if it is missing; the release package ships the new one.  [2026-11-07]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the engine sound of a car staying the old one after a car swap in the customizer. A Driver 2 car no longer keeps a Gran Turismo engine.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added radio station scheduling for modders. A station folder with a station.txt plays a live format clock: songs, station idents, DJ talk over the song intro or the end (the song gets quieter and comes back), ad breaks with a sting, call-ins, news and weather lines that fit the hour, the weather, the city and a police chase. A rain or chase starting pulls a matching line to the next gap, never in the middle of speech. The shipped station stays a plain random playlist for now; DJs and ads for it come later. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests ran, with beeps instead of real voices.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Added the texts of the radio station options (Talk Segments, Ads, Call-ins, Lots and their help lines) in all 21 languages. The options show up only when a scheduled radio station is installed. Machine translated, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Added programme blocks to the radio station scheduling for modders. A station.txt can set dayparts by game hour (morning show, drive time, night), each with its own clock, preferred voices and ad density, and specials that switch on with the weather or a police chase and bring more weather and bulletin lines. The radio never goes silent: when no talk line fits it plays a song, then an ident, and a file it cannot read is skipped. The same voice does not repeat a kind of line. Console: radio why and radio why silence explain a choice or a silent radio. The shipped station stays a plain random playlist for now. NOT tried by hand: unit tests and one game run with beeps only.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the radio station options on Options > Sound to three rows without a heading of their own: Radio: Talk Segments, Radio: Ads, Radio: Call-ins (Ads and Call-ins show in the Advanced view), so the Sound page stays inside its row limit. They show only when a scheduled radio station is installed. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-13]
Not Hand Tested: Stopped the log from warning about Driver 1 sounds when Driver 1 is not installed. NOT tried by hand, only the unit test ran.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Switched the sound output limiter on in every case, so a mix that goes past full scale (engine, rain and thunder together) is squeezed softly instead of cut hard. Quiet sound is not changed. NOT tried by ear.  [2026-11-15]

Not Hand Tested: Added a short click when the style flips between Classic and Extended. It is the game's own door close sound, a bit lower for Classic, played through the normal sound path so the master volume applies and it is silent when the sound is off. New row Options > Sound > Style Switch Sound (on by default), in all 21 languages. The simulation does not change: the 7 style tick hash scenarios stay equal. NOT heard, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

sections.title: Menus and Interface
lines: Changed Take A Ride in the main menu into one list of all eight cities, with a time of day to pick. Added the texts in all languages.  [2026-10-14]
Added a Camera Views option to choose which of the 12 views the camera button cycles, default 3rd person, bumper and hood.  [2026-10-14]
Fixed the on-foot camera view being kept as the car's view when you get in, and a saved view that is not on your list now moves on to one that is.  [2026-10-14]
Gave photo mode and the customizer a mouse pointer, and fixed the photo mode strafe going the wrong way.  [2026-10-15]
Fixed backslashes lost in some texts: the mission translation file name and the console and editor help texts.  [2026-10-19]

Added a Minimap Style row to Options, Display: Round (the default) or Square like the original map box. The square style has straight damage and felony bars and is also used in the split screen minimaps.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed the picture of the square minimap not filling the whole frame, a pale gap showed on the left.  [2026-10-20]
Added a Minimap Size % row (50 to 120, default 85) that scales the square minimap with its labels, markers and bars.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed choosing a game mode in the pause menu. Added a Game Modes submenu to the pause menu for this.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the popup messages to show up for players 3 and up too.  [2026-10-21]
Added Players to the pause menu Game Modes, it restarts the game with the number of players you pick.  [2026-10-21]
Changed Take A Ride to let you choose the number of players with Square.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the Controls list so it shows the 12 local play sources with the right labels.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the pause menu in 3 and 4 player games to a modern menu over the whole window, with Game Modes and Options in the multiplayer pause menu.  [2026-10-21]
Added a car row to Take A Ride that you change with L1 and R1.  [2026-10-21]
Added a new main menu background, an ultrawide picture.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the idle demo to start after 3 minutes 15 seconds so the menu music plays through.  [2026-10-21]
Added Demos: you can record a drive from the pause menu and play it back.  [2026-10-21]
Added Watch A Demo, it plays recorded drives without running the simulation, your own demos are picked up from the demos folder.  [2026-10-21]
Added five demo drives (Chicago day and night, Havana, Rio, Las Vegas) that play when the main menu sits idle.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the split screen HUD text to be readable at 720p and below, small labels are left out when the view is tiny.  [2026-10-22]
Added a profile row for every local player to the Multiplayer menu, and Options > Controls > Local Players > Profile for player 1.  [2026-10-22]
Added a profile manage screen where you rename and delete a profile and pick the start car of a player seat.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the HUD to draw faster: the shapes and text are remembered between frames and the HUD goes to the card without copies.  [2026-10-23]
Made the fuel HUD stop looking for the nearest station on every frame.  [2026-10-23]
Added a Water Brightness option (Options, Display, 25 to 200 percent, also the console command water) that scales the sea and the water shine, in all languages.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the console text being drawn with the minimap picture.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the Start button in the car picker to choose the last used car, then the car of each player who is ready (Same as player N).  [2026-10-23]
Added a find box to the customizer Car and Sound lists.  [2026-10-24]
Changed the customizer scroll bar to be draggable.  [2026-10-24]
Changed the Lights and Exhaust tabs of the customizer to take mouse clicks.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the classic and square minimap drawing the map picture over your dot, the target pointer and the cop and waypoint markers.  [2026-10-24]
Changed the classic minimap to follow the Minimap Size % setting, with the bottom right corner kept, and it keeps the original Driver 2 size at the default 85.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed a crash when typing a key that the name entry list does not have.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the console text being cut off on the left in a wide window, the panel now sits in the 4:3 picture.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the version line of the classic pause menu running off the screen.  [2026-10-24]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the car choice for a single player game: the main menu picture is the background now, the car sits in a sepia photo of the city, held like the photo of the vanilla screen, and the list on the right has the car name, the year and class and Previous, Select and Next. Works with keys, pad, mouse and the wheel, and fits 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added a car list to the car choice of Take A Ride: tabs for All, Driver 2, Driver 1, GT1, GT2 and Mods, the cars of a tab on the red bar with a scroll bar, a Default entry on top. Up and Down, Page Up and Down, Home and End, Left and Right for the tabs, the wheel and the mouse work, and typing letters jumps to the first car with that name (Ctrl+F filters). The photo follows the highlight. A car that is not a Driver 2 car becomes the start car.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Added Weather Variety (on or off), Weather Mode (Dynamic or Fixed) and a Weather Now list of every weather to the weather options. Weather Now blends the new weather in over a few seconds and holds it. Snow is left out of the list in cities that do not have snow. All texts are in the 21 languages. NOT tried by hand, only the options row tests and the loc check. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed Hide HUD being on after the first start, and set one standard default configuration. A demo no longer leaves the HUD hidden, an old tweaks.ini with Hide HUD on is put right once, and Reset All Options now asks first and really resets the options. NOT tried by hand, only automatic tests ran.  [2026-11-13]

Not Hand Tested: Moved the voice chat settings to their own Voice Chat page, opened from one row on the Sound page, so Sound is short again. The help lines of Voice Mode and Voice Position are shorter in all 21 languages. The Room tools page of an online room scrolls with Up and Down when the window is too short for its 15 rows (4:3), in 16:9 it looks as before. NOT tried by hand: only the options unit test, the picture scenes and the automatic checks ran.  [2026-11-15]

Not Hand Tested: Brought the Replays page into the current game. It works with every replay file the game writes now (older ones and the newer ones with the key and tyre trailers), and Rename and Delete only touch plain .D2RP files of the replays folder, never a path or another kind of file. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

sections.title: Multiplayer and Controllers
lines: Changed the radio buttons to come only from your bindings, so the shoulder buttons no longer change the station when they are bound to something else.  [2026-10-14]

Changed the keyboard to be able to be player 2 again, and a keyboard now counts as a connected pad, so the Multiplayer menu works without two pads. The first version was a Keyboard Plays As row, the pause menu Controllers below replaced it.  [2026-10-19]
Changed every split screen view to draw the whole modern world: the whole map, the sky and the cars. This fixed the freeze when players drive far apart.  [2026-10-19]
Put traffic in every split screen game.  [2026-10-19]
Changed every key set and gamepad to be givable to player 1, player 2 or nobody from the pause menu Controllers, with a second WASD key set so two people can share a keyboard.  [2026-10-19]
Gave every split screen player the modern HUD with a P1 or P2 tag, speed, rev arc, gear and damage.  [2026-10-19]
Gave every split screen view its own minimap, and one player missions in the multiplayer region use the round map picture.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed split screen frames being stretched like menu frames on a wide window, and split screen cutting off the HUD and the sides of the world.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed the game only looking at the first three players when it works out which car belongs to which player, and players without a car no longer count.  [2026-10-20]
Changed the police to work with several players: the cops chase the nearest wanted player, pick a new one when he is no longer wanted, and every cop locks onto one player.  [2026-10-20]
Gave every player his own fuel tank, every car burns fuel and can run dry.  [2026-10-20]
Changed the split screen HUD to show each player's own wanted bar and fuel gauge, and moved the clock to the divider.  [2026-10-20]
Gave every player his own wallet, mission pay goes to every human player.  [2026-10-20]
Changed the controller layer to handle 8 pads and four keyboard sets (arrows, WASD, IJKL, numpad), any player's pad can open the pause menu.  [2026-10-20]
Added 3 and 4 player split screen: players 3 and 4 start in rows behind the first two cars and every player gets a quarter of the window, traffic is built around every player in turn.  [2026-10-20]
Gave players 3 and 4 their own HUD in their quarter: tag, minimap with the other players, speed, damage, wanted bar, fuel and clock.  [2026-10-20]
Added bot players: any player slot can be driven by the traffic AI and still counts as a normal player with cops, fuel and money.  [2026-10-20]
Added a panel at the top of each quarter that shows the officer, CB or job offer of that player to accept or decline.  [2026-10-20]
Added the Checkpoint Race game mode for several players, with a waypoint arrow in every view and a pause menu entry that starts and stops it.  [2026-10-20]
Added the Survival game mode with its own pause menu entry.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed the cars of players 3 and 4 holding the handbrake.  [2026-10-20]
Added the Cops 'n' Robbers game mode: two rounds, the teams swap, points count.  [2026-10-21]
Added the Capture the Flag game mode: two teams, bases on the roads, first to 3 captures.  [2026-10-21]
Added the Gate Race and Trail Blazer game modes.  [2026-10-21]
Changed every game mode to pay prize money and end with a results panel.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed vibration so it works on every pad, not only the first two.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed 3 and 4 player games showing the original health bars in every quarter when the classic HUD option was off, they always get the split HUD now.  [2026-10-21]
Changed the empty fourth quarter of a three player game to show the standings of the running game mode and the clock.  [2026-10-21]
Added a Face Buttons setting (by label or by position) for Nintendo style pads, in Pause, Controllers and in Options, Controls.  [2026-10-21]

Added Players and Game Mode rows to the Multiplayer menu, so you choose how many players and which mode before the game starts. The menu opens with just one pad or the keyboard, it no longer needs two pads.  [2026-10-21]

Changed the Multiplayer menu to a Local page for 2 to 8 players, where the car picker shows for every player at once with a ready flag and a 15 second start. The Online row is shown greyed out and says coming in this version.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the second player not being able to get out of the car in a multiplayer game; a running game mode still keeps the doors locked.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the players a mission start leaves behind (players 3 and 4 started from the Take A Ride menu), they are put beside player 1.  [2026-10-21]
Added split screen for 5 to 8 players, the views are laid out in a grid and the HUD scales to fit.  [2026-10-21]
Added a car picker with filters, a letter jump, Random and favourites for each profile, it works with a long list of cars.  [2026-10-21]
Added profiles for each local player: you can list, create, rename and delete them, pick one per player seat, or play as Guest.  [2026-10-21]
Changed money and career (respect) to belong to each player's profile, switching a profile loads its own.  [2026-10-21]
Added tyre tracks, tyre smoke and car effects for the players 3 to 8 of a split screen.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the car picker to wrap around at the ends of the list, and Random picks evenly among the cars shown.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the car picker to work for up to 8 players at once, with ready flags, a 15 second start, bots, a brand quick key and a choice of which sources the cars come from.  [2026-10-22]
Changed deleting a profile to move its folder to saves/_deleted instead of erasing it, a profile another player uses can't be deleted.  [2026-10-22]
Changed volumes, sound and police settings and high scores to belong to the machine, not to the profile.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the start car to belong to each profile, every player seat starts in the car of its own profile.  [2026-10-22]

Added the first online play code: a check that both games match, Host game and Join by address with a lobby (room, seats, car picker, ready, START), and an online wallet. The Online row is shown greyed out and says coming in this version, it is early test code.  [2026-10-22]
Added a shared CB radio package run for 2 or more players. The private CB package offers are gone when two players or more are in the city.  [2026-10-22]
Changed the shared package offer to show up on the CB radio of every player with their own distance and direction, and the offer popup goes away when somebody takes the package.  [2026-10-22]
Added message lines for the shared package (joined, loading, too late, carries, lost, stolen, delivered, failed).  [2026-10-22]
Added a panel line for the shared package for every view (distance and time, loading, deliver with the pay, who has the package, package down).  [2026-10-22]

Added the Courier game mode, shared package runs back to back for eight minutes for 2 to 8 players, scored by dollars delivered, in the pause menu Game Modes and the Multiplayer mode list; the CB radio has to be on.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed the minimap of a split screen view that was never drawn, so the minimaps of the 5 player split screen look right.  [2026-10-25]
Changed profiles to 8 slots, one for every local player, players 5 to 8 were guests before.  [2026-10-28]

Added a Nintendo Switch Pro pad profile, the face buttons are picked automatically and the hints show the printed letters. NOT tried by hand: only tried with a virtual pad, no real Switch Pro pad has been used.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed the pause menu of players 3 to 8, it is now only driven by the pad of the player who opened it.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed unplugging pad 1 handing player 1 to pad 2, the pad slots now stay where they were.  [2026-10-29]
Changed replays and online rooms to refuse cars with different physics sheets or another realism setting.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed the two player split screen: the top view could lose its road and its car and show only the sky, because the picture of the bottom view was not cut off at its edge.  [2026-10-30]

Changed the multiplayer car picker screen to a solid dark background with a black title bar and a blue footer bar for the help text, and hid the version text on it. Tested In-Game: Functioning  [2026-11-01]

Fixed the start of 3 to 8 local players in split screen: every player gets a spot of his own along the road, two cars side by side, the next rows behind, and a spot too far from the road or too close to another car moves on.  [2026-11-02]
Added a car picture to the multiplayer car picker: every player's cell shows the highlighted car on top. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Changed the car choice of local multiplayer to the same list as the customizer: one row per car family, no hidden cars. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Added a MODERN control for walking on foot in the third person view: the left stick walks the way the camera looks (a light push walks, a full push runs, circle sprints), the character turns round in about a third of a second, the right stick turns the camera, the camera swings softly behind you when you leave it alone, and L1 held makes you face the camera and strafe. New options On-Foot Control Style (Automatic, Modern, Classic), On-Foot Camera Speed and Invert Look Up/Down in Options > Controls, in all languages. Automatic uses MODERN with a gamepad and keeps the old tank control with the keyboard; Classic is exactly as before; the first person view is unchanged. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with a real gamepad or keyboard.  [2026-11-07]

Changed Multiplayer > Local into a walk of screens: players with one profile row per player, game mode, map (city and time of day), a new Controller Assignment screen, then the car select. Triangle goes back one step and keeps your choices. Only player 1 operates the assignment screen, so it works with the keyboard or any gamepad: pick a player, press Cross or Enter, then press any button or key on the device you want that player to use. Left and Right pick a device by hand, Square shows the keys of a keyboard layout, Auto assign fills the pads and then the keyboards, and Continue only works when every player has a device. A gamepad that is unplugged on the screen is unassigned with a message. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests with virtual pads and injected keys ran, real pads and two real keyboards are not tried. The mouse does not work on these screens yet.  [2026-11-07]

Added full keyboard layouts for two players on one keyboard: WASD on the left and IJKL on the right, each with steering, gas, brake and reverse, handbrake, burnout, fast steering, the three look keys, get in and out, pause, map, change view and the accept and decline keys of the CB, jobs and taxi. No key is shared between the layouts or with the keys every player uses (Esc, T, M, the radio keys). The numeric keypad layout is not offered any more. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by two people on one keyboard.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the keyboard going dead in one player when a gamepad was plugged in after a split screen game: the saved Controllers choices (keyboard Off, pad on Player 2) now only count with two or more players, so the keyboard and the gamepad both drive player 1 at all times, in the menus too. The button pictures switch to the device you used last, a fifth of a second after the other one went quiet. Checked with virtual gamepads and injected keys; NOT tried by hand with a real gamepad.  [2026-11-07]

Added a Bot choice to the Controller Assignment screen: a player from 2 to 8 can be a computer driver, so you no longer need a device for every player. Left and Right on a player row end on Bot, Auto assign gives it to the players that are left over, and Continue works when everybody has a device or is a Bot and player 1 has a real device. Added the mouse to the Local multiplayer screens: click a row, the small arrows, Auto assign, Continue or Back, move over a row to select it, right click goes back. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests with a virtual mouse and virtual pads ran.  [2026-11-07]

Changed bots in local multiplayer: a Bot gets a random street car at once (no police car, no taxi or other special vehicle), is not shown on the car select (only the human players are), and drives by itself in the game with the traffic AI. Added Bot to the Profile row too (Left from not set, or Right after Guest); it is the same choice as Bot on the device row. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests ran.  [2026-11-08]

Changed the Map step of Multiplayer > Local to list every city (the Driver 2 cities, the Driver 1 cities and the extra cities), with scrolling, the same list as Take A Ride. Added the mouse to the car select screen: click a car, click it again or the header to get ready, click the tab line, the wheel scrolls the list of the cell under the pointer, right click goes back. The filter sheet, the maker tiles and dragging the scroll bar do not take the mouse yet. NOT tried by hand: only a virtual mouse ran.  [2026-11-08]

Added the mouse to the rest of the car select screen: the filter sheet (click a maker, click the Game or Kind row, right click closes it) and the scroll bar (click and drag). Works at 16:9, 4:3 and 21:9. NOT tried by hand: only a virtual mouse ran.  [2026-11-08]

Made the help lines on the Choose Your Cars page follow the device each player really uses. A keyboard player sees the real keys of his layout (Original, WASD or IJKL), a mouse player sees what clicks, the wheel and the right button do, and a pad player sees the buttons of his pad family (PlayStation, Xbox A B X Y LB RB, Switch). The panel follows the player who pressed something last and shows his P number when more than one plays. The filter sheet lines follow the same device. 11 new texts in all languages, written by hand. Checked by automatic tests and pictures (keyboard, WASD seat, pad, mouse, German, Greek, 4:3, 21:9), NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the car select for two people on one keyboard. The WASD and IJKL seats can scroll the car list now with their own keys (W S / I K), and get ready, star a car and go back with keys that are no pedals: E and 2 / O and 8 for ready and star, R / U for back. One key table feeds both the picker and the help lines, so the lines show the keys that really work. Original (arrows) is unchanged. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Made the online lobby step through every installed city, not only the four Driver 2 cities. The room still carries the old city number and the string id, so the protocol is the same. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand: the lobby itself was never opened with two players.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed missions with 3 to 8 local players: the mission timer and the mission message wrote past their two player slots over other mission data. Players 3 and up keep using their own messages. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed replays of split screen games with 3 to 8 players: a replay now keeps the car of every player, not only players 1 and 2, so the replay plays the game that was recorded. Replay files get a small trailer (file layout 4); older replays still load. Added the replay self test with several players. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Made the CB radio one system for all players when two or more play: one offer for everybody, shown on every view. When anybody accepts, every player in a car is on that job together and everybody on it gets the full pay. A player who passes, sits in a taxi fare or leaves loses nothing, and a failed job costs nobody anything. The package run is cooperative now (any player picks up and delivers); hit, shake and tail jobs are team jobs too, with one shared target. The old first-to-the-pickup run stays as the option CB Package Run: Competitive. One player plays the CB as before. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with two real pads.  [2026-11-11]

Added a start grid to the races. When the joining window ends, two or more racers are set side by side on the pad, facing the first checkpoint, the handbrake holds them and a message counts 3, 2, 1, GO. A lone player still starts a time trial at once. Added a respawn: a car that is wrecked, on its roof or has not moved for 5 seconds, or a press of Backspace, puts it back on the road at the last checkpoint facing the next one, repaired and with no penalty (last one standing has none). Race times now feed the best times of the stats page (sprint, race, best lap) and the winner of a race of 2 or more counts a race won. New texts GET READY and BACK ON THE ROAD are in all languages, written by hand, not read by native speakers. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Added race courses for Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, a sprint and a lap race in each. Every course of the four cities was driven end to end by a test car. Two Chicago courses had a spot where the car could not get through, so they were redrawn: the checkpoint race now runs round Dearborn, Madison, State and Adams, the Lincoln Park laps run the other way round. The Rio sprint moved from Avenida Brasil to Avenida Rio Branco and the Las Vegas sprint to the northern stretch of the Boulevard for the same reason. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Added two games for friends on one screen in Take a Ride: Hot Potato (one driver is IT and passes it on by bumping another car, the least time as IT wins) and Demolition Derby (the last car running wins, the circle shrinks in the last minute). Stop in a pad to join, it needs 2 or more players, there is a count in, a results screen and a prize. One pad pair for each of the four cities. Checked by automatic tests with 2, 4 and 8 players. NOT tried by hand: the look of the ring, the IT marker and the real crashes.  [2026-11-12]

Made 5 and 6 player split screen fill the whole window: the six cells are 3 by 2 and the picture follows the shape of its cell, so cars are not squeezed and the black bars above and below are gone. 7 and 8 players stay 3 by 3. Looked at 6 players in a picture, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Made replays of split screen games show every player in a view of his own, like in the game, instead of one full window view of player 1. Checked with 2 and 4 players in pictures. The split HUD is not drawn in replays. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Made the launcher start the game with the account ticket also when it is started with --play and no window. If Stay signed in is on, it uses the stored key, asks the account server for a fresh ticket (3 seconds at most) and hands it to the game, then wipes the key. Not signed in, wrong key or no answer: the game starts without a ticket and one line goes into the launcher log. Tested by the unit test with a loopback server (stored key, no key, refused key, silent server, wiped key), NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Fixed the online lobby page running off the bottom of the screen in 4:3. The page now shrinks to fit, so the seats, Start, Chat, Room tools and Leave all stay on screen with up to 8 players and a long chat line. 16:9 and 16:10 look as before. NOT tried by hand, only pictures and the automatic tests.  [2026-11-15]

Added a small amber star in front of the players who are signed in to an account, in the online lobby list and in the player list during a round, with a Signed in note (21 languages). The room browser does not show it yet. NOT tried by hand, only pictures and the automatic tests.  [2026-11-15]

Added a small amber star to Browse games for rooms whose host checks account tickets, with the legend Accounts checked in all 21 languages. It is only a sign: it never decides who can join. A room on an older game or an older master server shows no star, and the older ones keep working. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests ran and I looked at the pictures in 16:9 and 4:3.  [2026-11-15]

I added a game pad button for voice chat push to talk (Select by default, other buttons to choose, also on the Controls page) and an echo suppressor for people who use speakers (off by default, switch in the Voice Chat page). Checked with unit tests on made-up sounds. NOT tried by hand: no real microphone or speakers here.  [2026-11-15]
Added a config option, [online] menu=1, that opens the greyed Online row in the Multiplayer menu for testers, NOT tried by hand  [2026-11-15]

Made the Browse games screen easy to read: bigger text, five filter buttons with the current value, clear column headers, a bar on the chosen row, a darker plate behind the list so text never sits on the picture, a scroll bar for long lists, an empty state that says how to refresh, and a status line with the reason when the master server is not set or not reachable. Fixed the refresh key (it did nothing when the list socket was closed and showed nothing when it worked, now it reopens and shows Updating). Added mouse: click a row, click again to join, click a filter button, wheel to scroll, right click to go back. The key hints now list every button (filter, star, join last) with real key names. 21 languages (machine translation). Keys and mouse tried with the automatic browse test, NOT tried by hand, real keyboard Q NOT tried.  [2026-11-15]

Added a Host on a server screen under Multiplayer, Online with room name, city, time of day, players, start with one player, join while it plays and round, plus a line in the lobby that says Start works alone too and others can join while it plays, texts in 21 languages, the Online row is still greyed out in 0.4.0, NOT tried by hand, nettest runs with menu 2 and 3 players and a 40 s stall stayed equal.  [2026-11-15]

I fixed the text fields of the online menus: Enter now saves what you typed and goes on to the next row, Esc cancels, on the keyboard and with Cross / Triangle. Before, the room name field saved and then opened itself again. The Host on a server screen also stopped showing the address of the server. Checked by automatic tests of the room name and the address field (Enter and Esc); NOT tried by hand, NOT tried with a pad.  [2026-11-15]

I reworked the online lobby after the hand test on the room server: the chat is a panel at the bottom left (messages and an input line, Enter sends, Esc clears, Square starts a message on a pad), the Chat row is gone, picking a car returns to the lobby at once without the ready countdown, a room on the room server has a Start row (it sets you ready, the server starts the room), the Room tools stop on every row and say why a grey one is grey, and no screen shows the address of a server any more. A real Start button and room tools for the creator of a room on the server still need a protocol change. Checked by automatic tests on this PC (two games, typed chat line, server room flag); NOT tried by hand, NOT tried with a pad, NOT tried on the real server, the new texts are machine translated.  [2026-11-15]

Fixed four room bugs found in the code review of the room extras. A player kicked or banned from a room that is playing is now told so and stays out: before, the host's kick was answered like a dropped connection and the player could ask for the log back and take the seat again. A spectator can no longer write chat lines that show up under the host's name. The host's voice mute of a seat ends when that player leaves, so the next person in the seat is heard. A typed room password is wiped from the text field when the page closes, and a chat line of only spaces is cleared instead of saying wait a moment. Checked by the room unit test (kick while playing, spectator chat, voice mute). NOT tried by hand  [2026-11-15]

I gave a room on a room server an owner. The player who asks the server for the room is its owner, bound to a secret that only travels inside the encrypted join, not to a name. The server runs Start, room changes, kick, ban, voice mute, password, ready check, roles and closing only when they come from the owner, and drops the same commands from anybody else. When the owner leaves the room goes to the next player, and the creator can take it back within a minute. Protocol number is now 8, so the room server on the box must be updated with the game. Only checked by unit tests and the room server test with fake players, NOT tried by hand with a pad or the live server.  [2026-11-15]

I made the online lobby use the room owner. The owner sees a real Start row, the city and time rows and the room tools, and the tools got Start mode (everybody ready, or the owner presses Start) and Close the room. Everybody else sees Waiting for the owner and the reason Only the owner of the room can change this. The seat list marks the owner. New texts are in all languages (machine translated). Checked by tests and looking at pictures only, NOT tried by hand, not with a pad.  [2026-11-15]

I fixed the online lobby for a room with an owner that the player joined by a typed address: the Start row and the owner tools now show for the owner and Waiting for the owner for everybody else, not only when the room was joined through Host on a server. Seen on pictures of two games against the room server on the second PC, NOT tried by hand, not with a pad.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed hosting a room on a room server with a room name that has a space at the start or the end: the server refused it, now the spaces are cut off first. Only compiled, NOT run in a game, NOT tried by hand  [2026-11-16]
Fixed the Join game address page: Enter now connects like Cross, as in every other text field. Found by the new online screens test, only automatic tests ran, NOT tried by hand  [2026-11-16]

Added community nodes to the Browse games screen: a small N marks a room on a node, the line under the list names the node and its region (and says when it is new), a Nodes chip hides every node room, and the first time you pick a node room it says the volunteer host can see your IP address. 15 new texts in all 21 languages (machine translated). NOT tried by hand, no picture looked at yet, and no node exists on the real master yet.  [2026-11-16]

I added three quiet checks to the room server: a score for input that looks like a macro or a bot, a mark for a seat that has not moved its controls for two minutes, and a count of which buttons and stick positions the players really send. They only write to the server log and count, nobody is kicked or punished and the network protocol did not change. Tested by machine with the unit tests, NOT tried by hand, not on the live server, and the limits are first guesses that need real play to tune.  [2026-11-16]

I added Mute My Microphone to voice chat. There is a row on Options > Voice Chat (Off by default), a key (Pause or Scroll Lock, set in Mute Key) and an optional gamepad button (Off by default, so no button you use is taken) that switch it live in a room. While it is on, the microphone is closed: nothing is captured or sent, push to talk and voice activation do nothing, and the others see no talking mark for you. You still hear them. A red Mic Muted mark shows in the lobby chat panel and in the voice list in game. Nothing changes on the network, so older builds are not affected. The tests I ran: a unit test of the send rule, and a three machine room on the second PC where the muted one sent no voice at all and still heard the others. NOT tried by hand: a real microphone, the key, the gamepad button, or the in-game mark. The 20 translations are machine made.  [2026-11-16]

I gave the room server three more checks against bots and macros. A player whose input flips buttons and steering every tick for a long time gets strike points, and so does one whose analogue stick only ever has a few positions. When every player in a round has been away for a while the round now ends like an empty room. A removed player now sees 'The room server removed you: your input looked like a macro or a bot'. The limits can be set in the server options (--ac-bot-strike, --ac-hist-min, --ac-hist-values, --away-ends-round) and everything is logged with the reason. Tried by machine only: 400 seeds of a human like pad and 6 full rooms were never flagged, a macro and a two position stick were removed in the test rooms on the second PC. NOT tried by hand, NOT tried with a real person on a real pad, not on the live server (it needs a redeploy).  [2026-11-16]

I took the IP address and port off the online screens. The host lobby line now says only Room open, and the Connecting page says Connecting to the room with no address. The address is only visible while you type it on the Join game page. The 21 languages got the new line. The automatic screen test passes with the strict address check. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Changed the Community node line in Browse to say the volunteer host can see your IP address, name and chat, in 21 languages. Added the Community Node operator agreement text; no node is listed yet. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the online lobby sending you back to the car select screen after you took a car: the Enter that took the car was counted a second time. The online menu test follows it now. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the pause menu of a hosted online game: the seats of the other players counted as missing pads, so the pause menu could turn into the pad error menu that the keyboard cannot close. New automatic test: keyboard opens, moves and closes the pause menu in a room of two. NOT tried by hand, and the test room has a keyboard set on the second seat, so the exact hand case was not reproduced by the machine.  [2026-11-16]

Added speed, rev arc, fuel, money, damage and heat to the online game, they were missing. The map in an online game is now the Take a Ride map (M, Tab or the Show Map row in the pause menu), with the other players as named dots in their colour. The old room map is gone. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed hosting and joining an online game saying the game version is wrong. The version check used a build counter that goes up at every build on each PC, so two copies of the same release never matched. It now uses the release version text, so every copy of one release matches. Checked by the net unit tests (8 of 8), NOT tried by hand with two real installs.  [2026-11-17]

I made the city level files the same bytes on every PC when they are built from the same discs and patches. They used to carry the build time of each part inside, so two installs never matched and online rooms refused players (the city is not the same as on the host). Checked by building a city twice at different times: identical. NOT tried by hand in a room.  [2026-11-17]

I made the game decide if a city level file is current by a stamp of everything it was built from (discs, Core patches, city descriptor files, builder version), not only the importer version. The launcher now runs the level build in the background after an update, so the new Core patches reach the levels. Without the discs the levels stay as they are. Checked on scratch copies: an old level is rebuilt after a patch change and equals a fresh build. NOT tried by hand, real launcher update not run, no window text yet.  [2026-11-17]

Changed Host on a server so the room server in config.ini can be a name (rooms.toclink.com:28300) as well as an IP. The name is looked up in the background, the menu never waits, and the row says to try again if the answer is not there yet. NOT tried by hand against the real server.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the Browse games screen in a 4:3 window. The line of the chosen room is drawn again and shows the community node name and region. The note that a node host can see the IP address no longer sits on the Games listed line. The list keeps five rows by smaller steps. The note was cut short in Hungarian and other long languages, that is fixed too. NOT tried by hand, only pictures of the screen in English, German and Hungarian (4:3 and 16:9) and the unit test.  [2026-11-17]

Made one standard set of rules for every online game: Hard cops, the release traffic and pedestrian numbers, the same police view radius and about 100 more sim settings are fixed while you are in the Online screens, a room or an online game, whatever your own options say. Your own values come back when you leave, and the options files never save the online ones. The Online screens say 'Online rules: standard (Hard cops)'. Your draw distance stays free. The room server identity file is made with the same rules, so it no longer depends on the PC that makes it. Checked with a unit test and a room of two games with different options (equal hashes for 1800 ticks). NOT tried by hand, the line in the lobby is not looked at yet.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the online game to use the same HUD as single player Take a Ride: street name box, round minimap with the other players as dots, analog speedometer, money, toasts like New contracts today, the controls panel and the CB, fare, stop and pump panels, all for the player you play. The chat, the player list and the other players on the map stay. Looked at two pictures (host and guest) from two hidden games, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the online pause menu and keyboard splitting the room. The reverse key, the keyboard state and the accept and decline buttons of the CB radio, taxi and traffic stops were read from your own PC inside the game, so one Down arrow or one key in the pause menu made the two games differ. They now travel with the input of the room. Auto drive, the race reset key and the keyboard in the garage menu are off in a room. The test nettest --roompause went from 21 of 23 lines different to 0. The room server needs the new version. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the CB radio accept in an online room: the button of the second player now works from that player's own PC and both games stay equal. A second filter in the room code still cut the new input bits. Added test switches REDRIVER_NETANSWER and REDRIVER_CBSHARE=noans: the second player accepts a CB package job, 49 hash lines equal over 1500 ticks. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Added competed CB jobs to online games: the offer goes to every player at the same moment, the first to accept has the job alone, the others see Taken by NAME and lose nothing, and only the winner is paid. Local split screen keeps the team jobs. Both players pressed accept on the same tick in two hidden games over 2400 ticks with 79 equal hash lines. NOT tried by hand; the new text Taken by is not translated yet.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the online CB jobs into a race. Everybody who accepts is on the job; for a package the first one at the pickup carries it, another player who accepted can steal it by ramming the carrier hard (4 seconds of safety for the new carrier), and the one who delivers is paid alone. For hit, shake and tail only the first one done is paid, the others just end with no loss. Two hidden games, 2400 ticks, the second player rammed and delivered, 79 equal hash lines. The real ramming by driving and the hit strength are NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the police car of the cops in online Cops n Robbers and Chase rounds in the car store cities (Driver 1 cities, Ashland, Driv3r Miami): it is chosen from the car list and the region table of the city, not from what happens to be loaded, so every machine gets the same cruiser. Checked with two games in Driv3r Miami and Ashland (same cruiser, same slot, hash lines equal).
