NOT tried by hand, and the Driver 1 cities and London were NOT run (the room city list on the test PC does not offer them).  [2026-11-17]

Added the round view for spectators in online Cops n Robbers and Chase: a line with Watching, the clock and how many robbers are free while the round runs, and the scoreboard at the end. A spectator has no car and no input, so it cannot touch the round. Checked with a second game as spectator (hash lines equal to the host, same round lines). NOT tried by hand, the screen was not looked at.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed an online desync: the traffic and pedestrian rules that look at where the view is (where new cars appear, which cars may be removed, the pedestrian cone, the event lists) read the camera of the machine they ran on, so two players with different camera views got different cars and different random numbers and the round ended. They now follow the position and heading of a player car, the same on every machine. Checked with two games whose cameras were forced to different views (the old build desynced at tick 90, the new one had 79 hash lines equal over 2400 ticks) and tick hash (offline play unchanged). NOT tried by hand with two real PCs.  [2026-11-17]

Online rooms are Take a Ride only for 0.4.0: the room tools can no longer switch a room to Chase or Cops n Robbers. Those return later as events you start inside the world. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Added the second two player arena of every Driver 2 city to the local multiplayer map list: a row "<city> (Multiplayer 2)" after the Multiplayer row, for Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, day and night. The arenas were in the mission file all along (missions 498 to 505) and no menu started them. Checked by pictures of all 8 and by a menu test of the Havana row. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Raised the size of an online room from 8 to 16 players. A room starts with 8 seats and the host can set it up to 16 in the room tools. Every seat that is free from the start takes a player who comes in later, at any time (before only 4 seats were kept free). The lobby shows 16 seats in smaller rows, the player list scrolls and the map has 16 colours. The online protocol changed (version 9), so every player has to update. Tried by two real games with a 16 seat room, 1800 ticks, equal hashes. NOT tried by hand: real players on more than two machines.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the Online row staying greyed out on installs made by an older launcher: when config.ini has no [online] section (or misses menu, master or room_server) the game now uses the release addresses. A value in the player's config.ini always wins, menu=0 still switches the row off. Unit test and the net unit tests ran. NOT tried by hand, NOT tried with a real old install.  [2026-11-17]

I added race events to the online Take a Ride room. Any player starts a checkpoint race from the pause menu (Race Event, pick the course, Left and Right change the laps), the others get a prompt and answer with J or N, two or more make a race. The racers are put on a grid, counted in, race with position, lap, checkpoint and time on screen, get places and prizes, and are put back where they were. The police leave the racers alone, a wrecked car is out of the race. Every city has more circuits and sprints now. Only tested by script on 3 machines, NOT tried by hand, no pad key for the prompt yet.  [2026-11-18]

I built Cops n Robbers as an event inside the online Take a Ride room. Anybody opens Events in the pause menu, the others get a prompt to join (J, C or R on the keyboard, L1 on a pad, N or R1 to say no), and the ones who join are put together on a road with a robber car or a police car of any city. Three rounds, a score board, then everybody gets the own car back and the room is free roam again. Only real players: no robbers and no cops from the computer, and the police leaves the players of the event alone. At most three robbers and always more cops than robbers. Tried only by automatic tests with 2 to 4 players and a player who says no. NOT tried by hand: how it looks, the sound, the pad keys, the car pick (the car is a random allowed one).  [2026-11-18]

I fixed a desync in online races: the reset key (Backspace) and the test console respawn of a race are switched off in a room, because one machine put a car back and the others did not. A racer who is out of a race is not counted as racing any more. Checked by script on 3 machines, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

I made the world follow the racers of an online race event. The map is only loaded around the first player of a room, so a start grid somewhere else in the city showed no streets. While an event runs the map now follows the first racer, and goes back to the first player when the cars are put back. Players who decline and stand far from the racers lose their map while the event runs (engine limit, not fixed). Checked with pictures from a script run, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Changed the online race events to be one more kind of the room events, like Cops 'n' Robbers: the same invitation (J joins, N says no), the same wait, the same results time and the same pause between two events. Race Event is a row of the Events page of the pause menu now. The online protocol changed (version 10), so every player has to update. Checked by automatic tests with equal hashes: 3 racers, 2 rounds, one who says no, a wrecked racer with the police after everybody, a racer who leaves, laps, and a room server. NOT tried by hand: the course list, the invitation and the results on screen.  [2026-11-18]

Changed the wreck recovery in an online room: a player who plays a running event (a race or Cops 'n' Robbers) is out for the round when his car is wrecked, and gets his new car when the event is over. A player who said no to the event is in free roam and gets his new car as always, also while the others race. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the pause menu of an online room: the keyboard now drives the menu with the menu keys (before, Up arrow selected a row and Down did nothing), the car gets no input while the menu, the big map or the player list is open, and the mouse is free and visible there. The mouse is let go when the window loses focus and when the room ends. The menu says that the game keeps running. Checked with a two game room test and a unit test, NOT tried by hand (pad, two PCs).  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the desync when a controller is plugged in during an online round. The right stick and the trigger axes of a pad were only known to the machine that had the pad, so the on foot look, the camera and the thrust of every car could differ between machines. They now travel with the input of the round, the on foot options are fixed to the standard in a room, and a desync writes the state words of the machine into log.txt. Online protocol 11: everybody must update, old builds cannot join. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic tests ran.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed an online room drifting apart when one player changed any option in the pause menu: the sunrise and sunset of the game clock, the traffic and pedestrian limits of the day clock and the empty city of a room were put back to the standard on that PC only. The room now keeps them. Also the procedural sky setting is the same for everybody now. Tested by an automatic 3 player room with a client that changes options all the time, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Held more settings at the same value in an online room so that no PC reads its own: the traffic lights programme, parking and ambient limits, the taxi share, chase traffic, the car packs of traffic_cars.ini, the camera view list, wreck recovery and unfinished cars. The tyre compound of a saved car look, the Auto Exchange shop and customizer, the console commands that change the game (tp, hour, spawn, mission, weather ...) and the level editor are off while a room plays. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Checked the data files of the content packs when joining a room. Before, only the names of the pack folders were compared, so two PCs with the same packs but another jobs.txt, tyres.txt, economy, car or weather file joined and the round died at the first hash check. Now the economy, jobs, fares, car lists and the handling part of car files, city descriptions, collision, aircraft, driver weights, weather and mission files go into the join check, and the host refuses the guest at the door with the mods reason. The room identity file of the room server needs a new mods word. Tested by the program only (unit test, a refused guest in nettest, a normal join), NOT tried by hand on two PCs.  [2026-11-18]

Stopped the one player game over in a room. A car that sank faded the screen and opened the Game Over menu on every PC of the room, and a mission over could stop the pad of one PC only. The modes of the pause menu already could not start in a room. Offline nothing changes. Tested by the program only (unit test), NOT tried by hand, no sinking car was tested in a real room.  [2026-11-18]

I fixed a crash in Rio: after about 15 minutes in a room with 3 players, a pad race could start with a race slot that held no car, and every machine crashed on the same tick. The bridge check now skips an empty slot. The online soak found it; a 30 minute Rio run now passes with equal hashes.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed online rooms refusing a good install with 'the installed mods is not the same as on the host'. The list of car pictures differs on every install (Disc Install adds rows for the pictures it makes) and was counted as game data; it is not any more. Checked on the install that was refused: only that file differed. NOT tried by hand in a room yet.  [2026-11-18]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the multiplayer car picker to be easier to read: bigger, brighter lists and tabs, and the help lines on a dark panel at the bottom. Tested with picture evidence at 720p, 1080p and 4k with 2, 5 and 8 players.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Changed Ready in the car picker: it no longer starts the game at once. The first Ready starts a 2 minute clock, when everybody is ready it drops to 10 seconds, taking Ready back starts it over. The time shows large on screen.  [2026-11-01]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the Map step of Multiplayer > Local: every Driver 2 city is listed twice, as its single player map (for example Chicago) and as the smaller split screen map (Chicago (Multiplayer)); only the multiplayer one carries the label. Driver 1 and extra cities have their single map only. The game modes run on either one.  [2026-11-08]

Not Hand Tested: Added race events to Take a Ride. Stop in a start pad in the city to join: alone it is a time trial, with 2 or more players it is a race with live places (a car that only drives across a pad does not join). Four kinds (sprint, checkpoint race, lap race, last one standing), an arrow and ring per player, a lap counter, results with times, best times saved per profile and a prize for the winner. Four courses in Chicago; a course is a few lines in maps/races_<city>.txt of a pack.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Opened Online in the release build: the shipped config now has the Online row on and the master and room server addresses. The release check requires it. NOT tried by hand with a player install; the room content check against a disc built install is not proven yet.  [2026-11-17]

Not Hand Tested: Online rooms in the four Driver 2 cities now load the whole single player Take A Ride map. Before, they loaded the smaller split screen map. Built, NOT tried by hand, no online room run yet.  [2026-11-17]

sections.title: Discord Bot
lines: Not Hand Tested: Added the Discord bot: players can get account help and manage their reDriver account from Discord.  [2026-11-15]

sections.title: Missions and Story
lines: Added scenes for fan made stories: comic panels with a caption, voice and music, title cards and avi clips, played from Extras > Custom Missions or with the console command scene.  [2026-10-15]
Let a mission have an intro scene before it starts and an outro scene when it is completed.  [2026-10-15]
Added dialogue captions over the recorded cutscenes of a mission, with the modern HUD subtitle.  [2026-10-15]
Let scene panels be held until a button is pressed, Left or L1 goes one panel back, and a damaged jpg no longer closes the game.  [2026-10-15]
Added camera moves over a picture, fades and chaining one scene into the next.  [2026-10-15]
Let a custom mission continue with another mission, so you can build a story chain.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the job system to keep its own state for every player, every player's jobs run side by side.  [2026-10-20]
Changed fares to work per player, every player accepts or declines his own fare.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed restarts keeping the old jobs: the job, waypoint and job generator reset when a level loads.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed a story mission restart drawing different random numbers from a fresh start, the city of the mission is now read before the seed.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the cops batter trigger and the fuel tank values keeping the numbers of the game before after a restart.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed Las Vegas events starting differently after a restart, the parked trains lose their path and the event list starts clean.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the player idle watch animation freeze carrying over into a restart, and event objects not starting fresh after a restart: path speed, helicopter rotor, door stages and detonator.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed a restart in mission 30 freezing the game for good.  [2026-10-24]
Let the mission maker open an original mission as a template, move a target, change the time limit and the cars, and save it as a new mission of your pack.  [2026-10-25]
Added a tool that shows any original mission as readable steps and can make a copy with one target moved; all 137 original missions can be read.  [2026-10-25]
Added a reader for the Driver 1 missions on your disc (list, check, dump, extract) with the instruction table and its Driver 2 meaning, then list, plan, import and verify.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the game to start a Driver 1 mission in its own Driver 1 city, and a mod mission keeps its own start.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the setup to also convert the Driver 1 training, driving school and credits levels as hidden cities so more Driver 1 missions can import.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed the Custom Missions list showing Rio for every Driver 1 mission, the small line now names the real city.  [2026-10-27]
Changed story mission restarts to start like a fresh start, checked for twelve missions by the automatic tests.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed the destination of the imported Driver 1 missions. Needs a new import of the missions.  [2026-10-30]
Added loading of a mission from a level file that carries it, so a level pack can ship its own missions.  [2026-10-30]

Added loading of the missions a level file carries. A city file that has missions in it hands them to the mission list. Checked with the Driver 1 bank job stored in the Rio file: it loads from the file and starts. Driver 1 city files can not carry the Driver 1 missions yet.  [2026-10-30]
Fixed the Driver 1 bank job showing no marker at the bank. The arrow shows from about 8 blocks away, the bank is 100 blocks from the garage. Needs the Driver 1 missions imported again.  [2026-10-31]
Fixed the police stops (pull-overs) happening in the middle of a custom mission, like the timed Driver 1 jobs.  [2026-10-31]

Changed the Driver 1 bank pickup cutscene: three men in dark suits now come out of the bank door and run to your car, with black bars and a camera that follows them. The scene length follows the walk.  [2026-10-31]

Fixed cutscene cameras in the streamed Driver 1 cities being thrown back to the in-car view on the first tick, and cutscene actors that started where the level has no ground falling out of the world.  [2026-10-31]
Changed the cutscene camera fix and the cutscene actor ground fix to apply only to imported Driver 1 missions, so Driver 2 mission 23 plays as before.  [2026-10-31]

Added reading of the Driver 1 movie tables on the European, French, German and Italian discs too (they boot SLES_018.16, not SLUS_008.42). All seven dumps list the same 44 missions with 36 movie links. The European discs hold fewer movie files, so their movies are still left out.  [2026-11-01]
Fixed the follow-the-car distance of custom missions: a small distance no longer wraps around. Story missions behave as before.  [2026-11-03]
Changed scene files so that pictures, voices, music and clips can only come from the scene folder. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Fixed the chase route of a mission: it was picked from the frame counter, so two starts of the same mission (found with mission 26) could play another route and the traffic then ran differently. Now it comes from the mission and the last route, so a start is the same every time. NOT tried by hand; a fresh start of a chase mission now picks a fixed first route instead of a random one.  [2026-11-07]
Changed the CB radio chatter, job offers, cab dispatcher calls and passenger talk to new lines with characters of their own, Not Hand Tested  [2026-11-07]

Gave missions room for more than 16 places (up to 256) and made the WAIT step a real step of the mission engine. A long mission carries a small TGTX block after its header; missions with 16 places or less are written exactly as before, so old and original missions are untouched. The mission tools (dump, build, explain) and the in game text editor read and write it. The wait counts logic ticks in the target itself, so two waits never share a counter. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed Driver 1 Trail Blazer missions to keep all 100 checkpoints after a new import, and made WaitSeconds of the Driver 1 scripts a wait step wherever there is room. Added a new step WAIT (3, 5, 10 or 30 seconds) to the mission maker. The two new texts are translated in all languages by hand. The imported missions on disk must be imported again to get this. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added two mission maker steps, PICKUP and DROP OFF. A person waits at the marker, you stop, he walks to the car and gets in. At DROP OFF he gets out and walks away. It uses the taxi passenger. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added the mission maker step TIME LIMIT. A countdown runs for the rest of the mission and shows the seconds left. When it runs out the mission fails, goes on, or sends the police. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the mission text reader being very slow with a script of 100000 jumps, and made the mission text dump safe for jump distances near the largest number. Added a fuzz test with truncated, huge and damaged texts. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added mission maker conditions: MAX SPEED, STEALTH and MAX DAMAGE. The mission fails when you go over the speed cap, the police notice you, or the car takes too much damage. The rules show on the message line. RULES OFF ends them. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added mission maker steps TRAFFIC and COP WAVE. TRAFFIC makes the streets empty or full for a while and then gives the normal traffic back. COP WAVE sends one to four patrol cars after you. The cars come the usual way behind you, so there is no place to set. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Made the mission maker place up to 40 steps (it was 15). A mission with more than 16 steps is written with the TGTX block, so it needs 0.4.0 or newer; a RACE keeps its 14 checkpoints. A 20 step mission builds and plays to the end in the scripted test. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed the TAIL step picking a car the player was already too far from (the mission failed in the first second). Added scripted drives of the maker mission types TAIL, ESCAPE, DELIVERY, REC CHASE and RACE and of the MAX DAMAGE condition (the bot rams until the rule breaks). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Made scenes play more sound formats. A voice or music line in a scene can now be an mp3, m4a, aac, wma or flac file, and a wav that is not plain PCM (ADPCM, 24 bit, float). They go through the Windows decoder the menu music already uses, so no new library came in. Dropping a sound on the scene tab checks it first: a damaged file or an ogg is refused with a message and is not copied. Ogg Vorbis is still not supported, the game has no decoder for it. Checked by automatic tests with generated sound files, NOT tried by hand. The new texts are machine translated in all languages.  [2026-11-09]

Added story chains. Custom missions that follow each other (the THEN MISSION row of the mission maker, next= in M<n>.scenes.txt) now show as one Story row at the top of Extras > Custom Missions. It opens a chapter menu with Cleared, Up next and Locked marks. A cleared chapter can be played again, the next one is the first not cleared, later ones are locked in that menu. It works with the mouse, the keys and the pad, in the 70s menu style. Finishing a custom mission is saved per profile in saves\<profile>\chains.sav, a new small file, so old saves load as before. The story still goes on by itself to the next mission after an outro. A chain is named like its first mission. There is no best result, custom missions have no score. All new texts are in all languages (machine translated, native review owed). Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed the Custom Missions list: a mission in a mod city now shows the name of that city, not the engine level of its header. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand: the list on screen.  [2026-11-09]
Fixed a crash on the first frame of a mission with an event target that has no place: the map and marker drawing now skip it. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed the cone counting of Gate Race and Trailblazer with more than 2 players (it wrote past the 2 timers), a bad player number of a mission thread and a lap number past the lap table. Each logs one line. Checked by game run tests only, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed a crash when the first mission of a game is refused (damaged file): the player car now falls back to slot 0 with a log line. Car target models outside 0 to 249 are reset. Found by the value fuzzer. Game run checks added for the thread player, the list title of a mission with more than 16 targets, and Trailblazer with 3 players. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed Gate Race and Survival with 2 or more players: the game data has no 2 player mission for them (it showed an error box and then crashed), so the 1 player mission is played now, with a log line. Game run checks for 2 and 3 players. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Added the Speed Bomb job to the shared CB radio. The car of the player who takes it carries a bomb that arms above 50 mph and blows up when the speed stays under that for 5 seconds. Drive 3 minutes or reach 8 checkpoints for 400 to 800 dollars. After a blast the player is put back on the road after 5 seconds. Only automatic tests ran, NOT tried by hand. Solo play has no radio offer yet.  [2026-11-12]

Made a race stop putting the car back at the last checkpoint while it waits in front of a raised Chicago bridge. Before, standing there for 5 seconds counted as stuck, and the bridge can stay up for 40 seconds. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Added a CAMERA step to the mission maker. It plays a camera path you made with the Film Director: the placed cameras of a recording become a small file next to the mission, so you can share the mission without the replay. The step can wait for the end, can be skipped with Cross or Enter, and can lock your controls or let you keep driving. The editor lists your recordings, plays a preview in the editor view and saves the file with the mission. Old missions load as before, a mission with the step needs 0.5.0 or newer. Black bars and the lens of the recording are saved but not drawn yet. Checked by unit tests, two scripted game runs (the path plays, the mission ends; a missing file is skipped) and the tick hash (184 ok). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Fixed the cars you have to follow in the story chases (and in the Ram the car games) crashing into walls and wrecking themselves in nearly every try. The chased car now drives past building corners, takes no damage and is put back on its wheels if it rolls over, so it drives its whole route; it still plows through the traffic. New option chaseSafeTraffic in config.ini (1 on, 0 = the old behaviour). Tested only by automatic runs of every chase, NOT tried by hand with a pad.  [2026-11-18]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the Driver 1 chase mission 1157, whose target car stood off the roads of the Miami level and could not pull out: it is put in a lane of the nearest road now.  [2026-11-06]

Not Hand Tested: Marked restarting a mission from the pause menu as experimental in this beta: it resets traffic, police, jobs, the camera and the random numbers to a fresh start, but only one mission restart (mission 33) has been played through by hand, so report any mission that hangs or starts wrong after a restart.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Rewrote the CB small talk, the passenger stories and story series, the taxi passenger remarks and the boss lines in the same late 70s voice as the CB chatter, and translated all 161 changed or new CB, job and taxi texts by hand into the other languages. Old translations of replaced lines are gone.  [2026-11-08]

Not Hand Tested: Added the Pick List order: five cars the Auto Exchange needs in 25 minutes, offered at the shop and on the CB radio. Every car you turn in is paid with a rush price, and a finished list pays a bonus and a time bonus to everyone who helped.  [2026-11-11]
Not Hand Tested: Added your standing with the boss to the Jobs page of the stats. The game now says when you gain reputation or get promoted, and the Pick List adds reputation.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added a daily contract board to Take a Ride. Every game day has three contracts (deliveries, taxi fares, hidden packages, distance, losing the police, winning a race). All players see the same three and count their own progress. A finished contract pays a bonus and gives respect with the boss. There is a Contracts page in the Stats screen and a message when a new day starts.  [2026-11-12]

sections.title: Level Editor
lines: Polished the look of the classic level editor: plates behind the panels, little triangles on the sections, an underline on the active tab, soft shadows and a small axes widget.  [2026-10-14]
Fixed the editor menu dropdown clicking through to the buttons below it.  [2026-10-15]
Changed box select over original faces to be instant, it used to cast 600 rays three times.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the green selection highlight to show every selected face, tinted and outlined, not only the first 40.  [2026-10-15]
Put all the editor shortcuts in one list that feeds HELP > Keyboard shortcuts, and it is checked for clashes at start.  [2026-10-15]
Changed F1 to open the editor manual, and moved the polygon keys to F2 and F3.  [2026-10-15]
Stopped the renderer's own debug keys (F3, F5, F6, Backspace) from firing while the editor is open.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the editor to follow the HUD theme (70s, PlayStation, Driver Menu and mod themes), with THEME buttons on the VIEW tab and VIEW > Next theme.  [2026-10-15]
Added a small thumbnail of its texture to every row of the piece list.  [2026-10-15]
Changed a piece whose outline passes close to the cursor to be pickable even when the ray misses it, like thin slivers and edge-on pieces.  [2026-10-15]

Added import from inside the editor: an OBJ MODELS section on the CREATE tab, files dropped on the window are copied into the library, and png, jpg and tga pictures work as custom textures.  [2026-10-15]
Added INTRO SCENE and OUTRO SCENE rows to the mission maker.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the mission maker to draw the start, goals, targets and destinations of the draft as labelled rings in the editor view.  [2026-10-15]
Added NEW, COPY and DELETE buttons for mission slots and a line that says what the draft still lacks.  [2026-10-15]
Changed lamps, signs and barriers of the level to light up under the cursor, and a click turns one into a piece you can move, turn, scale, copy or delete.  [2026-10-15]
Added a SCENES tab to the editor, a scene composer that builds scenes with buttons.  [2026-10-15]
Added STOP, SPEED and POLICE steps, a CAR DAMAGE row and slot titles to the mission maker.  [2026-10-15]
Stopped browsing mission slots from leaving empty drafts behind.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the level editor to hitch less in New York, picking a hidden original face went from up to 810 ms to about 1 ms.  [2026-10-16]
Changed every text in the level editor to go through the translation files (423 new texts), and the Greek capital Omega now shows.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the editor reading of its files to be safer: lines are whole or skipped, counts are capped, bad numbers are refused and names cannot carry a folder.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed sample OBJ files importing as a dot in the editor (a scale reference in the header gave scale 0), and the lap text no longer points at freed memory.  [2026-10-23]

Changed the editor to save through a temp file, so a failed save is reported and keeps your work. The clipboard, object, pack and editor pack files are written the same way, so a crash while saving can no longer leave a half written file.  [2026-10-24]
Added T and Shift+T in the level editor to cycle through everything under the cursor, and an M collision view where a click deletes the solid under the cursor.  [2026-10-25]
Changed a big solid in the collision view to need a second click to delete, and the texts for picking and the collision view are in all languages.  [2026-10-25]
Added a TO PATCH button that writes your editor edits as a level patch into the open .level file, with texts in all languages.  [2026-10-25]
Fixed the mission maker START and GOAL buttons aiming through the cursor that sits on the button, they now place at the middle of the view and warn when nothing is hit.  [2026-10-25]

Changed BAKE in the level editor to write your edits into your own copy of the level, on top of the installed level with the Core edits. The button now says which file it writes, for example BAKE INTO chicago.level, it keeps your copy from before as a backup, and the city restarts by itself.  [2026-10-25]
Stopped the editor loading the Core edits twice when the level already carries them.  [2026-10-26]
Changed marker add, paste and object place to aim through the middle of the view when the mouse is over the menu, with a No Surface In View message.  [2026-10-26]
Added an undo history list in the VIEW tab, click a step to jump back or forward.  [2026-10-26]
Added a file browser panel to the editor (packs, edit files, textures, objects).  [2026-10-26]
Fixed BAKE in the editor, the restart opens the baked level copy and your edits stay if the game would not load it.  [2026-10-26]

Changed switching packs in the editor to keep patch pieces and hidden faces, switching packs drops the old pack's deleted objects, and the PACK button names the next pack and the save target.  [2026-10-26]
Changed every piece, face and object of a layer to be editable, and edits are saved into the working pack.  [2026-10-26]
Added UNDO BAKE, it brings back the level copy from before the last bake.  [2026-10-27]
Added SHARE LEVEL, it copies the whole baked level to a share folder with the date in the name and shows you the path.  [2026-10-27]

Changed RESET LEVEL to keep your copy as a backup instead of deleting it, so UNDO BAKE can bring it back, and the city restarts by itself like BAKE and UNDO BAKE, so the pieces you baked are gone at once.  [2026-10-27]
Added a new level editor look with a SIMPLE and an ADVANCED mode, a tool palette, a top bar, a right panel and a hint bar. SIMPLE is the default.  [2026-10-27]
Added first time help cards to the SIMPLE editor mode.  [2026-10-27]
Added Ctrl+K in the editor, it searches every menu entry and tool, and Ctrl+Shift+A switches between SIMPLE and ADVANCED.  [2026-10-27]
Added a switch in the editor settings to go back to the classic editor look.  [2026-10-27]
Changed the game to draw things a level patch adds and retextures, an added object stands in the city and is solid, a retextured face shows its new texture.  [2026-10-27]
Changed the editor click to take the nearest visible thing instead of the water behind a fence, and to take original faces by default.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed a held T key running through every candidate in the editor.  [2026-10-27]
Changed the editor collision view so a click goes to the solid first.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed M and T reaching the game while the editor is open (the map screen smeared the collision view), and made a click take a whole solid object.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed clicking a concrete barrier in the editor, one click takes the whole level object (both sides and the top) with its collision, and no hidden copy stays.  [2026-10-27]
Changed leaving the editor to put your car at the camera on the ground and leave the free camera.  [2026-10-27]
Updated the editor manual with the bake buttons, box select of 1500 faces, undo depth and browse files.  [2026-10-28]
Fixed the level editor crashing when placing the mission start and goal markers.  [2026-10-29]

Fixed the RESET LEVEL button text in the editor: it said it deletes your copy, but it keeps a backup and UNDO BAKE brings the copy back, in all 14 languages. Wrote the editor manual pages for the SIMPLE and ADVANCED modes, the tool palette, tool search, the first-time cards, the Saving to panel and the bake buttons.  [2026-10-30]

Fixed the Saving to chip in the ADVANCED editor bar cutting the pack name, and gave the tool palette short labels that fit the column in German, French, Hungarian and Spanish. The Ctrl+K tool search now also finds a tool by its English name in every language.  [2026-10-30]

Added a CAR tab to the editor ADD panel: click a car of the level and it is parked at the cursor and stays in the level. TURN, MOVE HERE, NEXT CAR and DELETE work on it and Ctrl+Z undoes every step. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Replaced the arrow buttons of the editor LEVEL tab with a picture chooser: a grid of previews of every level object and car, a search box, kind chips (lamp, sign, fence, road, prop) and a big picture of the picked one. Double click or PLACE puts it down. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Opened the CAR tab of the editor to the whole car catalog, about 1380 cars (Driver 2, Driver 1, Gran Turismo 1 and 2, mod cars), with a search box and kind chips. A parked car is saved by its catalog key and old saved cars still work. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]
Gave the cars of the editor CAR tab real pictures (1377 of 1383 cars). Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]
Added the Driver 2 cars of all four cities to the editor CAR tab and made them droppable. Cars the customizer cannot load (the police car, some specials) stay empty. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-01]

Made a new install start the editor in its own pack called My Edits. The release config ships it and the first F6 makes the folder and says so. The Core pack stays in the pack row (NEXT PACK). Test runs never make the folder.  [2026-11-04]
Added .fbx, .glb and .gltf models to the level editor drop, next to .obj, with their pictures found next to the model. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Raised the triangle limit of the level editor to 100000 for one dropped model and 300000 for the whole level. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added a car builder: a dropped 3D model becomes a car with Driver 2 driving, ready to pick in the game. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added a model wizard to the level editor: after you drop a model a form asks name, maker and body type, and SAVE THE CAR puts the car into your pack. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Made the model wizard find the wheels, front, unit and top of a car by itself and ask in the form when it is not sure, with wizard texts in all 16 languages. Machine translated, not read by a native speaker.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the model wizard drawing the collision box and the driver eye of a model as a black box around the car.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed models that are painted only in colours (OBJ and FBX) coming out grey in the car wizard. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added a 3D preview to the model wizard: the car with its colours, its size, the wheel rings and the front arrow. You can turn it with the mouse. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed a dropped 3D model that could not be moved with the Move tool. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added a building and prop path to the model wizard: buildings, scenery, street furniture and figures are placed upright with a solid box so cars hit them. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Added a physics page to the model wizard: type a top speed and set mass, grip and suspension as a percent of a stock car, and see the 0 to 60 time.  [2026-11-06]
Added a tweak page to the model wizard to make the wheels wider, move an axle, lift the body and move the lamps and exhaust. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Added a full colour option to the model wizard so a car keeps the pictures of its model in their own colours. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Added a traffic page to the model wizard: the car can be in the traffic or not, rare or common, and marked as a cab.  [2026-11-06]
Added a WHERE row to the traffic page of the model wizard to limit a car to one city or a group of cities. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Added a row SAVE IN THE OBJECTS LIBRARY (on by default) and a 3D preview of the model to the building and prop page of the model wizard, so the placed pieces can be placed again in any level. Not tried by hand with real models.  [2026-11-06]
Updated the editor manual and the modding guide for the model wizard: every page and the car.txt lines it writes.  [2026-11-06]
Added a CANCEL button to every page of the model wizard that throws the dropped model away, asking first if you changed something. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Fixed a car saved by the model wizard looking missing in the customizer: it now shows first in the Recent list.  [2026-11-06]
Made a car saved by the model wizard show up in the customizer and the car picker at once, without restarting the level.  [2026-11-06]
Gave wizard cars a maker (My Cars) and a NEW chip in the Car tab list for 7 days. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Changed the level editor pack share to write the zip file itself, so no helper program is started. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Fixed the editor help saying 18000 triangles per placement and 20000 per level, the editor takes 100000 per placed model and 300000 in all, in all languages. Not looked at on the screen by eye.  [2026-11-06]
Made a dropped model find its pictures even when the MTL file is missing or names other files. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Fixed the model wizard rows and arrows that did not react to the mouse. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Added a SCALE slider to the model wizard car page and an outline of the stock Chicago car next to the model in the preview. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Changed every row of the wizard tweak page into a slider with a large range, and made the wheels, lamps and exhaust draggable in the 3D preview. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Redrew the X Y Z orientation gizmo in the editor corner: soft round backdrop, coloured arms with lettered caps, small dots for the negative ends, far arms dimmer, and a smooth glow with a tooltip when the mouse is over it. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Made the editor crosshair always visible: two tones so it shows on a bright wall, the road and the sky, drawn on top of the panels, at the mouse when the cursor is free. View > Crosshair switches it off. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]
Added scaling of the editor interface from 75 to 200 percent with Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-, reset with Ctrl+0 or from the View menu; the size is kept between sessions.  [2026-11-07]
Added a compact editor size for mouse and keyboard, so the 3D view gets far more room.  [2026-11-07]

Collapse the right panel, the tool strip and the texture strip with a click on the tab at their edge or with Ctrl+B, Ctrl+L and Ctrl+J, and switch on optional auto-hide so panels slide away until the mouse touches the screen edge.  [2026-11-07]
Add a dark and a light theme to the editor, switched from the View menu or with Ctrl+Shift+T and kept between sessions.  [2026-11-07]

Added a way to open the model wizard without dragging a file: a MODEL WIZARD... button in the CREATE tab (and in SIMPLE under ADD > MODEL), FILE > Import 3D model... and Ctrl+M. Each opens the file browser on your models, Downloads, Desktop and Documents folders, showing only folders and 3D model files; the file you pick goes the same way as a dropped one. Esc does nothing. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added an editor settings window (Ctrl+,) with six tabs for the interface, camera, editing, saving and a searchable list of keys. Every setting works at once and is kept after a restart. The menus got Open pack folder, Next grid step, Reset layout, Screenshot and About. NOT tried by hand, automatic tests click through the window and the menus.  [2026-11-07]

Gave the texture strip at the bottom of the editor its own background bar over the whole screen width, bigger numbers, a frame on the current texture and a size setting. NOT tried by hand, automatic tests check the layout at 75, 100 and 200 percent in both themes.  [2026-11-07]

Added a guided tour of the level editor that darkens the screen and lights up what it explains, starts the first time you open the editor, can be skipped at any step and can be started again from Help.  [2026-11-07]
Fixed the editor tour: on the crosshair step the card ran away from the mouse, now it stays where it is, and the arrow keys and Backspace go on and back.  [2026-11-07]

Replaced the four first-time cards of the level editor with the guided tour, added a TOUR button to the simple view that starts it again, and made the Tutorial row of the editor settings start it.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the editor tour so a click can no longer skip or break a step: a step goes on only for the real action, a wrong click is ignored with a hint, a double click is one click, and the texture step now lays a texture on the box. When the editor starts in advanced mode the tour is offered in one line.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the DETAIL row of the car wizard to steps of the model itself: TRAFFIC keeps a quarter of its triangles, DETAILED half, HIGH three quarters and ORIGINAL all of them (up to the car limit). The row shows the real numbers, for example 170 of 342 triangles, and the preview changes at once. The reduction keeps the texture seams, the window rims and the wheel arches. Checked by automatic tests and pictures of the real Suspicious Car 01 model, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the car wizard preview to draw the model with its picture like a 3D viewer: perspective correct, smooth light, filtered texture at the size of the picture, and the 16 colour palette of the game when that is chosen. The old preview was blocky, smeared and noisy. The TEXTURES row and a line under the preview now say which picture mode the preview shows. NOT tried by hand, only by pictures of the real Suspicious Car 01 model next to a reference render.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the texture strip: the thumbnails are drawn flat now, in true colours. The wet road and wall grain shader no longer darkens or roughens them. Checked with a rain picture before and after, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed PLAY in the scene composer: the scene is read from its own folder, so a new scene plays (cards, panels, captions) and after it the level starts again with the editor still on, not the main menu. A scene without items or a missing file now says so in the log. Checked by automatic tests; the look of the scene and the return were NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the MISSION tab: the crosshair stays in the middle of the screen and is always shown, and a placed point (start, goal, checkpoint, target, destination) can be moved afterwards: pointer over its ring, hold the right mouse button, drag, let go. It lights up, UNDO takes the move back. New help line and status text in all languages by hand. Checked by automatic tests at 75, 100 and 200 percent; the feel with a real mouse was NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the model wizard cars coming out dark. The game lights a wizard car like a Driver 2 car (0.55 of the picture in the shade, 0.65 to 0.69 on average), so a model painted for a plain viewer looked grey in the game. Every picture and colour is now 40 percent brighter when the car is built (white stays white, the hue stays), and the preview now uses the same light as the game, so what the preview shows is what drives. Measured on the Suspicious Car 01 in the customizer: the car is 21 percent brighter, preview and game within 3 percent. Not tried by hand, cars saved before this need a rebuild, night and rain are not shown in the preview.  [2026-11-07]

Made the full colour cars of the model wizard small and correct. The paint pictures go to the game as the right paint (the customizer's second colour is the first paint), the pictures are compressed (51 KB instead of 4 MB, a car with five paints 190 KB instead of 24 MB), and the swatches in the Paint tab show the body colour instead of a lamp colour. The wizard log tells how much of the model is wound inward. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the level editor manual to be easy to read: numbered pages with one line on top, a quick start, and new pages for settings, saving, the model wizard and troubleshooting. The text file has a contents list and 78 columns.  [2026-11-08]
Fixed the editor panel buttons showing over the manual, the settings window and the model wizard, and clicks reaching the editor buttons behind them.  [2026-11-08]

Changed the level editor manual to the format of old Windows help files: chapters with numbered topics, back and forward, one readable text size, full paragraphs with steps, notes and links, a full model wizard section and a glossary. The manual is English only for now.  [2026-11-08]

Rewrote every topic of the level editor manual as full text: settings, menus, selecting and moving, copy, textures, missions, scenes, saving, the guided tour and troubleshooting. The manual is English only for now.  [2026-11-08]

Made water tiles easy to select in the editor: a WATER ONLY button (also in Ctrl+K) makes clicks, hover and box select see water and nothing else, and SELECT WATER takes every water tile in view. Delete and undo work on them. Added a SURFACE row (sidewalk, grass, gravel, sand, shallow water, deep water) so a piece can set what the ground under it is made of: grip, tyre sound and drowning follow it, and it is saved in the edits file. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, NOT tried by hand. The Hide water toggle is not done.  [2026-11-08]

Added a search to the level editor manual: type while it is open and the page shows the matching places, a click goes there. Back, forward and close are plain arrow and cross buttons in a bar under the title, with arrows for the previous and next topic. Added a glossary of 115 words, an alphabetical INDEX topic, and index words in the text that are underlined links to the exact heading. The text manual has the same glossary and index. The new bar texts are translated in all languages, the glossary and index are English only. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the editor light marker. It was 12 times fainter than a street lamp, so it left no pool of light on the road. It now lights like a lamp at night, also after you leave the editor. The marker is a handle in the world now: you can click it, box it, drag it with the move tool, nudge it with the arrow keys, delete it and undo all of it. It also shows by day while the editor is open. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added a TEXTURE TOOLS section to the TEXTURE tab of the level editor. LOAD PICTURE takes the picture of the selected pieces (a picture of the pack or a texture of the game). Sliders for hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, levels and a three point curve, buttons for invert, grey and flips, a reduction to the 16 colours of a car texture with dither, a tile check that moves the picture by half so a seam shows, a seam score and the UV triangles over the picture. APPLY ADJUST saves the result as a new picture in the textures folder of the pack and puts the selected pieces on it, so Ctrl+Z brings the old picture back, the original and the disc data are never touched. Keys: Alt+Enter, Alt+Arrows, Alt+Delete. Texts in all languages. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the box select in WATER ONLY: a drag now always makes a box (also with the Move tool, which grabbed the tile before) and takes every water tile the box touches, not only the ones fully inside. SELECT WATER used a box 0 to 320 wide and missed the sides of a wide window, it covers the whole view now. Added ALL WATER (every water tile of the level, up to 3000 original faces), CONNECTED (the whole bay from the selected water) and HIDE WATER, and WATER ONLY draws everything that is not water dark. Added the keys Ctrl+W (water only), Ctrl+Shift+W (select water in view) and Ctrl+E (next surface), the buttons in the View tab, and texts in all languages. Water tiles of a Driver 2 city are a few big faces (Havana: about 4 in view), so the count can be small. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and Miami, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the editor settings window (Ctrl+,): its tabs and buttons could not be clicked any more since the windows that own the pointer came in, the click was held back from it. It gets the click again. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Clipped the scrolling editor panel to its own area: when the Mission tab (or any tab) is scrolled, the lines no longer draw over the tab rows and the top bar, and a click above the area no longer hits a hidden button. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic checks (every tab at 75 and 200 percent) and one picture. The ITEM list also no longer grows when the panel is scrolled.  [2026-11-08]

Added SELECT SAME TEXTURE: click one face, press SAME TEXTURE (Ctrl+T) and every flat face you can see with that texture is selected, so one click takes the whole water of a bay and the same works for a road or a floor. SAME: LEVEL takes the faces of the whole level (up to 6000 original faces) and SAME: TOUCHING grows from the selected face through the touching faces with that texture. FLAT ONLY keeps the faces within 15 degrees of level and can be switched off. The count shows on the status bar. Texts in all languages. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and Miami, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Changed SAME TEXTURE (button and Ctrl+T) to select every face of that texture in the whole level, not only what you see. The old 6000 face limit is gone: only a full editor (300000 triangles) stops it, and the status bar then says so. SAME: VIEW (Ctrl+Alt+T) keeps the small case. SAME: TOUCHING now follows faces whose boxes meet, because big water and ground tiles meet in the middle of an edge: in Miami it takes 12221 of the 13152 water faces from one click instead of 5. Texts changed in all languages. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added a TEXTURE TOOLS topic to the editor manual: the sliders, the switches, the buttons, the four Alt keys and where the new picture file goes. The SELECT + MOVE topic now explains SAME TEXTURE, WATER ONLY, ALL WATER, CONNECTED, HIDE WATER and the SURFACE chips. Added 8 glossary words and 23 index rows. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Changed SHARE LEVEL in the level editor to share only your own work. It zips your pack with your edits, also the ones a bake put aside, and your pictures and models, with no level data from your discs. The other player unpacks it into mods and it goes on their own copy of the city. The whole level moved to a new button, SHARE FULL LEVEL, which asks you to type YES and warns that it holds game data from your discs. rdcontent pack install now says which city a pack belongs to. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added exact moves to the level editor. Press C to move, V to turn or Z to change the size of the selection. The mouse moves it live, or you type a number (12.5, or 3,0,-2 for three directions) and Enter keeps it exactly. Esc or the right mouse button puts everything back. If you type a number while you drag, the drag turns into the typed move. The status bar shows the numbers. The keys are in the shortcut list and in Ctrl+K. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with the mouse.  [2026-11-08]

Added axis locks to the exact transforms of the level editor. While C, V or Z is going, press X (east), Y (up) or Z (north) to lock to that axis, or Shift with the key to lock to the plane without it. A line shows the axis, the same key unlocks, and a typed number follows the lock. Ctrl+K has three entries that start a move already locked. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with the mouse.  [2026-11-08]

Added soft selection to the exact transforms of the level editor. Press O while moving, turning or sizing: pieces near the selection follow with a smooth falloff. The mouse wheel sets the radius and a ring on the ground shows it. Ctrl+K has an entry that starts a move with it on. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with the mouse.  [2026-11-08]

Added more ways to select in the level editor. Ctrl+Numpad + grows the selection by one step and Ctrl+Numpad - shrinks it by one step. Shift+C turns on a circle brush that paints the selection (Ctrl takes pieces away, the wheel sets the size, Esc ends it) and a circle follows the mouse. Ctrl+K has entries for all of them and for select linked (the old key 5). Select all, none, invert, box select and same texture were there before. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with the mouse.  [2026-11-08]

Added an outliner and view modes to the level editor. The piece list now has a search (FIND..., a name, a number like #5 or a group name) and H and L buttons on every row: H hides a piece or a whole group while you edit (it is not drawn, picked or selected, and it is not saved), L locks it (drawn, but cannot be picked). Ctrl+H hides the selection, Ctrl+Alt+H shows everything. Shift+Z switches between the textured and a wireframe view, and Numpad 1, 3 and 7 (with Ctrl the other side) look along an axis at the selection as a flat view. There is no flat solid mode yet. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Extended the ruler of the level editor and the typed numbers. A measure click now snaps to a corner of a piece or of the original face near the cursor. Two points show distance, slope and heading, a third point shows the angle at the second point, a fourth starts again. In every typed number you can calculate (2*3, 12.5+4, (10-2)/4), also in the entry bars like type the X position, and an unfinished sum moves nothing. While a mouse transform runs, Shift makes the mouse ten times finer and Ctrl turns the grid snap the other way. The typed numbers are checked by automatic tests, the ruler numbers and the snap not yet. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added six editing tools to the level editor. Shift+X is a lasso: drag a free outline round pieces, it replaces the selection, Shift adds, Ctrl takes away, and the outline is drawn. Numpad 1, 3 and 7 give a flat view with no perspective, the wheel zooms, the middle button pans, a grid is drawn, and Numpad 5 switches back. The axis ball in the corner is clickable: a cap looks from that side, the centre from the opposite side, a drag turns the view. Numpad / is a local view that keeps only the selection until you press it again (it only hides pieces, not the original level, and your own hide and lock stay). The X, H and Z fields and DEGREES and SIZE can be dragged left and right (Shift finer, Ctrl coarser, one undo step), a click still types a number. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V over a field copy and paste its value. Known: in the flat view cars, people and rain are not flat and sit in the wrong place, and a front view at road level shows the water plane over the lower half. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Made the step list of the mission maker wrap over up to 4 lines so all steps show and no name is cut in the middle, named the rows of MAX SPEED, STEALTH, MAX DAMAGE and LIMIT TIME like their steps (all 21 languages had the names already), and put two close world labels (PICKUP and DROP OFF) one above the other. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Translated the new level editor buttons into all 20 languages: SAME TEXTURE, SAME: VIEW, SAME: TOUCHING, FLAT ONLY, ALL WATER, CONNECTED, HIDE WATER, SHARE FULL LEVEL, NEXT CAR, INVERT, BRIGHTNESS, CONTRAST and MISSION STEPS, plus the manual page names and the WATER tab (machine quality, NOT tried by hand: only the editor pictures in German, Greek, Japanese and Serbian were looked at).  [2026-11-09]

Hardened the geometry bake of the level editor. A bake of a patch over the same level file now writes beside it and moves it over, so a kill or a full disk leaves the old level whole. More than 32 patch files are refused with a message instead of dropping the rest. The list of rewritten geometry files cannot run over its end any more. The .bak copy for UNDO BAKE is written beside and renamed, a stale one is removed first, and UNDO BAKE only removes your baked copy once the kept one is in place. RESET LEVEL keeps the old .bak when there is no baked copy. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Wrote the missing manual topic BLENDER STYLE TOOLS for the level editor (also the F1 help in the game). It explains the typed moves C, V and Z with sums, the X Y Z and Shift axis locks, soft selection with O, circle and lasso select, select linked, grow and shrink, the piece list with search, hide and lock, the flat Numpad views and the local view, draggable number fields with copy and paste of values, and the ruler. Every key was checked in the code first. Added glossary words and index rows, shortened the long labels of the shortcut table, and made the text manual new from the sources, so the shortcut page now lists the new keys too. The topic is English only like the rest of the manual. NOT tried by hand, the game was not run.  [2026-11-09]
Fixed the deleted level objects of your edits and of installed packs being added a second time every time the city restarts. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed a custom mission text that is longer in another language (German, French) than the file: the next level data overwrote the end of the texts. The game now keeps the longer size. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed the mission maker steps ESCAPE, TAIL, STOP, SPEED and POLICE after a restart: they kept the state of the first try (ESCAPE ended without any police, STOP kept its old count). Their state now starts fresh with every mission load. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]
Added a yellow box around everything that is selected in the editor, with the piece count over it, so you can see what the move tool will move. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]

Fixed the axis gizmo in the level editor showing and taking clicks under an open window (manual, entry bar, file browser, wizard, settings). Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]
Fixed the yellow selection box around a turned ramp: it now turns with the selection and fits it, not a big straight box with long lines running off the screen. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]

Fixed the editor markers that could be picked but not moved (the lamps of the Goose Island pack). Moving, resizing, renaming or deleting a marker of another pack now copies it into your own pack and hides the original there, so the other pack is never changed. Added a legend, a hover plate that says what a marker is, rings and names only for the picked marker (VIEW tab can show all), a marker list that flies to the marker, and duplicate and rename. Texts in all languages, machine translated. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]

Rebuilt how the editor takes a mouse click: one fixed order (panels, handles, markers, pieces, empty space) and one drag state. Esc now cancels a drag and puts the pieces back, and a lost mouse release no longer leaves a drag or the look mode stuck. The move arrows, plane squares, turn rings and a new scale cube also work on the picked marker (arrows only) and sit at the centre of the selection box; the key ' changes the pivot. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-11]

Fixed the editor manual generator. It now reads the marker panel again, no longer misses the pivot key rows and the light pools, and makes the button page sizes itself. The manual and the button help are regenerated. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Made hover, click and the T cycle agree in the editor: one pick service now answers pieces, original faces, level objects and water, and walks the level once per ray. Mission points can be picked with a click and moved with the arrows and the ground square like markers; Esc puts one back. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Added a race course tool to the editor. The checkpoints you place become a course: set the name, kind, laps, prize and the start pad, save it into your pack (courses of the game stay) and test drive it from the pad. Help topic added, 20 languages by hand. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

Fixed the car moving when you leave the level editor: it now stays where it was when you opened the editor, same turn and same speed. Shift+F6 still puts it at the camera. Also switched off a stuck mouse capture, so the pointer stays free over the editor panels. NOT tried by hand, only the editor logchecks ran.  [2026-11-14]

Added SLICE SOLID: cuts the selected collision box in two at the cursor (button, Edit menu, Ctrl+Shift+X, one undo step). The picture stays the same. 8 new texts in 21 languages. Also added two test beds: Duplicate copies every field of every face (vertices byte for byte) and select, deselect and the edits file text change nothing. NOT tried by hand, only the logchecks editdupcheck and editboxtool ran.  [2026-11-14]

Added two more pivot choices to the level editor, the active piece and each piece on its own (turn and scale then work about the middle of every piece), and a 3D cursor you can see: a click puts it (Ctrl+'), it jumps to the selection (Alt+') or to the world origin (Alt+Shift+'). The help screen, the tool search and 20 languages have the new keys. NOT tried by hand, only the editpivot test and the unit test ran, and I looked at one picture.  [2026-11-14]

Added snapping to the level editor: hold the key left of 1 while you drag a piece on the ground and its nearest corner jumps onto a corner of another piece (Shift: the middle of a face), with a ring on the target. Added nine saved selection sets: Ctrl+Shift+1 to 9 saves the selection, Alt+1 to 9 selects it again. The sets live while the editor runs, they are not written to the edits file. NOT tried by hand, only the editsnap and editselset tests ran.  [2026-11-14]

Added merge by distance to the level editor (Alt+M): corners of the selected pieces that lie within a quarter of the step size of each other become one, so seams between hand placed pieces close, and triangles that lose their area are dropped. One undo step. Mirror, array and turning the faces around were already there. NOT tried by hand, only the editweld test and the unit test ran.  [2026-11-14]

Added resize handles and a size field for solid collision boxes. With the SCALE tool a selected solid box shows a square on every face; drag one to move that face, the opposite face stays, and the grid step snaps it. The panel has a BOX row (X, height, Z) you can drag or type into, and Ctrl+Alt with the arrow and Page keys resizes by the step. One undo step per change, saved in the edits file and baked like any piece. Texts are in 20 languages (the manual paragraphs are English only). Tested by automatic checks only, NOT tried by hand with a real mouse.  [2026-11-15]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the level editor to say how many triangles a dropped 3D model placed, and that it was cut at 18000 when it was bigger. A drop only adds pieces and never hides or deletes anything of the level.  [2026-11-05]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed FBX models painted in the modeller without pictures coming out flat grey in the car wizard, the plain colour of each material is read now.  [2026-11-05]
Not Hand Tested: Fixed the outlines of a selected object showing through the texture strip at the bottom of the editor, they stop at the edge of the 3D view now.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Changed the model wizard defaults and the paints after the second dark car report. The car now starts at the highest detail and in full colour (before it was 25 percent of the triangles and a 256 pixel picture of 15 colours). Full colour cars now have paints too, one picture per paint. A paint picture that is much darker than the base picture (the Red variant of the Suspicious Car) is lifted so it does not give a muddy car. The wizard checks the winding of the model and turns it when it is wrong.  [2026-11-07]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed picking in the level editor: a piece that lies behind the ground (like the water under a shore) is not lit or picked any more, so what is under the crosshair is what you get. A click on a gizmo arrow or ring always grabs it before anything else is picked, nothing is lit while the pointer is on a handle, and the crosshair is always drawn, in the middle of the view when the pointer is on a panel.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Fixed the editor view washing out white and grainy by day when light markers were placed (the Auto Exchange lot). The editor now lights the scene like the game: lamps only at dusk and night. A new LIGHT POOLS switch in the VIEW tab shows the marker pools by day if you want to see them, off by default. Fixed the small texture square that stayed on the 3D view after the texture strip was closed.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Reworked the editor overlays: one colour table now, so hover, selection, markers, places, water and collision each have their own colour. Added a legend, WATER ONLY and FLAT ONLY chips, and a status line with what is under the pointer and how much is selected. The TEXTURE panel shows the sampled texture. Lights can be warm, white, cool, red or green, with a strength and a by-day switch, and the ring of a marker can be dragged. The places of the Auto Exchange (repair pad, showroom door, lot stalls) show up as markers and can be moved and saved in your pack.  [2026-11-11]

Not Hand Tested: Added to the level editor: frame the selection (Numpad . or Ctrl+F) or everything (Shift+Numpad . or Ctrl+Shift+F), nine camera views (Ctrl+1 to 9 go there, Ctrl+Shift+1 to 9 save), TO GROUND (Ctrl+Shift+D), TO FACE, TO GRID, SPREAD Y and SAME HEIGHT for the selection, and PLAY HERE that drives from the selection and comes back with Esc or F6 to the same view. After a crash the editor asks RECOVER or DISCARD when the autosave is newer than your saved edits, the status line says how long ago it was written, and REVERT throws away everything since the last save (Ctrl+Z brings it back). The OBJECTS tab has a search box, a double click places the object at the crosshair and TURN lets you place it turned. Fixed the autosave file path being cut in a long game folder, and a hover that could point past the end of the piece list after a delete or undo. Texts are in all languages.  [2026-11-12]

Not Hand Tested: Added LOAD COURSE to the race course tool: pick a saved course by its id and its checkpoints come back as CHECKPT markers in the same order, with name, kind, laps, prize and start pad. Checkpoints can now carry names (optional pname lines in the races file, old files load as before), and saving a course no longer adds an empty line to the file each time. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-12]

sections.title: Modding and Tools for Modders
lines: Fixed mods with a DRIVER2 folder (like BetterCars) doing nothing, because the shipped settings switched them off. They are switched on now.  [2026-10-14]
Added the whole editor manual as a text file in the package.  [2026-10-15]
Updated the modding guide for car packs, traffic cars, the new option keys and how damaged files are handled.  [2026-10-16]
Added the Driver 1 cities folder and the gas station file to the README.  [2026-10-19]
Wrote down the formats of jobs.txt and fares.txt in the modding guide.  [2026-10-21]
Added a level file reader to the test tools that dumps the contents of Driver 1 and Driver 2 level files.  [2026-10-21]
Replaced the old mission tool with a new one that can extract, dump, build and check missions. It makes the same files as before for all 137 missions of the game.  [2026-10-21]
Replaced the old mod pack tool with a new one that can make, check, pack, install and list mods. The zip files are a bit bigger but hold the same files.  [2026-10-21]
Moved the chase and cutscene tool to C. It can turn recorded replays into chase and cutscene bundles, with the same result as before.  [2026-10-21]
Moved the car sound tool to C. It makes the looped engine sound files for a car, byte for byte what the old tool made.  [2026-10-21]
Moved the road and city label tool to C. It writes the street names for Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, the same files as before.  [2026-10-21]
Updated the modder guides for the new mission, pack and chase tools, and the package now ships the content tool.  [2026-10-21]

Moved the translation tools to C. They can export the language texts, pull the subtitles and credits headings from the discs, write the editor help list and build the setup language table, and they check the setup keys.  [2026-10-21]
Moved the Driver 1 car and level viewers to C.  [2026-10-21]
Moved the disc tools to C. They read files from a disc image and open a PlayStation program (Gran Turismo too).  [2026-10-21]
Changed an unknown command line option to get logged instead of opening a help window, the help opens for -help, -h and -?.  [2026-10-21]
Added a check to the translation tool that finds a text key translated two different ways in two language files.  [2026-10-22]
Added a test tool command that finds the gas stations of a Driver 2 city in the level data.  [2026-10-22]
Added a content tool option that lists the lumps and chunk sizes of a level file.  [2026-10-22]
Added replacing the pages of a car with a PNG (cars/name.png).  [2026-10-22]
Changed BetterCars style PAGE_n TIM files to reach the borrowed cars of other cities.  [2026-10-22]
Added a car modding handbook (scale, axes, names, textures, performance sheet and the Car Creator flow); imported cars use their real performance by default.  [2026-10-22]
Added car templates for modders: scale reference boxes per vehicle class and a low poly sedan as OBJ files in metres.  [2026-10-22]
Added a test tool command that prints car model sizes in game units and metres for Driver 2, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars.  [2026-10-22]
Added a performance sheet for a car to the content tool.  [2026-10-22]
Added pinned performance sheets for the Driver 2 and Driver 1 cars.  [2026-10-22]
Added a Gran Turismo car record to sheet mapping to the test tools.  [2026-10-22]
Added a test tool command that writes Driver 2 level textures as PNG in the override layout.  [2026-10-22]
Added a test tool command that turns edited PNGs back into 4 bit TIM files.  [2026-10-22]
Updated the modding guide and tools list, added a chapter on dumping textures with a road texture template, and wrote down the rules for mods on borrowed cars.  [2026-10-22]
Added a car model builder that turns an OBJ model and a PNG texture into a game car, with wheel position, centre of gravity and collision points filled in.  [2026-10-23]

Added the Car Creator, a window (reDriver_CarCreator.exe) where you fill in a car sheet, see a preview, run the checks and build the car, and made it keep game folder paths out of its messages.  [2026-10-23]
Added a content tool command that prints the car catalog of a game or mod folder without starting the game.  [2026-10-23]
Added commands to the content tool to import and check content packages, and a city can be read from its level file. This is on by default now (contentLoader=1 in config.ini).  [2026-10-23]
Changed the Car Creator quick test to also switch the performance sheet on, and to put your own settings files back when the game exits.  [2026-10-23]
Added usage help for the sheet, car, package, screenshot test and release check tool commands.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the release build to ship reDriver_CarCreator.exe next to the game and in the ModTools zip.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the test tool reading past the end of a file in a damaged level lump.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the test tool reading a disc image folder past the image, and following a folder that lists itself.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the test tool crashing on a damaged JPEG, the segment length is checked first.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the test tool checking texture counts in 32 bit, a huge count read far past the lump.  [2026-10-24]
Fixed the test tool reading the Driver 1 car view table out of the lump with a bad texture count.  [2026-10-24]
Put the cars handbook into the tools folder of the game package and into the ModTools zip.  [2026-10-24]
Added the level file (.level), one zip with the whole city, with a tool to pack, unpack, list and check it, and the game reads a .level directly.  [2026-10-25]
Added a list of every object in a city with a stable number, and level patch files, so a level can have things removed from it and the game removes them (picture and collision).  [2026-10-25]
Added a tool that turns the objects you deleted in the editor into a level patch.  [2026-10-25]

Gave level patches a second format with hidden faces and added pieces, one shared library for the tools and the game, and a level rebuild. The editor opens the hidden faces and piece layers so you can edit them.  [2026-10-25]

Changed a .level to be able to carry the missions of its city (a missions folder with a checked list). The game cannot start them from there yet, it still loads the mission files from the MISSIONS folder.  [2026-10-25]
Added the car file (.car), one zip per car, with a tool to pack, unpack, list, check, hash, export and convert old car files into it.  [2026-10-25]
Wrote a docs pass for the game folder, car and level files, patches, mission tools and the installer, and added MODDING_files.txt.  [2026-10-26]
Changed city files to carry the whole city, the roads, cell lists, models and pages, and added a compare command that checks them against the discs byte for byte.  [2026-10-27]
Added a tool that reads the Driver 1 PC levels and compares them with the PlayStation ones, the PC Newcastle level is the PC version of the credits level.  [2026-10-27]
Changed the Driver 2 car mod tool to write a car file with its flags, no .d1c and no index line.  [2026-10-27]
Changed the car convert command to also take a mod's cars folder, so a mod with .d1c cars turns into car files.  [2026-10-27]
Added a second route that builds the Driver 1 city level files with the player start taken from the original game table, and a compare command, Miami looks the same.  [2026-10-27]
Updated the README and the modding guide with the light presets, dynamic weather, police patrols, shader cache, profile slots, console commands and tweak keys.  [2026-10-28]
Fixed the car handbook, the modding files and the Car Creator quick test. The quick test now only turns the performance sheet on.  [2026-10-30]

Changed the README and the modding guides to match the game today: the Driver 1 disc and its missions mod, the multiplayer picker, Switch Pro pads, Portuguese in the language list, and the real game mode names.  [2026-11-01]

Moved BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes by Commando52Colton into the game as built in packs. They are always on, load right after the core pack and no longer show in the mod list. NOT tried by hand: how the game looks with the packs.  [2026-11-03]

Split the game log in two: a small player log with what a bug report needs (your Windows user name is cut from its paths) and a developer log that is off by default and testers can switch on. Lines about a damaged or refused file are warnings in the player log.  [2026-11-03]

Changed the 26 binary subtitle files of the speech into one plain text file (DRIVER2/XA/XA_SUBTITLES.TXT): per speech a track line, then one line per cue with start frame, end frame and the English text (130 cues). The game reads it with a range checked parser. Other languages work as before, the cue text is still the key in localizations/*/subtitles.txt.  [2026-11-03]
Fixed a damaged level file crashing the game on load. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed a changed progress.sav with a car model or paint that does not exist crashing the continue point. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed a sound file with a loop point past its data making the game crash or hang on that sound. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added extra physics values to the car sheet for modders, all set to the Driver 2 numbers by default. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Extended the level checks so a damaged level cannot make the game read outside its data. A damaged .level in a mod no longer takes the city away: the game falls back to the level of the base game. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]
Added a cockpit line to the car effects file so a car can set where the driver eye sits. (experimental, off by default, not finished)  [2026-11-06]

Changed the model wizard so a dropped car is fitted to the length of the Chicago car of its body type by default (5.0 m for a sedan), whatever unit the finder guessed. The SCALE slider adjusts by hand from there, a typed length or unit still wins, and the car page says FITTED TO THE CHICAGO CAR or OWN SIZE. A model that came out 3.97 m next to the 5.0 m outline now comes out 5.0 m, and 4.0 m at 80 percent. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added solid wheels to the model wizard 3D preview (car page and tweak page): the game's wheel face on a dark tyre at each wheel, with a WHEELS button and the R key to switch back to the wire rings. Textured wheels are the default and the choice is kept while the game runs; outside a level the rings are shown. New texts in all languages. Pictures looked at (low resolution), NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the model wizard window so it opens in the middle of the screen on every page and screen shape, and you can drag it by its title bar. It stays inside the screen and keeps its place until the wizard is opened again. All buttons, rows, sliders and the 3D view follow the moved window. Checked by automatic tests for 4:3, 16:9 and 21:9, NOT tried by hand with a real mouse.  [2026-11-07]
