Fixed the model wizard not finding a texture when the folder holds colour variants. A model that wants 'Texture.png' next to 'Texture White.png', 'Texture Black.png' and more now takes the white (else grey, else first) one as the picture and the others as paints, and a mask picture is left out. The car page and the log say which files were used. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the model wizard car looking wrong with a texture sheet. The 3D preview now cuts big triangles into small ones so the picture can be read, and flat sheet art is cut to 16 colours without dither dots. The saved car was looked at in the game from the side. NOT tried by hand with a real model.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the editor side panel scrolling the mission parameters first. The wheel now scrolls the list under the mouse, and the whole panel everywhere else and when the list is at its end. NOT tried by hand, a new automatic test moves the wheel over the list and the margin.  [2026-11-07]

Added undo and redo to the mission maker and the scene tab (Ctrl+Z on the tab), and a DELETE SCENE button. A scene without items no longer plays, a clip needs an avi file first, and line breaks in mission and scene texts no longer break the saved files. NOT tried by hand, new automatic tests run every button function of both tabs.  [2026-11-07]

Added a picture naming rule for imported models: texture.png is the base picture and texture_<paint>.png is one paint each (up to 18), looked for in the model's folder and in its textures folder, any letter case. Other names still work as before. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added a PICTURES page to the model wizard. It lists every picture found next to the model and in its textures folder, suggests a role (base, paint or ignore) and a name from the file names, lets you change both, and checks the names as you type. CONTINUE stays grey until they are right. The PICTURES... button on the car page opens it any time. The model's folder is never renamed. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand with the real car.  [2026-11-07]

Changed the model wizard DETAIL row to four steps: 400, 500, 700 and ORIGINAL (up to the 1000 vertices and 1000 triangles the car format takes), with the model's own triangle count shown next to it and a warning only over the limit. The 3D preview now follows the TEXTURES row, so full colour shows all colours of the picture smoothly, and it cuts texture sheet triangles finer. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added config/keyboard_layouts.ini: it changes keys of the WASD and IJKL layouts or adds a fourth keyboard layout for split screen. A file with a mistake is ignored and says so in the log. Written up in MODDING_files.txt part 9. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Updated the modder guides: car files with up to 19 paints, car effects files, pop-up lids, cars from the model wizard, the new traffic and camera settings, the mod pack layout and one list of the tool commands.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the modder guides and the tool help text where they did not match the code: the rdcontent help had a broken line and left out the level, car and mission commands, the guides listed a console command and a tool (FontTool) that do not exist, the keyboard layouts file is shipped as a sample, RESET LEVEL keeps a backup now, and the translation list was missing four languages. Added a recipes section (car pack, level pack, translation, music and sound, mission) and a description of the edits file lines, including water and ground material. The sample car and mission commands were run to check the steps; the game was not started.  [2026-11-08]

Hardened two mod text readers. A very long line in an ini or text file no longer turns its tail into a second setting, and a mod job file can no longer set a negative or huge pay or time limit. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]
Fixed the texture page unpacker so a damaged level or car texture can no longer write up to 127 bytes in front of its page. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed a hang in the car sound loader: a damaged .wav in a mod with a huge chunk size made the game read the same chunk for ever. It now stops and the sound is skipped. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]
Hardened the zip reader of rdcontent pack install against damaged zips (offsets and sizes near 4 GB). Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Brought the modder guides up to date with the work of 2026-11-08. Wrote down the per profile save files (slotstate.sav, fare_serial.ini format 2, damaged files moved to .bad), what SHARE LEVEL zips (a patch pack, no level data) and what SHARE FULL LEVEL is, the water file name rule and the replaces water line, collision shape 3, the _adj texture files, the keys of keyboard seats in the car picker, and the newest options (Smart Racer AI, Windscreen Rain, Carry Fuel Over). Fixed the Driver 1 import notes (all 100 Trail Blazer checkpoints, WaitSeconds as a WAIT step) and added the STOP, SPEED and POLICE targets to the mission guide. Checked each claim against the code and the tool output. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Made the zip reader of the game (levels, cars, share patches) read zip64 files, and refuse password protected zips with a clear message instead of garbage. The rdcontent reader refuses them too. Plain zips read the same as before. Checked with 1441 generated zips (zip64, encrypted, cut and damaged records). NOT tried by hand with a real big zip.  [2026-11-09]

Added look files and .cube LUT import to photo mode: Save Look File writes your sliders as a small text file in photo_looks, and any .cube colour table you put in photo_luts can be picked and mixed in with a strength slider. A damaged file is skipped with a line in the log. The formats are in MODDING_files.txt. LightCraft by the ArtCraft Team (MIT) is credited in the credits and the third party notices. NOT tried by hand, a real LUT from a colour program was not tried.  [2026-11-09]

Let a mod pack bring its own driving network. A file ai/racer_neural_v2.rdpol or ai/cop_neural_v1.rdpol in a pack replaces the one of the Core pack. The last pack in load order with a good file wins. A damaged file is skipped with a line in the log and the next pack below is used, down to Core, and then the normal AI. It is written down in MODDING_files. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Made the level loader and the event setup safer against damaged data. A level pack with a huge sector number, a negative file offset or a bad bridge and train table is now cut off at the end of the file or table (with one line in the log) instead of reading or writing past it. Valid levels load as before. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Fixed rdcontent pack install so a pack zip cannot write over the files of an installed mod (the level edits of the Core pack, for example) with a member name like x:reDriver 2 Extended Core/edits_0.txt. Names with a colon, dot dot parts, an absolute path, control characters or a Windows device name (CON, NUL, COM1) are refused before anything is written. Checked by automatic tests, and a crafted zip was refused when tried by hand against a scratch mods folder.  [2026-11-10]

Added the pictures of every car to the game: 1522 thumbnails and 1522 sepia photos, 102 MB, made by one command (rdcontent car photos) with a manifest and a check. They ship with the game, also the ones of the Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars, so the setup does not draw them again. Only the cars of mods still get drawn on install.  [2026-11-11]

Fixed small things in the content tool for modders: checking a .car file no longer warns about its own temp folder, a mission written as text no longer names an old Python tool in its first line, and the help texts no longer point at internal notes. Checked by running the commands on a sample car and the sample mission. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-13]

Added reDriver_ModTools.exe, one program for mod makers. Double click it for a numbered menu: make a new mod from a starter, check a mod, show what a mod changes, pack it into a zip, install a zip, list mods, make a car from a 3D model, turn a mission into text and back. A mod folder or a zip dropped on it is checked or installed and the window stays open. 13 starters with remarks in every file (options, HUD colours, a car with a working sample, a mission that plays, story scene, city changes, translation, sounds, jobs, weather, road textures, radio station, empty). The check names the file, the line and what to do, for mod.json, options, themes, cars, missions, translations, jobs, weather, tyres and more. Unit test with 98 checks: every starter passes its own check and 27 broken mods get the right message. NOT tried by hand: nobody has double clicked it or dropped a folder on it yet, and no mod maker has tried it.  [2026-11-13]

Rewrote the modding docs for people who are not programmers. New: MODDING_START_HERE.txt (a first mod in 10 minutes, step by step) and one short page per job: a car, a mission, city changes, a translation, sounds, a radio station, textures, options and HUD colours, sharing and installing. MODDING_tools.txt now starts with the new program and its menu. The big reference MODDING_files.txt got a table of contents and its section numbers are in order again (tyres is section 30). Removed a stale line that said level files need a config switch. Every command in the new pages was run. NOT tried by hand: no mod maker has followed the pages yet.  [2026-11-13]

Raised the car model limit from 1024 to 4096 vertices and polygons for the main model of a car. The two small levels of detail keep 1024, so far away traffic stays cheap. Cars with more than 1024 vertices make a car file of version 4. Cars up to 1024 load exactly as before. Unit tests and the second PC ran it, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Taught the mod check to catch typing slips. A misspelt option in tweaks.ini or an entry in mod.json now says 'Did you mean ambcar?', an option set twice is named, and texture pictures (.TIM) are checked for damage and for the right PAGE folder. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic test of the tool ran.  [2026-11-14]

Added a mod doctor to the mod tools (menu 10, or the command doctor). It looks at all your mods together: the order the game loads them in, one line per mod, and every place where two mods bring the same file, a needed mod is missing, or one mod is there twice. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic test and one run on the dev mods folder.  [2026-11-14]

Added a Make a mod tab to the project page. It walks through a first mod step by step with the real commands: make it, change it, check it, try it, look at all mods together, share it. NOT tried by hand: the page was built and leak scanned, not looked at in a browser.  [2026-11-14]

Added Check Mods and Open Mods Folder to Options > Mods (main menu and pause menu). Check Mods says in plain words what is wrong: load order, a mod that needs another that is missing, off or loads later, two folders for one mod, mods.ini lines with no folder, and mistyped names with Did you mean. Under the selected mod the list shows a line like Two mods change the same file: x.txt: Beta wins over Alpha. All texts are in the 21 languages. Tick hash 184 ok, screenshots looked at with 3 test mods. NOT tried by hand: Open Mods Folder, pad control.  [2026-11-14]
Added the night light options (round light glow, lamp light on trees) to the list of known options of the mod check, so they are no longer reported as mistyped. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

sections.title: Install and Setup
lines: Changed the setup to accept disc images inside .zip and .7z archives, and .rar gets a plain message to unpack it first.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the Gran Turismo 2 row and the summary of the setup to say that the engine sounds are made too, in all languages.  [2026-10-15]
Added Gran Turismo and Gran Turismo 2 disc rows to the setup wizard, and the welcome page lists the Gran Turismo discs.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the setup to make the wheel designs for the customizer from the Driver 1, Driver 2 and Gran Turismo 2 discs.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the setup to convert the four Driver 1 cities itself.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the setup to make the loading pictures of the Driver 1 cities.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the setup to let the game build the city maps at the end of the install, in a hidden window, and put them behind the Driver 1 loading pictures.  [2026-10-15]
Put the version 0.3.1-beta in the game log, the pause menu and the setup.  [2026-10-15]
Changed the game to run silent while the setup builds the city maps.  [2026-10-19]
Moved the Gran Turismo 1 wheel designs into the setup. They are off by default because the Gran Turismo 1 rims looked bad at the Driver 2 wheel size.  [2026-10-21]
Made the setup convert the Driver 2 car mod to .d1c files itself, so the setup is the only converter you need.  [2026-10-21]
Changed Linux to run through Proton (Steam Play) and added a new Linux readme. The old Linux installer is gone.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the README files so they name the right profile folders for the files the game creates.  [2026-10-22]
Removed the upscaled high quality sky from the setup (the Sharper skies step from 2026-10-15) and from the release checks.  [2026-10-23]

Changed the game to look for its files in a new GAME_DATA folder sorted by type (cars, sounds, HUD, maps, textures, objects, demos, translations, Driver 1 cities, radio, profiles), the old places are only a fallback.  [2026-10-25]
Moved the yellow cab repaint, the car effects and the editor textures of the Core pack into the GAME_DATA folder.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the setup and the release to write the new GAME_DATA folders, the discs go to GAME_DISCS, screenshots go to your profile, and a tool moves an old game folder to the new layout.  [2026-10-25]

Changed the setup into a real installer with the game inside the exe: you pick the folder, it makes the shortcuts, an uninstaller and an Apps and features entry, and it checks the runtime.  [2026-10-25]

Gave the installer an old school look: a welcome page with a picture, a license page, white pages with a red header line and a grey button bar. A progress page with red bars and a big step title, and a last page with the picture and a coloured result list.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the installer to ask for the Driver 2 discs on their own page, then one disc page with a tick box per extra, an extra that is ticked without a disc is refused.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the setup to write every converted Driver 1 and Gran Turismo car as one .car file and to remove the plain file.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the release package to carry the Core edits as one patch file per city, with loud warnings for anything a patch cannot express.  [2026-10-25]
Changed the setup to build the city files for installs and updates (buildLevels), with a dry run and a levels-only mode.  [2026-10-26]
Turned on content loader, texture manager, Driver 2 car files, car scan, Smooth Night and level build by default, every key can be set back.  [2026-10-26]
Changed updates to move old defaults to the new ones once, a changed value stays, and the old file is kept as config.ini.before_flip.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the setup to make only car files. The car list order, flags and pop-up lights are inside each car file now.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed the language key in the shipped config, it is spelled languageId now so the setup can set the language.  [2026-10-27]
Fixed a fresh install logging a car called # when the start car line only held a comment.  [2026-10-27]
Changed a level rebuild to keep the old city file once as .level.old.  [2026-10-28]
Added a warning in the game log and the setup result when a city file is outdated and is not rebuilt.  [2026-10-28]

Added the shared game files to the setup: cars, city pictures, cutscene replays, trails and multiplayer arena maps (120 files, about 28 MB) are taken from the Driver 2 disc next to the game, so the game no longer reads them from the disc image. If the game is already installed, run the setup once (repair) to add them. Files you changed are kept.  [2026-10-30]

Removed the -cdimage option and the [cdfs] image key of config.ini. The game never reads a disc image any more, the discs are only used by the setup. An old config.ini with the section still loads.  [2026-10-30]
Changed the setup to build the Driver 1 Missions mod by itself when the Driver 1 disc is given, no command is needed any more. The Driver 1 movies option follows the movies checkbox.  [2026-11-01]

Fixed the release package: the main menu music and the five attract demos were missing from a clean install and are packed now. The setup also no longer deletes the shipped Gran Turismo 2 lamp and exhaust files when it converts the Gran Turismo cars.  [2026-11-01]

Removed the Chicago Caprice mod from the game, so the package carries two bundled mods, BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes. It is gone from the release list, the readmes and the credits screen.  [2026-11-02]

Added credits for Commando52Colton (BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes) and Nikkichan92 (Vegas and Rio night road textures) to the third-party notices and to the package list. The files are used and updated with their permission.  [2026-11-02]

Changed the credit for the platform layer: Psynapse is our own platform layer, started from PsyCross and rewritten, with no PsyCross code left and the MIT notices kept. The same wording stands in the readme, licence and package list. Removed the PsyCross banner picture. NOT tried by hand, text only.  [2026-11-03]

Fixed the Miami level edits not applying on a fresh install. The Miami patch was made from an old Driver 1 Miami level and failed on every item. The test install now builds all 11 levels and bakes the Miami and New York patches. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-04]
Changed the uninstaller so it no longer starts ping.exe to wait before it deletes itself. Some security tools treat ping.exe as suspicious. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-04]
Fixed the setup loading its files only from the Windows folder and refusing odd archive names, and fixed the path of the runtime installer. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Added version information to the game exe and took two debugging parts out of it, so virus scanners have less reason to flag it. The uninstaller no longer starts a hidden command window. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the setup crashing on a damaged .7z archive, and added tests for the zip and 7z readers of the setup. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Made the setup cut the semi truck out of the Chicago level of Driver 2 disc 1: a Semi Truck, a Semi Truck with Trailer and the trailer as a hidden part. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]

Made the game start in the language you picked in the setup: a fresh install writes it into config\language.ini, and a game with no saved language now follows the language of Windows (English if there is no match). An update never changes a language you saved. The setup window itself still has 13 languages, so Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese Windows get their language only through the Windows fallback. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-07]

Added a Driv3r step to the setup: it makes the 39 Driv3r pedestrians (models and walk, run and idle animations) from your own PlayStation 2 Driv3r disc into cache\driv3r_peds, which the game reads for Pedestrian Models. New disc row Driv3r (PlayStation 2) in the setup, or --driv3r <.iso> on the command line. A disc that is not found is skipped, a wrong disc is explained, a failed run keeps the old set. Tried by the tests and a real run into a scratch folder with the game seeing the people. NOT tried by hand: the setup window with the new row.  [2026-11-07]

Fixed the setup window at 125, 150 and 200 percent screen scaling and in long languages: the text was not scaled with the window, rows touched by a pixel, the status lines under the disc rows and the extras note were cut off with all five extras ticked, the movies tick box sat on the button bar, the buttons of the last page were too narrow in Greek, Spanish, Romanian and Hungarian, and two Greek Gran Turismo lines were too long. Found by the new automatic layout test, checked by pictures at 100 and 150 percent in English, German and Russian. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]
Changed the README to a short front part with what is in the game, the install steps, config, known problems and how to report a bug. The long reference follows it.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed the setup window at 125 and 200 percent screen scaling: the Back button now follows the chosen language, the word column of the result list is wide enough for long words like fehlgeschlagen, and the result list rows grow with the scale so letters are no longer cut. Looked at every page in all languages by automatic screenshots, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added Slovene (Slovenscina): the game texts, the options, the pause menu, jobs, CB radio, subtitles and the level editor labels, and the setup window. Machine quality translation, reviewers welcome. The long level editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand, no pictures looked at yet.  [2026-11-08]

Added Serbian (Latin script, Srpski) to the game and the setup window: menus, options, HUD, jobs, CB radio, subtitles, editor labels and all setup texts. Machine quality translation, written by hand but not checked by a native speaker, reviewers welcome. The editor manual paragraphs stay English. The loc check ran, the pictures were not tried by hand. A Cyrillic version could follow later.  [2026-11-08]

Added the Ukrainian language (??????????) to the game and the setup window: every game text, the options, menus, radio, jobs and the editor, and the setup pages. It is a machine quality translation, reviewers are welcome. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic text checks and the screenshots of the main menu, pause menu, options, car select and setup welcome page.  [2026-11-08]

Added Croatian (Hrvatski) as a new language: the game texts, the editor labels, the CB radio and job texts, the subtitles and the setup window are translated by hand. Machine quality translation, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Updated the language count in the README: the game now has 21 languages with Ukrainian, Croatian, Slovene and Serbian. The four new ones are machine quality translations and reviewers are welcome.  [2026-11-08]

Translated the texts that were added after the first Ukrainian round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated the texts that were added after the first Croatian round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated the texts that were added after the first Slovene round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated the texts that were added after the first Serbian (Latin) round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts, and about 190 editor tool tips and labels that were still English. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated more of the later texts into Ukrainian: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated more of the later texts into Croatian: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated more of the later texts into Slovene: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Translated more of the later texts into Serbian (Latin): the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Added the Smart Cop and Smart Racer AI policy files (ai folder of the Core pack) to the package, so a clean install finds them. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand, no package built.  [2026-11-09]

Changed the README: red2ex is the home of the project (project page and release downloads), and the source snapshot follows there after the release. The red2ex link in the third party notices stays.  [2026-11-09]

Went through the setup code for the uninstaller, the registry entry, the path and disc handling. The install folder from the registry is cut cleanly when the value has no end mark, the temp folder of the uninstall is checked, the runtime installer messages show the right path (a backslash v was printed as a tab), a damaged Nero disc image with a huge chunk length no longer reads past its data in the 32 bit setup, and a disc image whose folders point back at themselves stops with an error instead of running for ever. NOT tried by hand, no disc was installed.  [2026-11-09]

Hardened the Gran Turismo 2 disc reader of the setup. A damaged GT2.VOL whose folders point back at each other is refused at once instead of running for ever, a car archive index outside the entry count is refused, and a car model cut off in the middle of a polygon is refused before it is read. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Hardened the wheel reader of the setup. A damaged Driver 1 or Driver 2 level file on a disc image with wild counts, offsets or sizes is refused instead of read out of bounds, and a wheel picture that leaves its texture page is skipped. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Hardened the zip reader of the setup. A zip whose data inflates to far more than the size it announces is stopped after 64 KB with an error instead of filling the temp folder, failed seeks and a failed name allocation are checked now. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Hardened the disc reader of the setup. File names of a disc image that are empty, are dots, or hold a slash, a backslash, a colon or a control character are skipped, so a damaged or hostile image cannot make the setup create folders or video files outside the game data folder. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed two small leaks in the setup: the shared disc data step left the disc image open, and the Gran Turismo 1 chrome texture read kept a buffer when it failed. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Made the setup's level step tell you why a level was not made. Before, the reason (for example a missing city description file) was only written to a developer log line that the release build drops, so the setup just said 0 levels. Now it is in the log as a warning. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Rewrote the texts of the setup to say what it really does now: the first screen names Driver 1 for the PlayStation and the PC, Gran Turismo 1 and 2 and the Driv3r pedestrians, the summary lists the Driver 1 missions and the level data, maps and car pictures the game makes, and the end screen tells about the reD2ex Radio station. All the other languages of the setup are translated by hand. Looked at the pages in pictures in English and German, NOT tried with a full install of every disc.  [2026-11-10]

Fixed the moving progress bar of the setup turning green when a step has no number: it has the red of the other bars now. Added a clock line (this step / all together) that counts every second, and the car pictures and the city level data show a count or the time, so no long step looks stuck. NOT tried through a full install by hand.  [2026-11-10]

Updated the license text of the setup: Driv3r and Gran Turismo 2 in the disc and trademark lines, and a short list of the work of other people (REDRIVER2, Psynapse and PsyCross, SDL2, OpenAL Soft, libjpeg, fonts, BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes, the Gran Turismo 2 PC port contributors) taken from THIRD_PARTY.txt. Some legal questions are still open.  [2026-11-10]

Added Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional) to the setup, so it has every language of the game; the East Asian languages use their own Windows UI font. The licence page is translated in every language (the MIT text, copyright lines and third party notices stay English as the binding original, with a note), shows the full THIRD_PARTY.txt (built into the setup, so it cannot differ from the file) and credits the logos of Gector Nathan. Also translated the log lines that were still English. Looked at the pages in pictures in English, German, Portuguese, Japanese and both Chinese. NOT tried by hand: a real install in a Japanese or Chinese Windows, and the translations were not read by native speakers.  [2026-11-10]

Gave the installer a side banner with the reDriver 2 Extended artwork on the first screen. The other pages use the full width. NOT tried by hand, only the layout test (21 languages, 4 scales) and pictures.  [2026-11-13]
Rewrote the install steps in the README for the single installer file. There is no zip to unpack any more.  [2026-11-13]

Added Find discs in a folder to the disc page of the installer. Point it at one folder and it searches that folder and its sub folders for every disc image it knows and fills in the rows, with a progress window, a Cancel button and a summary of what is still missing. NOT tried by hand, only automatic tests ran.  [2026-11-13]
Fixed the Driver 1 PC row of the setup, which took the Windows disc of Driv3r for the Driver 1 PC disc. NOT tried by hand, only automatic tests ran.  [2026-11-13]

Removed the old setup that was run inside the unzipped game folder. The game comes as one installer file now, and running the installer again on the same folder adds a disc or repairs the game. uninstall.exe in the game folder only uninstalls. NOT tried by hand, only automatic tests ran, and no new installer was built yet.  [2026-11-13]

Rebuilt the installer window after the new launcher mockup: the installer picture is the whole window, a white bar at the bottom with a plain gear icon (options), the progress with one status line, and red pill buttons. The window shows one card, Add your game discs: license, folder, the two Driver 2 discs, the extras with their disc rows, and the folder search, all in one place; INSTALL is on once the license is ticked and the discs are in order. Progress, Cancel as a small link, and the result with PLAY, OPEN FOLDER and VIEW LOG pills are on that same window. The gear holds language, folder, shortcuts and the disc report. No page by page wizard any more. Every installer step, disc check and switch is as before. 4 new texts in 20 languages. Layout test (21 languages x 4 scales), the disc scan test and the window smoke with real Driver 2 discs (install and cancel) pass. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Made the game folder tidier: only the launcher and the uninstaller sit in the main folder, the game, the Car Creator and their DLLs are in a bin folder. The game finds its folder from there by itself, the installer, the shortcuts, the launcher and the Car Creator know the new place, and a folder of an older install is tidied when you install over it. NOT tried by hand: only the automatic tests ran (unit tests, a start of the game from bin, the release scan).  [2026-11-14]

Changed the installer's progress line to Part 3 of 12 - name of the part, and the license text now says to close the setup if you do not accept (the second choice is gone, it is one tick). 2 new texts in 20 languages. Layout test (21 languages x 4 scales) passes. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-14]

Fixed the INSTALL button of the launcher, which did nothing. It now installs the whole game over the update channel. When no update is published yet (today the server has none) the status line says so: No update is published yet. Use Disc Install, or try again later. The button says INSTALL whenever the game is missing, also when an update was found. Layout checked by the automatic test in all 21 languages, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-15]

Added Disc Install to the launcher: a small link next to the bar while the game is missing and a button in Options. The launcher fetches the disc installer from the update server, checks the signed list and the hash of the file, and only then starts it on the game folder. It asks for all your discs and converts everything on your PC; nothing made from a disc is downloaded or uploaded. The setup got a --discs-only mode for this (no game files, no shortcuts, no uninstaller). 8 new texts in 21 languages (machine translation, native review owed). Tested by unit tests with a stub installer and by a tree compare with the Driver 2 discs (201 files equal), NOT tried by hand, NOT tested with all the discs.  [2026-11-15]

Changed the last page of Disc Install: the button now says Open the launcher and starts the launcher from the game folder, then the setup closes. If the launcher is not there, the button is off and the text says so. The normal installer still starts the game. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic layout and lookup tests ran (21 languages).  [2026-11-15]

Changed INSTALL in the launcher to be the only way to install. First it gets the program files from the update server, then the game data: a tester account gets the data from the server, everyone else gets Disc Install from their own discs. Removed the Disc Install button and the Tester access and Game lump buttons from Options, and the Disc Install link on the status line. NOT tried by hand, only the automatic tests ran (a real server on this PC, 21 languages at 4 scales). The real server and the setup with a real data lump were not tried.  [2026-11-15]

I fixed the update server so it hands out the Disc Install program; before, the launcher got a 404 when it asked for it. Tested with the server unit test; the live server still needs the update.  [2026-11-15]

Added a first step to the Disc Install wizard: it says you must own the original discs, that the mod has no game data in it and that your files stay on your PC, shows the license and the credits, and Next stays grey until you tick I own these discs and agree. The tick is remembered for that game folder, so adding a disc later does not ask again. Checked by unit tests, a window test with no disc and the layout test in 21 languages at 100, 125, 150 and 200 percent. NOT tried by hand, not with a pad.  [2026-11-15]

Split the last disc row of the wizard into three: Driv3r, The Italian Job (PC) and World's Scariest Police Chases each get their own tick, path box, Browse and disc name, and a disc in the wrong row is refused with a hint. Find discs in a folder fills each row. The conversion itself is unchanged. Checked by the disc scan unit test and the layout test. NOT tried by hand, NOT run with real discs.  [2026-11-15]

I built Disc Install into the launcher. After INSTALL the license, your disc rows (all nine, with Find discs in a folder) and the progress open inside the launcher window, and the launcher no longer downloads a separate installer to convert your discs. The convert code runs hidden inside the launcher's own files and reports its steps to the window. Tested by the automatic checks (the pages in 21 languages at four sizes, a fake engine, the real engine without discs). NOT tried by hand, NOT tried with real discs.  [2026-11-16]

Made game update releases possible as ONE lump file with the extension .update, in the same container as the data lumps: a full one for a fresh install or Repair and a small one with only the changed files and a list of removed files for the next build. The launcher picks a chain of the small ones when that is less to download, checks every file inside, and keeps the signature, the rollback, the self update and the player files exactly as before. Publish and upload tools and the server route are in, tested on loopback with a fake package only; nothing is deployed, and the launcher window was NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the texts that still sent you to reDriver_Setup.exe: the modding guides, the Linux steps, the install readme and the two messages the game shows when game data files are missing now say to run the installer again, and the readme names Disc Install in the launcher. The two messages are translated into all 21 languages (machine quality). NOT tried by hand, only the text checks ran.  [2026-11-16]

I changed the last texts that still sent you to the old setup. The level editor message about a missing level file and the console message about missing Driv3r characters now say to open the launcher and choose Disc Install (Serbian and Ukrainian lines updated, the other languages show the English line). I also removed one unused text of the installer. Checked by the language and installer text tools only; I have not tried it by hand.  [2026-11-16]

I made the launcher take over a game folder that was installed with the old installer (0.4.0-beta of 13 November). The update checks every file by hash and downloads only what differs. Then the old programs in the root move to updates\adopted, the shortcuts and the Apps entry follow the launcher, and uninstall.exe is replaced by the one of the new layout. Saves, settings, mods and game data are not touched. Tested with a copy of a real old install and a local test server: not tried by hand, not tried on the real server.  [2026-11-16]

I fixed an update that stopped and rolled back when two files of the release had the same bytes (the same texture in two packs): the first one took the downloaded copy and the second found none. Found with the old install test. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]
I fixed the downloaded update file staying in updates\staging after an update (it kept its own file open, a full release is far over 100 MB). Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

I moved the license to its own first step in the disc install wizard: the license page comes first (I own these discs and agree, then Next), and the disc list page no longer shows the license box or a second tick. The tick is still remembered per game folder in the launcher window, Start on the first screen still needs it. Tested with the layout test (21 languages, 4 scales) and a window test of the page order; NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-16]

Changed the installer and launcher texts that said run the setup again: they now say open the launcher and press Disc Install, in 13 installer window texts plus the launcher, 20 languages. The same for the damaged / missing level file messages, the editor help and the credits lines. The admin hint says start the launcher as administrator. Checked by the language and unit tests only, NOT tried by hand: how the lines look in the installer window and the launcher, and the translations are machine made.  [2026-11-16]

Changed the README, the editor manual, the modding guides, THIRD_PARTY files and the config comments to say Disc Install or the installer where they said the setup. The Online sentence in the README Known problems is its own bullet now and says what is true: early test code, greyed out until I switch it on, not tried by hand and not on two real home networks, no matchmaking. NOT tried by hand, text only.  [2026-11-16]

Fixed the error at the end of a Disc Install that said setup_log.txt was used by another program. The install itself was fine; only the log copy in setup_report.txt was empty. Checked by the launcher unit tests, NOT tried by hand with a new install.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed a fresh install from the launcher having an empty config folder, so the game opened small (800x600) with no settings. The launcher now puts the shipped settings and name lists there when they are missing and never replaces your own changed files. Checked by the launcher unit tests (15 of 15), NOT tried by hand with a fresh install yet.  [2026-11-17]

Moves the nine core folders (Core pack, Ashland, London, Driver 1 Missions, car photos, Goose Island and the Driv3r characters) out of the mods folder in the engine: the game now reads them as built-in packs from GAME_DATA/PACKS, always on, the Core first, before the real mods. An old install that still has them in mods keeps working (that copy is used until PACKS has the pack, never both), and the level edits of the old Core folder are copied over once without overwriting. The level editor saves into the new place, the mods screen and the mod check show them as built-in and still report a mod that changes a file of one. Mod fingerprint and batch cache hash do not depend on where a pack lives. Tick hash identical in both layouts (same 166 ok, same 18 that already differed before). NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Moved the game's own packs out of the mods folder into GAME_DATA/PACKS: Ashland, The Italian Job London, Driver 1 Missions, car photos, Goose Island, Driv3r characters and the Core pack are part of the game, not mods. Mods keeps BetterCars, Driver2TextureFixes and your own mods. The package stages them there, Disc Install makes Ashland, London and the Driver 1 missions there, and an older install is moved over once with the level edits and the disc built data (the setup log says what was moved, nothing is overwritten). An old data lump still installs into the new place. Checked by the setup lump tests and the rdbuild self test, NOT tried by hand with an old install or a real Disc Install.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the updater for the packs in GAME_DATA/PACKS: the packs made from your discs stay untouched, level edit files and engine sounds are kept, the shipped packs are replaced like other game files. When an update moves a shipped pack out of mods, the old copy is taken away into the rollback folder when you did not change it, a changed copy is left and written to the launcher log. Checked by the launcher unit tests (15 of 15), NOT tried by hand with a real update.  [2026-11-17]

Cleaned up and regrouped the shipped config.ini by topic (setup, draw distance, traffic, cars, light and weather, sound, online, controls). Removed the dead userChases line. Every setting keeps its value. The release config check passes. NOT tried by hand in the game.  [2026-11-17]

Added a Disc Install step that turns the nine CD audio tracks of the Driver 1 PC disc into WAV files in GAME_DATA/SOUND/DRIVER1. It reads the German, Spanish, USA, French and Italian dumps and the English Nero image, and skips a disc without audio (the PlayStation images have none). Tested on scratch copies by the tools only, NOT tried by hand in the wizard, and the game does not play the files yet.  [2026-11-17]
Changed the made-by line of THIRD_PARTY.txt (water texture, main menu picture, installer picture) to say CatFlip instead of me. Text only.  [2026-11-17]

Reworded the credits in THIRD_PARTY.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: the weather and aircraft sounds belong to CatFlip, one trademark sentence for Driver, Driver 2, Driv3r and Gran Turismo, and the made-by lines say CatFlip. Text only.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the launcher update so the one update file is unpacked while it downloads. A thread reads the end of the file first, cuts every file out as soon as its bytes are there and builds the check hash on the way, so there is no wait for 3000+ files after the download. On a scratch test with 3121 files the unpack after the download went from 11.7 s to under 0.1 s. The hash check of the whole file and every file stays, a broken transfer falls back to the old way. NOT tried by hand, only loopback and folder tests.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the launcher progress bars. Every step has its own real percent and stops at 99 until the step is done, steps with no total (checking, making the city files, disc steps without a percent) show a moving bar with the step name, the unpack and the check of a download have their own text, and the Disc Install bar counts steps and never goes back. After an update with no discs in the install the launcher asks once to run Disc Install again so the city files match online games. NOT tried by hand, only pictures and unit tests.  [2026-11-17]

Changed INSTALL in the launcher into one flow with one bar. It lists every step (check, download the program files, install them, your discs, download the game data, install it, check the files, city files) with the done ones ticked, and the line under the bar says Step 3 of 9 and the name. The percent is weighted by the real work (download sizes, unpack, the disc conversion), never goes back and says waiting for you where you have to act. NOT tried by hand: only the layout pictures, the unit tests and a small local install ran.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the launcher stopping in the middle of INSTALL after it updated itself. The new launcher now goes on with INSTALL by itself (game data, discs, city files) and does not need to be closed and opened again. NOT tried by hand: a local install with a self update ran, not the real list.  [2026-11-17]

Fixed the launcher saying Play after INSTALL and Update after the next start. The game data and the discs rewrite some files of the update list, so INSTALL now ends with the list run once more from the file that is still there (no second download) and the button shows what a fresh start would show. NOT tried by hand: the unit test does the same steps on a scratch folder.  [2026-11-17]

Moved BetterCars, Driver2TextureFixes and Driv3r Miami out of the mods folder in the engine: they are built-in packs of GAME_DATA/PACKS now, always on, and load in the same order as before (after the Core pack and the other game packs, before your mods). A Driv3r Miami that Disc Install made in mods is moved to GAME_DATA/PACKS once at the next start (one rename, nothing is copied). An old mods copy of BetterCars or Driver2TextureFixes is used until the update has put the pack in place. The content check of online rooms did not change. Checked on a copy of a 1302 install: the same pack order, the same identity file, with the old layout and with the new one. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-17]

Changed Disc Install and the data lumps for the three new core packs: the Driv3r Miami city and its cars are made in GAME_DATA/PACKS/Driv3r Miami, and the setup moves an older mods/Driv3r Miami, mods/BetterCars and mods/Driver2TextureFixes there once (nothing is overwritten). An old data lump with mods/Driv3r Miami paths is installed in the new place. Unit test lump passes. NOT tried with a real Driv3r disc.  [2026-11-17]

Changed the package and the update for BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes: they ship in GAME_DATA/PACKS, and the update takes the old copies in mods away (into the rollback folder, only when you did not change them). A file of your own in mods/BetterCars stays where it is. The Driv3r Miami folder made from your disc is never in an update list. Checked by the launcher unit tests (launcher_core, launcher_update). NOT tried with a real signed update on a real install.  [2026-11-17]

Updated the Known problems of the README: removed dynamic weather, restarting a mission, Driver 1 cars and cities and the editor, and rewrote the Online line (Online is open, two real PCs joined a room on my server). Text only.  [2026-11-17]
Removed split screen from the Known problems of the README: the smaller shadow and reflection maps and closer fog per view are by design. Text only.  [2026-11-17]

Made the launcher INSTALL download the game data for everybody in the testing phase. No tester account and no discs needed. It takes the data from a signed public list, checks every file and installs it like the tester path. Without that list it asks for the discs as before. Disc Install is still there: tick it in Options. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Put the experimental Destruction Derby cars into the game data download: they travel in the same part as the Driv3r cars, so a download install has them without the discs. Checked by the lump unit test, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the realistic car physics file not reaching players through the update: config/carsheet.ini was left out as a settings file. It is now a seed file of the update, written when missing and kept when the player changes it. Checked with the launcher unit tests, and a test install showed the file missing before the fix. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-18]

Fixed the hidden INSTALL click of the launcher (--auto-install, used by tests and scripts) stopping at the Your own discs page when the public game data list is on the server. It now takes the same way as the INSTALL button in the window for a player who is no tester: it finds the public list, downloads the base, update and disc installer data, installs it and ends with the same result lines. With no list it still ends at the Disc Install page. Auto tested, NOT tried by hand with a real public list.  [2026-11-18]

sections.title: Translations
lines: Translated the level editor manual into all languages.  [2026-10-14]
Translated the level editor button tooltips into all languages and made the tooltip box fit longer texts.  [2026-10-14]
Translated the new setup texts for the Gran Turismo discs, archives and Driver 1 cities into all languages.  [2026-10-15]
Translated the city maps step of the setup and its messages into all languages.  [2026-10-15]
Translated the Traffic Cars and Extended Cars texts into all languages.  [2026-10-15]
Added a language report to the translation tool, it lists the missing and the wrong lines for all languages.  [2026-10-21]
Added a pseudo language to the translation tool, it helps to find text that does not fit or is not translated.  [2026-10-21]
Added two translation tool commands that find text in the code that is not yet in the translation sheets and wrap tables so they can be translated.  [2026-10-21]
Added the English texts for the pause menu Players submenu (1 to 8 players), and gave the Start Game row of the Multiplayer menu its own text in all languages.  [2026-10-22]
Added about 240 new texts in all languages (game modes, Multiplayer menu, profiles, local players, credits), machine translated.  [2026-10-22]
Translated 117 new texts (CB package, Courier, Multiplayer Local and Online, car picker, profile manage) into Czech, Slovak and Polish, machine translated.  [2026-10-22]
Translated the same 117 new texts into French, Italian, Spanish and Romanian, machine translated.  [2026-10-22]
Translated the same 117 new texts into German, Hungarian, Turkish, Greek and Russian, machine translated.  [2026-10-22]

Added the new editor texts in German, French, Spanish, Italian, Romanian, Czech, Slovak, Polish, Russian, Greek, Hungarian and Turkish (round 4, machine translated, no native review yet).  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the editor label NEW to use the feminine form (scene and mission) in French, Italian, Romanian and Greek.  [2026-10-23]
Translated the 423 new editor texts into German, French, Spanish and Italian (round 5, machine translated).  [2026-10-23]
Translated the 423 new editor texts into Czech, Slovak, Polish, Hungarian and Romanian (round 5, machine translated).  [2026-10-23]
Translated the 423 new editor texts into Russian, Greek and Turkish (round 5, machine translated).  [2026-10-23]
Added the SAVE FAILED message of the level editor in all languages.  [2026-10-24]
Added the 28 new installer texts in all languages (machine translated) and fixed the uninstaller leaving a file behind.  [2026-10-25]
Translated the BAKE, RESET LEVEL and no surface messages of the editor into all languages.  [2026-10-26]
Translated the file browser texts and the remaining editor help texts into all languages.  [2026-10-26]
Added the 62 new editor texts in all languages (machine translated, no native review).  [2026-10-27]
Filled the missing texts in Czech (215 texts), Slovak and Polish (machine translated, no native review).  [2026-10-28]
Filled the missing texts in Hungarian, Romanian and Greek (machine translated, no native review).  [2026-10-28]
Filled the missing texts in French, German and Italian, with the CB radio names and the weather and headlights options.  [2026-10-28]
Filled the missing texts in Spanish, Russian and Turkish, with the CB radio names and the weather and headlights options.  [2026-10-28]
Repaired broken characters in the Russian, Greek, Polish and Spanish editor texts.  [2026-10-28]
Added five missing texts in six languages and shortened five over-long lines.  [2026-10-28]

Added Brazilian Portuguese as a language: the HUD, jobs, CB radio, game texts, missions, credits, the main menu, pause menu and options, the subtitles, the game modes and the taxi texts (shortened the taxi fare multiplier label). Machine translated, a native speaker review is still to come.  [2026-10-29]
Translated the level editor into Brazilian Portuguese.  [2026-10-29]

Translated the texts of the new level editor look into all languages (machine translated, not checked by a native speaker). 150 texts per language. Looked at pictures of the editor in German, Russian, French, Greek, Hungarian, Turkish and Polish.  [2026-10-30]
Translated the new setup step Shared disc data into the 12 setup languages, plus five older setup messages that were still English. Machine translated, not checked by a native speaker.  [2026-10-30]
Translated the new editor help pages and the tool palette words into the other 13 language folders, plus the out-of-memory message box. Machine translated, no native review.  [2026-10-30]

Translated the new menu texts into all languages: the Blood row, Local Players, Keyboard 3 and 4, Gamepad 5 to 8, the car group options, Pedestrians Crossing Roads and two titles of the mods menu. Machine translated, no native review.  [2026-11-02]

Translated the new options texts (page and group names, the new settings, one line of help per row) into all languages: Czech, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish and Turkish. Machine translation, not reviewed by a native speaker.  [2026-11-03]

Fixed the Russian options menu. The help line under the View row showed broken letters because the menu cut a long Cyrillic line inside a letter, so it now holds the whole help text. The rows View, Game, People & Traffic and Interface and the values Simple and Advanced had no translation, so they stayed English in every language; they are translated now (machine translation).  [2026-11-04]

Filled the texts that were still missing in all translations: the console and developer log messages, the credits line, the CB radio handles, the editor shape name and the Portuguese editor labels. Machine translation, NOT checked by native speakers.  [2026-11-04]

Added Japanese, Chinese Simplified and Chinese Traditional translations of every text (menus, HUD, jobs, CB radio, subtitles, credits headings, level editor). Machine translation, NOT checked by a native speaker. The CJK glyph rendering is a separate job.  [2026-11-04]

Made the game draw Japanese and Chinese letters. A language with a cjk line in its language.txt gets the glyphs of its texts drawn at run time from the Noto Sans CJK font (SIL OFL, ships with the game) into the in game text, front end and HUD fonts. Text wraps after any CJK letter. The names of the three languages show in every language. English and the other languages look the same as before.  [2026-11-04]

Changed the credits line in all languages to say reDriver 2: Extended is on top of the REDRIVER2 source port by SoapyMan. The other languages got a fresh machine translation of the new sentence.  [2026-11-04]
Fixed a damaged translation line that could crash the game. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Wrote into the README and the localizations readme that most translations are machine made and ship as they are, and that a native speaker can send corrections.  [2026-11-09]
Added the photo mode colour texts to all 21 language files by hand: the new tabs, rows, tips, the 30 looks and the credits line.  [2026-11-09]

Added its own message for a replay, demo or mission of a city that is not installed (before it said the level was damaged). Written by hand in all 21 languages. NOT tried by hand: the message box was never looked at on screen.  [2026-11-09]
Added the texts of the Auto Exchange (panel, prices, messages and the shady CB calls) in all 21 languages, written by hand. NOT reviewed by native speakers.  [2026-11-11]
Added the texts of the Auto Exchange menu and the Pick List in all 21 languages, written by hand. NOT reviewed by native speakers.  [2026-11-11]

sections.title: Performance and Stability
lines: Fixed a small memory leak in the setup when a city conversion fails.  [2026-10-15]
Fixed replays reading the wrong spot at the edge of the map, with no effect a player can see.  [2026-10-15]
Changed damaged car pack files and damaged override pictures to get refused instead of crashing the game, after 6 crashes found with damaged files.  [2026-10-15]
Added a freeze report: when no frame has been drawn for 20 seconds, the game writes where it was stuck into the crash log.  [2026-10-20]
Fixed a freeze in split screen when a player was far off the map with the police after him, the traffic search never ended.  [2026-10-20]

Changed the game logic to run on a steady clock that catches up when a frame is late, the same for every number of players, and made everything the game times follow that game clock, not the number of frames drawn, so the frame rate can't change the game.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the random number generator overflowing after about 25 minutes of play, and made the model shift of a mission file checked against its range.  [2026-10-21]
Fixed the game's random numbers starting a restart at a different place than a fresh start.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed restarts keeping the old camera (look direction and position), bot counter and cop target, so the first cars and people that appeared were not the same as in a fresh start.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed the wallet of player 1 keeping its trip counter and loose cents after a restart, the money itself stays.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed a restart keeping the hour of the old game, it now starts the day clock again like a new game, so traffic and people follow the hour again.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed a restart taking the lowered rush hour limit of pedestrians for the full setting.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed the Havana ferry foam timer surviving a restart, which changed the Havana traffic.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed cars of a new game inheriting waits and yields from the cars of the old game after a restart, and cleared the traffic yield timers at a level load.  [2026-10-22]
Fixed racers keeping the dodge side of the old game after a restart.  [2026-10-22]
Made the game rebuild the pad menu names only when a pad is plugged in or removed, not on every pad update.  [2026-10-22]
Cut the number of graphics error checks to one per frame instead of one after every drawn piece.  [2026-10-22]
Changed two math routines of the traffic (square root and multiply-divide) to run several times faster with exactly the same results.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the traffic to look only at cars in the nearby grid cells instead of every car, same results as before.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the game to refuse replay files whose sizes and tables do not fit the file, so a bad shared replay no longer crashes it.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the sound code to refuse samples with no end, writes outside sound memory and broken sound bank tables.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the mission loader to check header sizes before using them, and the mission text sum no longer overflows.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the ladder position to clamp when a save is loaded, and the text saves to get written safely in one step.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed texts from files being used as a format string in the menus, and replay names keep their full length.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the music loaders to limit the XM header counts and check the bank sizes.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the language file loader to end its text and check the file size.  [2026-10-23]
Changed menu music and car sound WAV files to be safe to load: the decode is capped, the rate is limited and the format chunk is checked.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the mod scan to stop following junctions and cap the number of files it reads.  [2026-10-23]
Did a second round of safety fixes for song tables, language texts, mission messages and sound memory.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed a level or model with a bad texture page number reading outside its data. It shows page 0 and logs once instead.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the car to car collision test to only look at neighbouring cars, three times faster with the same results.  [2026-10-23]
Changed the check between you on foot and the cars to skip empty car slots, same results.  [2026-10-23]
Cut the graphics calls for the car shadows and the grass, they are set up once instead of on every draw.  [2026-10-23]
Put the fog, colour grade, sun shadow and light values of a frame in one shared block, about 500 fewer graphics calls a frame.  [2026-10-23]
Fixed the pause menu going round in circles on a menu made only of separators, and the modern pause menu now holds up to 128 rows with the right row selected.  [2026-10-24]

Changed the out of memory message to name the real menu path (Options > Graphics Settings in the pause menu, Options > Graphics in the main menu), and the console texts are in all languages.  [2026-10-24]
Freed 58 MB of memory by removing a leftover vertex cache of the old PlayStation layer.  [2026-10-26]
Fixed the graphics memory of the old level staying behind when you travel to another city, a chain of four trips held 1 GB.  [2026-10-26]
Fixed built cars leaving memory behind at every level change.  [2026-10-26]
Freed the grass memory of a level when it ends, so a trip to another city holds much less memory.  [2026-10-26]
Added a clean-up of the cache of the far city, with a setting for how many files to keep.  [2026-10-26]
Changed the street life layer to start with small buffers, from 52 MB to under 1 MB with the same pictures.  [2026-10-26]
Added a shader cache on disk so levels start faster, the first start builds it while the intro plays.  [2026-10-28]
Fixed a crash when a mod car model file in a level folder is damaged or too big, the level's own model is used instead.  [2026-10-29]
Fixed a hidden number overflow in the traffic driving code: distances to far points are now squared in 64 bit, so cars far from their control node see the true distance.  [2026-10-30]
Fixed the traffic spawn distance check: it wrapped past 65535 units, so a far car could look near and block a spawn. It is 64 bit now.  [2026-10-31]
Fixed the crash when typing 'weather rain' in the console. A bad 2D item is now logged and skipped instead of crashing. Tested In-Game: Functioning  [2026-11-01]
Stopped the city cache from being made again for every weather, so there is one 200 MB file and a start in rain no longer waits for a 7 second bake.  [2026-11-01]
Made loading a city you have loaded before quicker: Chicago went from about 4.4 s to about 3.2 s from the start of the game to driving. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]
Made a crowd of the new pedestrians much cheaper to draw. The picture is the same. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]
Removed a short stutter when a new pedestrian model plays a walk, run or idle clip for the first time. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]
Made the first-start shader build faster: the 21 programs compile in parallel and finish in about 2 s of work.  [2026-11-02]
Made the first load of a city quicker: the time to driving in Chicago on a first start went from about 9.7 s to about 6.9 s. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-02]

Added the setting Pedestrian Detail (High, Normal, Low) for the Driv3r pedestrians. High is the old look, Normal and Low use simpler models at a distance and cut the cost per pedestrian by about 40 to 50 percent.  [2026-11-02]
Cut the cost of the light streaks on the wet road: the GPU time of a wet night went from 2.05 to 1.77 ms.  [2026-11-02]
Sped up the tree shadows by skipping the trees outside the shadow strip.  [2026-11-02]
Sped up making the city map picture on the first load of a city: Chicago 1.8 s to 1.05 s, Vegas 4.8 s to 2.9 s.  [2026-11-02]
Changed the movie player to skip a damaged frame instead of ending the game. Valid disc movies play as before.  [2026-11-03]
Fixed demo recordings storing cars from slot 256 up as another car; they are skipped and logged once. Old demos read as before.  [2026-11-03]
Split the game into a developer build and a release build with one compile switch. The release build has no test code and is smaller (7.15 MB against 7.58 MB).  [2026-11-03]

Stopped the timer of the game from using part of a CPU core. It spun the last 2.5 ms of every tick, now it waits on a high resolution timer and spins 0.6 ms. The timer used about 12 percent of a core before and about 1.5 percent after. Frame rate and game speed stay the same. NOT tried by hand: the sound and the music timing were not listened to.  [2026-11-03]

Made the night lights cheaper on the CPU. The cone of every car beam was worked out with five trig calls per point, now once per light. Night frame part for the batch pass in the night test: 0.54 to 0.55 ms before, 0.39 to 0.41 ms after (day is 0.28 ms). Pictures are the same: night and rain night test scenes have 0 changed pixels, the chaotic night chase scene shows the same difference with the old and the new build. The PC was loaded by other tests during the runs. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-03]
Fixed an OpenGL error that was logged on the first start of the game  [2026-11-04]
Fixed crashes when a mod or scene has a damaged picture or a zip file that blows up when opened. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed a crash and an endless loop on a damaged WAVE sound file. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added stack protection and checked string functions to the game and the setup. The load time with them was not measured. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Made the second start of a city a little faster by reading the car files on several threads. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed the stop of up to half a second in the first frames after a load by building the shaders behind the load screen. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Made the black bars over the loading picture close 3 times faster, so a city loads a bit sooner. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Changed the first-start shader build to give the graphics driver 2 programs at a time instead of 4, so a first start into Chicago went from 10.9 to 9.0 seconds. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Fixed far away pedestrians throwing a huge dark patch of shadow over the street, which also cost speed. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-05]
Added a level validator, so a damaged level file can no longer make the game read outside its data. Normal levels load the same. Not tried by hand.  [2026-11-06]

Fixed a damaged profile or garage save file with a very long line: the end of the line is no longer read as a new setting, the whole line is dropped. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]
Fixed the texture page unpacker reading past the end of a damaged car or night texture block. It now stops at the end of the block. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Fixed five crashes when a level file is damaged and has no road and region tables: the game now gets further before it stops. A damaged level can still crash later, it is not refused at load yet. Found by the damaged level fuzz test, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-08]

Went through the event files, the front end main file, the sound mixer, the jobs and the borrowed cars line by line and fixed what was clear. A mission that calls the Chicago truck event too often, or triggers an event with a negative number, no longer writes outside its tables. A replaced front end screen file (SCRS.BIN) with too many screens, buttons or a bad link can no longer crash the menu. A negative side volume no longer gives a broken sound pan, a sound driver without the reverb functions is skipped, the mod jobs file and respect.ini keep their numbers in range, a very long line in fares.txt is skipped as a whole, and a car model with a wrapped polygon count is refused. The simulation changes only add checks. NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-09]

Added checks for numbers in mod and disc files that could write outside the game tables or crash it: route and junction count of a mission, a mission cut off short, car slot and event flag of a mission target, city texture pages, special car numbers, police light bar and horizon values, long engine sound file names, a texture override over 256 KB, the kerb count of a level, file names that point out of a level package, and a script that went on after an error. A bad value is ignored or the file is refused, with a line in the log. Checked by automatic tests, NOT tried by hand.  [2026-11-10]

sections.title: LEVEL EDITOR
lines: Level editor: the menu dropdown no longer clicks through to the buttons below it.
Level editor: a box select over original faces is instant now (it used to cast 600 rays).
Level editor: the green highlight shows every selected face, tinted and outlined.
Level editor: a piece whose outline passes within a few pixels of the cursor is picked even when the ray misses it.
Level editor: every colour follows the HUD theme (70s, PlayStation, Driver Menu, mod themes). VIEW > Next theme switches it.
Level editor: the piece list shows a thumbnail of each piece's texture.
Level editor: F1 opens the manual and the polygon keys are F2 / F3.
Level editor: HELP > Keyboard shortcuts lists every shortcut in one table, checked for clashes at start.
Level editor: the renderer's own debug keys (F3, F5, F6, Backspace) no longer fire while the editor is open.
Level editor manual: 21 pages, including a BUTTONS page per tab made from the UI (every button with its tip).
Level editor manual: pages for the menus, themes, importing, the mission maker and scenes. The same text ships as EDITOR_MANUAL.txt.
Level editor import: drop an .obj (with its .mtl and pictures) on the window and it is copied into the library and used.
Level editor import: drop a png / jpg / tga on the window to use it as a custom texture.
Level editor: CREATE > OBJ MODELS lists the imported models, with a SIZE setting.
Level editor: in FACES mode a lamp, sign or barrier lights up under the cursor.
Level editor: a click turns that lamp, sign or barrier into a piece you can move, turn, scale, copy or delete (before it could only be deleted).
Level editor: fixed a hitch of up to 0.8 s every few frames in cities with many hidden original faces (New York has about 23 000).
Level editor: picking the original face under the cursor now uses a spatial hash, so a pick takes 1 ms instead of 160 - 810 ms.

sections.title: SCENES AND MISSION MAKER
lines: Scenes: new story format made of comic panels (picture + caption, voice and music wav), title cards and avi clips.
Scenes: they are files at mods/<pack>/scenes/<name>/scene.txt. See tools/MODDING_scenes.txt and mods/_samples/Sample Scene.
Scenes: play them from Extras > Custom Missions, with the console command "scene <name>", or as the intro / outro scene of a custom mission.
Scenes: slow camera moves over a picture (move=zoomin ... pandown) and fades.
Scenes: a scene can continue with another scene (next=).
Scenes: a mission can continue with another mission (THEN MISSION), so you can build a story chain.
Scenes: seconds=hold keeps a panel until a button is pressed.
Scenes: Left / L1 goes one panel back.
Scenes: a damaged jpg picture no longer closes the game.
Scene composer: new SCENES tab in the level editor that builds scenes with buttons (pictures, captions, voices, music, clips, order, PLAY).
Scene composer: drop png / jpg / tga, wav or avi files on the window to add them.
Mission maker: new INTRO SCENE / OUTRO SCENE rows.
Mission maker: the start, goals, targets and destinations of the draft are drawn as labelled rings in the editor view.
Mission maker: new NEW / COPY / DELETE buttons for mission slots.
Mission maker: a line under the summary says what the draft still lacks (no start, no goal, tail without destination ...).
Mission maker: new STOP, SPEED and POLICE steps for custom missions.
Mission maker: new CAR DAMAGE row and slot titles.
Mission maker: browsing the mission slots no longer leaves empty drafts behind.
Mission maker: EDIT TEXT no longer crashes on a read only mod folder.

sections.title: CAMERA AND CONTROLS
lines: Photo mode takes the mouse: Tab shows the pointer, a click on a row changes it, the wheel steps, and there is a Take Photo button.
Photo mode: the left stick strafed the wrong way. Fixed.
Camera Views: Options > Camera Views (also in the main menu under Controls) chooses which of the 12 views the camera button cycles.
Camera Views default: 3rd person, bumper, hood.
The on-foot view is no longer carried into the next car.
Gamepad: the radio buttons come only from your bindings (Radio / Job: Previous / Next).
Gamepad: the shoulder buttons no longer change the station when they are bound to something else.

sections.title: CUSTOMIZER
lines: The Customizer takes the mouse: tabs, car / sound lists, paint swatches and wheel cells are clickable.
Customizer: new Sound tab to pick the engine sound of your car from every sound the game knows (Driver 2 cars and the sound sets of mods' carsounds folders). You hear it while you choose.
Customizer Sound tab: labels come from carsounds/names.txt, and the audition works while the game is paused.
The engine sound choice is saved with the car in garage.sav.
Car customizer (pause menu > Customize) now has three tabs: Car, Paint and Wheels. The camera shows the car at an angle and turns around it.
Customizer Car tab: every installed car in one list (this city, the other cities, Driver 1, packs such as Gran Turismo). Your car is swapped on the spot, no restart. Works in Take a Drive.
Customizer Car tab: cars that are not loaded are loaded as you scroll.
Customizer Paint tab: the paints of that car as swatches.
Customizer Wheels tab: thumbnails of 188 wheel designs, with finishes.
Wheel designs: the stock wheels of the four Driver 2 cities and of Driver 1, and the wheel shop of Gran Turismo 2 as a separate set.
The Gran Turismo 1 rims were dropped (too blurry).
Wheel files: game\wheels\d2.wheels, d1.wheels (made from the discs' levels) and gt2.wheels (made from a Gran Turismo 2 disc).
Customizer texts are in 12 languages.
Customizer: new Lights tab to move the built-in lamps of any car in the 3D view (mouse gizmo or keyboard).
Customizer Lights tab: add lamps (headlight, taillight, turn signal, running light, side marker, reverse, brake, fog) with a name, colour and size.
Lamp behavior can be always on, brake, gas, reverse, lights on, turn left / right or hazard.
Customizer: new Exhaust tab to move the exhaust pipe of any car in the 3D view and add extra pipes with their own scale and smoke start.
Customizer: the rim size of the wheels is adjustable.
Lamps and exhaust pipes are saved per car as text in the Core mod (cars\fx\<car>.carfx).
The converted Driver 1 cars and the wheel files are stored in the Core mod now (mods\reDriver 2 Extended Core\cars / wheels).
The paint, wheel design and rim size of every car you customize are remembered in your save (saves\<profile>\garage.sav).
They are put on the car again when you start Take a Drive or pick the car.

sections.title: SETUP AND PACKAGE
lines: Setup: the city map pictures are made by the setup now, so the game no longer builds them at your first visit to a city.
Setup: at the end of the install it lets the game build the map of every city (Driver 2 and the installed Driver 1 cities) in a hidden window, about a minute and a half.
Setup: the loading pictures of the Driver 1 cities get their map behind the city name.
Setup (reDriver_Setup.exe): everything the dev game makes from your discs is now made by the setup itself, nothing else needs to be installed.
Setup now makes the Gran Turismo 1 and 2 cars (with pop-up headlights, decals and race cars) and all engine sounds.
Setup now makes the Driver 1 / Driver 2 / Gran Turismo 2 wheel designs (Customizer Wheels tab).
Setup now makes the four Driver 1 cities (Take A Ride).
Setup: new rows for Gran Turismo and Gran Turismo 2 (EBOOT.PBP, .cue/.bin or .iso). The Driver 2 disc 1 is the template of the cars.
Setup also makes the loading pictures of the Driver 1 cities.
Setup: disc images may stay in a .zip or .7z archive (also both discs, also an archive with several images). The setup unpacks to a temporary folder and cleans it up.
Setup: .rar and other archive types get a message to unpack them first.
Setup: all new texts are translated into the 12 setup languages.
Setup: the Driver 1 PC cars no longer print a FAILED line for pc_player15. The 30 PC cars are made as before.
Setup: Nero images use the first data track (audio tracks are skipped).
Setup: the window follows the DPI of the monitor it is on.
The modder tools (tools\*.exe) are an optional separate download (reDriver_ModTools_<version>.zip) instead of being in the game package.
Players do not need the modder tools. The package is a third of its size (34 MB instead of 131 MB) with fewer antivirus false positives. The guides stay in the package.

sections.title: CARS
lines: Yellow Cab: without the Driver 1 disc the cab is the Driver 2 Bel Air repainted yellow with the checker band.
Yellow Cab: the project ships only the painted pixels (an overlay). The rest is made from your own disc.
Gran Turismo cars: lamps and badges set back under a bigger body panel (the taillights of many cars) are drawn in front of it now.
Cars with more than 255 vertices / polygons can be dented now (the dent lists are 16 bit).
The old 255 limit also overran the damage level table of models with more than 256 polygons. Fixed.
